source: 😈 Anticheat Support
zh: 😈 反作弊支持

source: MMOCore will automatically hook into anti-cheat plugins and can be configured to disable certain checks when casting skills.
zh: MMOCore将自动挂钩到anti-cheat插件，并可以配置为在投射技能时禁用某些检查。

source: > **INFO**
> Only skills made using MythicMobs are supported
zh: > 仅支持使用MythicMobs制作的技能

source: The way it works, is by specifying different Anti-Cheat types and disabling them for a certain amount of ticks.
zh: 它的工作方式是指定不同的Anti-Cheat类型并在一定数量的刻内禁用它们。

source: Adding Anti-Cheat to MythicMob skills
zh: 将Anti-Cheat添加到 MythicMob技能

source: (In order to set up MythicMob skills, [go here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/archive/dead-link)) To add Anti-Cheat support to your MythicMob skills, simply add `disabled-anti-cheats:` to your skill YML file. (The one in MMOCore) You can then add 'flags' with a tick value depending on which Anti-Cheat systems you need to disable.
zh: （为了设置 MythicMob技能，[转到此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/archive/dead-link)）要将Anti-Cheat支持添加到你的 MythicMob技能，只需将`disabled-anti-cheats:`添加到你的技能YML 文件中。 （MMOCore中的那个）然后，你可以添加带有刻值的“标志”，具体取决于你需要禁用的Anti-Cheat系统。

source: You can modify the player class, level, party, skill data, quest data and anything else. Player data is loaded sync when the player joins, on event priority NORMAL.
zh: 你可以修改玩家职业、等级、队伍、技能数据、任务数据和其他任何内容。  当玩家加入时，玩家数据同步加载，事件优先级为 NORMAL。

source: Adding extra quest conditions/triggers/drop table items/conditions
zh: 添加额外的任务条件/触发器/掉落表物品/条件

source: In order to improve compatibility with other drop table or quest plugins, you may need to register extra options like drop table items, conditions, or quest conditions/triggers.
zh: 为了提高与其他掉落表或任务插件的兼容性，你可能需要注册额外的选项，例如掉落表物品、条件或任务条件/触发器。

source: Loading these options is made using instances of `MMOLoader`. The more loaders MMOCore has, the more of these options it can recognize (just like skill mechanics or drop table items in MythicMobs). First, you need to setup your `MMOLoader` so it loads any extra option. For example, here is the default `MMOLoader`:
zh: 使用`MMOLoader`的实例加载这些选项。MMOCore拥有的加载器越多，它可以识别的选项就越多（就像技能机制或MythicMobs中的掉落表物品一样）。首先，你需要设置`MMOLoader`，以便它加载任何额外选项。例如，这是默认的`MMOLoader`：

source: As you can see, you must override one method from the MMOLoader superclass for each option type (trigger/condition/drop item...). `config` returns an object which lets you get info about line configs like `vanilla{type=DIAMOND} 0.5 1-3` (similar to MythicMobs API).
zh: 正如你所看到的，你必须为每种选项类型（触发/条件/删除物品...）重写 MMOLoader 超类中的一个方法。`config`返回一个对象，可让你获取有关线路配置的信息，如`vanilla{type=DIAMOND} 0.5 1-3`（类似于MythicMobsAPI）。

source: Once your MMOLoader is setup, you must register it in MMOCore using `MMOCore.plugin.loadManager.registerLoader(yourMMOLoader)`. Make sure you register it before **MMOCore is enabled**. Either make your plugin load before MMOCore and register it when it enables, or don't risk any loading order issue and register it when your plugin is **loading** after MMOCore has been loaded.
zh: 设置 MMOLoader 后，你必须使用`MMOCore.plugin.loadManager.registerLoader(yourMMOLoader)`将其注册到MMOCore中。确保在**MMOCore启用**之前注册它。要么让你的插件在MMOCore之前加载并在启用时注册它，要么不要冒任何加载顺序问题的风险，并在MMOCore加载后**加载**时注册它。

source: 🏹 MMOItems

source: MMOCore is built to be used with MMOItems ([Polymart](https://polymart.org/product/3413/mmoitems) / [Spigot](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/mmoitems-premium.39267)) although it is not a dependency. MMOCore features a lot of compatibility options for MMOItems, here is the detailed list.
zh: MMOCore构建为与MMOItems([Polymart](https://polymart.org/product/3413/mmoitems)/ [Spigot](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/mmoitems-premium.39267)) 一起使用，尽管它不是依赖项。MMOCore为MMOItems提供了很多兼容性选项，这里是详细列表。

source: Extra MMOItems Stats
zh: 额外MMOItems属性

source: When using both MMOCore and MMOItems, extra item stats will automatically enable and will be added to the MMOItems item edition GUI.
zh: 当同时使用MMOCore和MMOItems时，额外的物品属性将自动启用，并将添加到MMOItems物品版本GUI中。

source: | Stat | Description |
zh: |属性|描述 |

source: | Max Mana | Default stat, but it does support MMOCore |
zh: |最大魔力|默认属性，但它确实支持MMOCore|

source: | Max Stamina | Gives extra MMOCore stamina. |
zh: |最大耐力|额外提供MMOCore耐力。 |

source: | Max Stellium | Gives extra MMOCore stellium. |
zh: |最大星群 |提供额外的MMOCore群星。 |

source: | Resource* Regeneration | Increases flat resource* regen. |
zh: |资源* 再生 |增加固定资源*再生。 |

source: | Max Resource* Regeneration | Regens a % of max resource* every second. |
zh: |最大资源* 再生 |每秒重新生成最大资源* 的 %。 |

source: | Additional Experience | Increases exp earned. |
zh: |额外经验|增加获得的经验值。 |

source: | Skill Cooldown Reduction | Default stat, but it does support MMOCore |
zh: |技能冷却时间还原 |默认属性，但它确实支持MMOCore|

source: *Resource stands for either health, mana, stamina or stellium.
zh: *资源代表生命值、魔力、耐力或 stellium。

source: Quest Objectives & Triggers
zh: 任务目标和触发因素

source: MMOItems adds new quest [objectives](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/quests) to MMOCore quests, where players have to get an item and give it to a specific Citizen NPC. You can also setup quest [triggers](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/quests) which give an MMOItem when a specific quest objective is completed.
zh: MMOItems在MMOCore任务中添加了新任务 [目标](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/quests)，其中玩家必须获得物品并将其交给特定的公民 NPC。你还可以设置任务[触发](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/quests)，当完成特定任务目标时会给出 MMOItem。

source: MMOCore Drop Tables
zh: MMOCore掉落表

source: You may add items from MI to MMOCore [drop tables](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/drop-tables).
zh: 你可以将物品从 MI 添加到MMOCore[删除表](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/drop-tables)。

source: Item Restrictions, Mana
zh: 物品限制，魔力

source: MMOItems features item restrictions, including level and class restrictions which **do work** with MMOCore. MMOItems ability and wand weapons may also use mana or stamina/stellium which is also supported by MMOCore.
zh: MMOItems 的物品等级限制和职业限制**都支持** MMOCore。MMOItems 的技能和魔杖类武器还可以消耗魔力或耐力/stellium，这些资源也受 MMOCore 支持。

source: Extra features for MMOItems Crafting
zh: MMOItemsCrafting 的额外功能

source: In MMOItems, some recipes have specific conditions which must be met for the player to be able to use the crafting recipe. MMOCore adds profession level crafting restrictions i.e players must be at least Lvl X in some profession like smithing or mining, in order to use the recipes. More info on MMOItems recipe conditions [in the MMOItems wiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/conditions).
zh: 在MMOItems中，一些配方具有特定条件，玩家必须满足这些条件才能使用合成配方。MMOCore添加了副职业等级制作限制i.e玩家在某些副职业中必须至少达到 Lvl X，例如锻造或采矿，才能使用配方。有关MMOItems配方条件的更多信息 [在MMOItemswiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/conditions)中。

source: **Recipe example**, where the player must be at least Lvl 5 in *Smithing*.
zh: **配方示例**，其中 *Smithing* 中的玩家必须至少达到 Lvl5。

source: MMOCore also adds a new type of crafting trigger (actions made when a recipe is used), which can be used to give experience to a player (either main experience, or experience in a specific profession). More information on MMOItems recipe triggers [in the MMOItems wiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/triggers).
zh: MMOCore还添加了一种新型的制作触发器（使用配方时执行的操作），可用于将经验赋予玩家（主要经验或特定副职业中的经验）。有关MMOItems配方触发器的更多信息 [在MMOItemswiki](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/stations/triggers)中。

source: **Same example**, which grants 10 Smithing EXP when used
zh: **相同的示例**，使用时授予10Smithing EXP

source: 🧌 MythicMobs
zh: 🧌MythicMobs

source: Most of our mob features and custom drops tie into MythicMobs, the best mob creation plugin. Also **one of the most important features**, in order to create your own skills through MMOCore, you will utilize MythicMobs to make any skill you want. More info [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#custom-skills).
zh: 我们的大多数生物功能和自定义滴都与MythicMobs相关，这是最好的生物创建插件。另外**最重要的功能之一**，为了通过MMOCore创建你自己的技能，你将利用MythicMobs来制作你想要的任何技能。更多信息[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#custom-skills)。

source: MythicMobs also adds more options to the quest system: you can setup quests where players must kill X mobs from MythicMobs, more info [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/quests).
zh: MythicMobs还为任务系统添加了更多选项：你可以设置任务，其中玩家必须杀死MythicMobs中的 X 个小怪，更多信息[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/quests)。

source: Players may also earn main-class experience when killing mobs from MythicMobs, more info on that [wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/intro).
zh: 击杀 MythicMobs 的生物时，玩家也可以获得主职业经验，详见[此页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/intro)。

source: MythicMobs drop items
zh: MythicMobs下降物品

source: MMOCore adds new drop item types to MythicMobs drop tables, here is the list:
zh: MMOCore在MythicMobs掉落表中添加了新的掉落物品类型，列表如下：

source: | Drop Item | Usage | Description |
zh: |掉落物品|用途 |描述 |

zh: |金袋|`gold_pouch{min=10;max=100}`|金袋内含 MIN 和 MAX 之间随机数量的 $$ |

source: | Gold Coin | `gold_coin{}` | Drops a gold coin worth $1 |
zh: |金币|`gold_coin{}`|掉落一枚价值 $1的金币 |

source: Gold Pouches
zh: 金袋

source: Gold pouches are leather pieces you can right click in order to open a 2-rows GUI which contains randomly generated gold coins and notes. Players cannot place any item in there, they may only take items from it if they have some space left in their inventory. Pouches **are taken off the player inventory** when fully emptied.
zh: 金袋是皮革件，你可以右键单击以打开2行GUI，其中包含随机生成的金币和纸币。玩家不能在那里放置任何物品，如果他们的物品栏中还有一些空间，他们只能从中取出物品。袋子**在完全清空后从玩家物品栏** 上取下。

source: ![pp](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/gold_pouch.BYKMWIZW.gif)
zh: ![pp](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/gold_pouch.BYKMWIZW.gif)

source: 🔌 Other Plugins
zh: 🔌 其他插件

source: MMOCore only has MythicLib as hard dependency, but all of our soft dependencies are highly recommended for the RPG best experience.
zh: MMOCore仅具有MythicLib作为硬依赖项，但强烈建议使用我们所有的软依赖项以获得RPG最佳体验。

source: This plugin is meant to go hand in hand with MMOCore. MMOItems provides item level & class restrictions, Item Stats, Quest Objectives, Triggers, Drop Table Items, and tons of other stuff. MMOItems is the only plugin which has built-in support, and it can't be beat! You do not need to install any compatibility addon, all the following features are automatically setup when the plugins detect each other. More info on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/compatibility/mmoitems).
zh: MMOItems 与 MMOCore 配套使用，提供物品等级与职业限制、物品属性、任务目标、触发器、掉落表物品等功能。MMOItems 是唯一获得内置支持的物品插件。无需安装兼容附加插件；两者检测到彼此后，以下功能会自动配置。详见[此页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/compatibility/mmoitems)。

source: MythicMobs
zh: MythicMobs

source: MythicMobs adds new quest objectives and allows you to create an infinite amount of skills for MMOCore. Moreover, MMOCore adds new drop table items to MythicMobs. More info on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/compatibility/mythic).
zh: MythicMobs添加了新的任务目标，并允许你为MMOCore创建无限数量的技能。此外，MMOCore在MythicMobs的基础上添加了新的掉落表物品。更多信息请参见[此维基页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/compatibility/mythic)。

source: Fabled, ProSkillAPI, SkillAPI

source: Since MythicLib 1.3 you can also register custom skills in MythicLib, MMOCore and MMOItems using the Fabled skill creation system. More info on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/fabled).
zh: 由于MythicLib1.3你还可以使用Fabled技能创建系统在MythicLib、MMOCore和MMOItems中注册自定义技能。更多信息请参见[此维基页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/fabled)。

source: 💪 Attributes
zh: 💪基础属性

source: Attributes are super classic RPG "stats" which players can level up to unlock new perks. These perks includes additional stats (max health, damage, cooldown reduction...) and the ability to use certain items. This very classic RPG feature adds more theory crafting material to your server.
zh: 基础属性是超级经典的RPG“属性”，其中玩家可以与等级一起解锁新的福利。这些福利包括额外的属性（最大生命值、伤害、冷却时间减少...）以及使用某些物品的能力。这个非常经典的RPG功能为你的服务器添加了更多理论制作材料。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/attribute_ui.wIHIIgQM.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/attribute_ui.wIHIIgQM.gif)

source: MMOCore’s attributes are fully integrated with **MMOItems**, allowing you to set **attribute requirements** for items. This means you can configure an MMOItem so that a player can only equip or use it if they have at least a certain number of points in a specific MMOCore attribute. For example, you could make a legendary sword require **15 Strength** before it can be wielded, or a mystical staff require **20 Intelligence** before it can be used. This creates a natural progression system where players need to invest in the right attributes to unlock access to more powerful gear.
zh: MMOCore的基础属性与 **MMOItems** 完全集成，允许你为物品设置**基础属性要求**。这意味着你可以配置 MMOItem，以便玩家仅在特定MMOCore基础属性中至少具有一定数量的点时才能装备或使用它。例如，你可以制作一把传奇剑，需要 **15力量** 才能使用，或者神秘法杖需要 **20智力** 才能使用。这创建了一个自然的进展系统，其中玩家需要投资正确的基础属性来解锁更强大的装备。

source: **Attributes can also grant fully custom perks** — for example, they can run commands, send messages, or unlock skills when leveled up. Using PAPI placeholders you can also get the current value of a player's attribute and use these values inside custom conditions anywhere you need them (MythicMobs skills, MythicLibs scripts....).
zh: **基础属性还可以授予完全自定义的特权** - 例如，他们可以在升级时运行命令、发送消息或解锁技能。使用 PAPI占位符你还可以获得玩家的基础属性的当前值，并在任何需要的自定义条件中使用这些值（MythicMobs技能、MythicLibs 脚本......）。

source: Attribute Menu
zh: 基础属性菜单

source: Use `/attributes` to open up the attribute menu. Players can see the current value of their stats, spend points to level up their attributes, or reallocate their attribute points (also referred to as *respec*).
zh: 使用`/attributes`打开基础属性菜单。玩家可以查看其属性的当前值，将积分花费到基础属性的等级上，或重新分配其基础属性点（也称为 *respec*）。

source: You will need one *attribute point* to level up once one single attribute.
zh: 需要一个 *基础属性点* 到等级最多一次基础属性。

source: To reallocate your attribute points, click the *Reallocate Skill Points* button. You will need one *attribute reallocation point*, that you can give to players using an [admin command](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/commands).
zh: 要重新分配你的基础属性点，请单击*重新分配技能积分*按钮。需要一个 *基础属性重新分配点*，你可以使用 [管理命令](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/commands)] 将其提供给玩家。

source: Default Attributes & Ideas
zh: 默认基础属性& 想法

source: This section covers the attributes that are provided in the default MMOCore attributes configuration file. You are encouraged to edit and balance them to your liking, as this should serve as a reference/inspiration for you. The default MMOCore attributes are Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence which are inspired from the game *Path of exile*.
zh: 本节介绍默认MMOCore基础属性配置文件中提供的基础属性。我们鼓励你根据自己的喜好编辑和平衡它们，因为这应该作为你的参考/灵感。默认的MMOCore基础属性分别是力量、敏捷和智力，灵感来自游戏*流放之路*。

source: The **Strength** attribute is meant to be leveled up by warriors, tanks, paladins as it grants both additional **weapon damage** and **maximum health** for extra tankiness and survivability.
zh: **力量**基础属性旨在由战士、坦克、圣骑士升级，因为它提供额外的 **武器伤害** 和 **最大生命值** 额外的坦克性和生存能力。

source: Warriors, rogues or marksmen may focus on leveling up their **dexterity** because it increases their movement speed (either to escape for lighter classes like rogues or marksmen, or to run in the fight for warriors), their **projectile damage** for marksmen and their **physical damage** (both physical skills and weapons).
zh: 战士、盗贼或射手可能会专注于升级来提高他们的**敏捷度**，因为它会提高他们的移动速度（要么为盗贼或射手等较轻的职业逃跑，要么为战士奔跑）、射手的**射弹伤害**以及他们的**物理伤害**（物理技能和武器）。

source: **Intelligence** is mainly for wizards, mages as it increases damage dealt by magical skills. It also reduces cooldowns of skills, which could justify spending some points in this attribute even for non-skill oriented classes.
zh: **智力**主要针对法师、法师，因为它会增加魔法技能造成的伤害。它还减少了技能的冷却时间，这可以证明在该基础属性上花费一些点是合理的，即使对于面向非技能的职业也是如此。

source: As a reference, *The Elder Scrolls Online* has three "attributes" which are *Health*, *Stamina* and *Magicka*. Health increases maximum health, Stamina increases max stamina (used to cast stamina-based skills), while Magicka is the equivalent of mana (used to cast magicka-based skills). Depending on the class chosen, you want to focus either on Health (tank classes or bruiser fighters, heavy armor), Stamina (medium/light armor, DPS classes) and Magicka (DPS classes, medium/light armor, burst magic damage).
zh: 作为参考，*上古卷轴 Online* 有三个“基础属性”，分别是 *生命值*、*耐力* 和 *Magicka*。生命值增加最大生命值，耐力增加最大耐力（用于施放以耐力为资源的技能），而 Magicka 相当于魔力（用于施放以魔法为资源的技能）。根据所选的职业，你需要关注生命值（坦克职业或猛男战士，重型护甲）、耐力（中/轻型护甲、DPS职业）和 Magicka（DPS职业，中/轻度护甲，爆发魔法伤害）。

source: Default Config File
zh: 默认配置文件

source: The default config file is named `default_attributes.yml` and is located in the folder `MMOCore/attributes`. You can add as many YAML config files and subfolders as you like inside the main attribute folder for clean file organization.
zh: 默认配置文件名为`default_attributes.yml`，位于文件夹`MMOCore/attributes`中。你可以在主基础属性文件夹中添加任意数量的YAML配置文件和子文件夹，以实现干净的文件组织。

source: Every config section corresponds to a player attribute. Remember, you can add as many as you want (one config section per attribute), and you may also remove the default ones.
zh: 每个配置部分对应一个玩家基础属性。请记住，你可以添加任意数量的内容（每个基础属性一个配置部分），并且你也可以删除默认的部分。

source: You need to specify the attribute name which will be used to display the attributes inside GUIs, the maximum amount of **attribute points** you can spend in that specific attribute, and the stat buffs the attribute gives. These buffs correspond to the stats given to the player for **every attribute point spent in that attribute.**
zh: 你需要指定基础属性名称，该名称将用于在 GUI 内显示基础属性、你可以在该特定基础属性中花费的最大金额 **基础属性点** 以及基础属性给出的属性增益效果。这些增益效果对应于 **在该基础属性中花费的每个基础属性点给予玩家的属性。**

source: **Virtual Attributes (that don't save to player data)**
zh: **虚拟基础属性（不保存到玩家数据）**

source: There is one last use case for attributes. You might want to create attributes that reproduce 1-to-1 an existing stat. In the following example, every *Health* attribute point grants 1% of maximum health is provided to the player. If you do not want the attribute to be leveled up by the player and only use the stat buff feature, you can toggle off the `save-to-player-data` option. This is purely optional and reduces database clutter.
zh: 基础属性还有最后一个用例。你可能想要创建基础属性来重现1-to-1现有的属性。在以下示例中，每个 *生命值*基础属性点授予1%或最大生命值提供给玩家。如果你不希望基础属性通过玩家升级而仅使用属性增益效果功能，则可以关闭`save-to-player-data`选项。这纯粹是可选的，可以减少数据库混乱。

source: **Disabling attributes**
zh: **禁用基础属性**

source: If you do not plan on using the MMOCore attribute system, you can disable it, and it's super easy to do so.
zh: 如果你不打算使用MMOCore基础属性系统，你可以禁用它，而且非常简单。

source: Empty the `MMOCore/attributes` folder (don't delete it, or it will regenerate)
zh: 清空`MMOCore/attributes`文件夹（不要删除，否则会重新生成）

source: Comment out/delete the `/attributes` command inside the `commands.yml` file
zh: 注释掉/删除`commands.yml`文件内的`/attributes`命令

source: Editing the Attributes GUI
zh: 编辑基础属性GUI

source: The `/attributes` folder is for defining the attributes and their buffs. However, you also need to edit the `/gui/attribute-view.yml` config file to make sure players can see and interact with the attributes you have defined in the previous config file.
zh: `/attributes`文件夹用于定义基础属性及其增益效果。但是，你还需要编辑`/gui/attribute-view.yml`配置文件，以确保玩家可以看到你在之前的配置文件中定义的基础属性并与之交互。

source: > We recommend opening this file with a text editor on the side while reading the rest of this section.
zh: > 我们建议在阅读本节其余部分时使用侧面的文本编辑器打开此文件。

source: First, please refer to this [wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/misc/ui-syntax) to learn about the general MMOCore UI syntax.
zh: 首先，请参考这个[wiki页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/misc/ui-syntax)来了解一般的MMOCoreUI语法。

source: Under the `items` config section, there should be one config section per attribute. By default, their names are `dex`, `str` and `int` for *Dexterity*, *Strength* and *Intelligence* respectively. Each correspond to the clickable items inside the GUI, as seen on the GIF above.
zh: 在`items`配置部分下，每个基础属性应该有一个配置部分。默认情况下，它们的名称分别为`dex`、`str`和`int`，分别代表*敏捷*、*力量*和*智力*。每个都对应于GUI内的可点击物品，如上面的 GIF 所示。

source: Adding a new attribute
zh: 添加新的基础属性

source: In order to add a new attribute:
zh: 要添加新的基础属性：

source: Add a new config section in of the config files inside the `/attributes` folder as described in the previous sections,
zh: 如前面部分所述，在`/attributes`文件夹内的配置文件中添加新的配置部分，

source: Add a new config section in the `attribute-view.yml` GUI config, and make sure to set the item function to `attribute_<attribute_id>` (for instance, `attribute_vigour` for an attribute with id `vigour`) so that MMOCore can apply the correct placeholders in the item lore and make the item behave correctly when clicked.
zh: 在`attribute-view.yml`GUI配置中添加新的配置部分，并确保将物品函数设置为`attribute_<attribute_id>`（例如，`attribute_vigour`对于 ID 为`vigour`的基础属性），以便MMOCore可以应用正确的占位符中的物品描述并使物品在单击时行为正确。

source: > **WARNING**
> If you forget the second step, your attribute will exist but players won't be able to see, or interact with it in the attribute menu.
zh: > 如果你忘记了第二步，你的基础属性将存在，但玩家将无法在基础属性菜单中看到或与其交互。

source: Adding a buff to an attribute
zh: 将增益效果添加到基础属性

source: In order to add a buff to an existing attribute:
zh: 要将增益效果添加到现有的基础属性中：

source: Add the buff to the attribute config section in the `/attributes` folder,
zh: 将增益效果添加到`/attributes`文件夹中的基础属性config 部分，

source: Optionally, update the lore of the item corresponding to that attribute in the `attribute-view.yml` file to display the new buff. If you don't do that, players will get the buff but won't be aware of it. You can somehow display it elsewhere, but most users would want to display it here.
zh: （可选）更新`attribute-view.yml`文件中与基础属性对应的物品的描述以显示新的增益效果。如果你不这样做，玩家将获得增益效果但不会意识到这一点。你可以以某种方式将其显示在其他地方，但大多数用户希望将其显示在此处。

source: 🧙‍♂️ Classes
Due to popular demand, one of MMOCore's trademark features is its customizable class system! This paragraph goes over the important features of classes as well as how to configure them.
zh: 自定义职业系统是 MMOCore 应玩家需求加入的主要功能之一。这里介绍职业的主要功能及配置方法。

source: Our class system aims to provide a completely user determined class creation system that looks good and works well. We have picked up where other plugins have been abandoned!
zh: 职业系统的目标是让服主自行创建外观和功能都符合需求的职业，并继续完善其他同类插件停止维护后留下的功能。

source: Choosing a class
zh: 选择职业

source: Use the `/class` command to open up the class selection menu.
zh: 使用`/class`命令打开职业选择菜单。

source: ![Profess Menu](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/class_select.BewFLyl3.gif)
zh: ![专业菜单](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/class_select.BewFLyl3.gif)

source: Class Points
zh: 职业点数

source: In order to pick a new class, or switch between classes, players need a skill point. You can get these via an admin command. With this versatile command, server admins can hand out class points however they want, either when leveling up or using a special item with a command bound onto it.
zh: 选择新职业或切换职业需要一个技能点，可以通过管理员命令获得。服主可以自行决定何时发放职业点数，例如玩家升级时，或使用绑定了命令的特殊物品时。

source: ![Class Points](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/class_pts.DDGqB46e.png)
zh: ![职业积分](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/class_pts.DDGqB46e.png)

source: Default Class
zh: 默认职业

source: When logging in for the first time, players start with the dummy *Human* class. They are able to gain experience and level up this class, but it should only be a temporary class as it has no skill and lower stats. As soon as they get their first class point, they should switch to another class! The default classes are Mage, Marksman, Paladin, Rogue and Warrior.
zh: 玩家首次登录时，默认使用临时的 *Human* 职业。这个职业可以获取经验并升级，但没有技能，属性也较低，因此只适合作为过渡。获得第一个职业点数后，就应该切换到其他职业。默认提供 Mage、Marksman、Paladin、Rogue 和 Warrior。

source: If you do not plan on using the MMOCore class system, you can remove all classes but the *Human* class. MMOCore needs at least one class. If there is only one class, players won't be able to switch classes.
zh: 如果不打算使用 MMOCore 的职业系统，可以删除 *Human* 以外的所有职业。MMOCore 至少需要保留一个职业；只剩一个职业时，玩家就无法切换职业。

source: Class Configuration Overview
zh: 职业配置概述

source: Each class is divided into its own class config file. You may create as many classes as you want, and you may modify/remove the default classes, as long as there is at least one class. Creating new classes is as simple as copying the format from the default folders and giving it your own creative ideas.
zh: 每个职业使用独立的配置文件。可以创建任意数量的职业，也可以修改或删除默认职业，但至少要保留一个。创建新职业时，复制默认配置的格式，再按自己的设想修改即可。

source: > In order to create a new class, copy and paste the *Mage* class config file. This is a simple class template which already has most of the features explicitly written in its config file. This will give you a decent base to start with.
zh: > 创建新职业时，可以复制 *Mage* 的职业配置文件。这个模板比较简单，而且大多数功能都已明确写在配置中，适合作为起点。

source: The following sections will guide through class configuration - choose a class config file, open it and explore it along with the wiki.
zh: 接下来介绍职业配置。选一个职业配置文件并打开，对照下文查看各项设置。

source: Display Options
zh: 显示选项

source: These are the first options you will see when opening class config files. These display options let you determine how your class looks in the class menu.
zh: 打开职业配置文件后，首先会看到显示选项，用于设置该职业在职业菜单中的外观。

source: The `name` option corresponds to the class name, used in placeholders and info GUIs. The `lore` and `attribute-lore` options correspond to the class description displayed when a player selects his class using /class.
zh: `name` 是职业名称，用于占位符和信息界面。`lore` 与 `attribute-lore` 是玩家通过 /class 选择职业时显示的职业描述。

source: > Editing the class lore does NOT actually edit those attributes, it is visual-only!
zh: > 修改职业描述**不会**修改实际属性，这些设置只影响显示内容！

source: The `item` option corresponds to the icon displayed in the same GUI. You may use custom model data to change the class icon using the following format:
zh: `item` 是同一界面中显示的图标。可以使用自定义模型数据修改职业图标，格式如下：

source: The following syntax is also valid.
zh: 以下写法也有效。

source: Maximum Level
zh: 最高等级

source: This option sets the maximum level reachable in this class. Once reached, players can no longer level up.
zh: 此选项设置该职业能达到的最高等级。达到上限后，玩家无法继续升级。

source: Experience Curve
zh: 经验曲线

source: Experiences curves define how much experience players in this class need in order to level up. Please read [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/curves) to learn how to setup experience curves.
zh: 经验曲线决定该职业每次升级需要多少经验。配置方法见[此页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/curves)。

source: Every class has exactly one experience curve. In every class config, the `exp-curve` field must match the ID of an existing experience curve.
zh: 每个职业只能使用一条经验曲线。职业配置中的 `exp-curve` 必须与一条现有经验曲线的 ID 一致。

source: Experience Tables
zh: 经验表

source: Experience tables define what happens when players level up their main class: do they get stats, obtain skill points, attribute points, skill tree points? Do they unlock new skills or new waypoints?
zh: 经验表定义玩家主职业升级时发生的事情：获得属性、技能点、基础属性点或技能树点数，还是解锁新技能、新传送点？

source: > [Experience curves](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes#experience-curve) decide **when** players level up, experience tables decide **what happens**.
zh: > [经验曲线](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes#experience-curve)决定**何时升级**，经验表决定**升级后发生什么**。

source: Just like professions, classes have exactly one experience table. The field `exp-table` field must match the ID of an existing experience table. Please read [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/tables) to learn how to setup experience tables.
zh: 与副职业相同，每个职业只能使用一张经验表。`exp-table` 必须与一张现有经验表的 ID 一致。配置方法见[此页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/tables)。

source: Additional Options
zh: 附加选项

source: These are very diverse yet important class options.
zh: 以下职业选项用途各不相同，但都很重要。

source: | Option | Description | Default |
zh: |选项 |描述 |默认 |

source: | default | The class that a new player will spawn in with | false |
zh: | default | 新玩家初始使用的职业 | false |

source: | display | Whether or not the class should display in /class | true |
zh: | display | 是否在 /class 中显示此职业 | true |

source: | off-combat--regen | Resource regen only applies when out of combat | false |
zh: | off-combat--regen | 是否仅在脱离战斗时恢复资源值 | false |

source: | needs-permission | The class needs the permission `mmocore.class.<class_id>` to be unlocked | false |
zh: | needs-permission | 解锁此职业需要 `mmocore.class.<class_id>` 权限 | false |

source: Class Stats
zh: 职业属性

source: Class stats are the statistics given to the player when they level up. It's one of the most essential features for RPG servers.
zh: 职业属性是玩家升级时获得的属性，是 RPG 服务器的主要功能之一。

source: Every stat scales with the player's class level. Given the player's level, the stat formula is the following:
zh: 各项属性会随职业等级变化。根据玩家等级，属性的计算公式如下：

source: > When not specified in the class config, MMOCore fallbacks to the stat values provided in `MMOCore/stats.yml`, then `MythicLib/stats.yml`.
zh: > 如果职业配置中没有指定数值，MMOCore 会先使用 `MMOCore/stats.yml` 中的值，再使用 `MythicLib/stats.yml` 中的值。

source: You may also add min/max bounds to balance stats that are too overpowered.
zh: 还可以设置最小值和最大值，限制过强的属性。

source: You can also use complex math formulas, instead of the linear formula presented above, using the following syntax. This supports PlaceholderAPI as well as the `{level}` placeholder.
zh: 除了上面的线性公式，还可以按以下语法使用复杂数学公式。支持 PlaceholderAPI 和 `{level}` 占位符。

source: Mana Display Options
zh: 魔力显示选项

source: Every class can have a different mana bar (mana for mages, rage for warriors...). The `char` option corresponds to the character which will be used to display the player's mana bar inside a chat message. The `color` config section corresponds to the color being used to generate that bar. The `icon` option corresponds to the mana icon displayed on the player action bar.
zh: 每个职业都可以使用不同的魔力条，例如法师显示魔力、战士显示怒气。`char` 是聊天消息中用来组成魔力条的字符，`color` 配置节设置魔力条的颜色，`icon` 则是动作栏上显示的魔力图标。

source: Subclasses
zh: 进阶职业

source: Subclasses are classes which are available only when players reach a certain level. This is a way to make your class architecture more diverse by adding multiple new paths and playstyles.
zh: 进阶职业只有在玩家达到指定等级后才可选择，可以为现有职业增加不同的发展路线和玩法。

source: Simply give the class ID and the level at which the subclass should be unlocked. When a player has a subclass available, a slightly different menu will pop up when using `/classes`. Nothing else differs for a subclass. Display, attributes, skills, etc are all setup the same. That obviously means you will need to create a separate config file for your subclass and put its reference in that `subclasses` section.
zh: 只需填写职业 ID 和进阶职业的解锁等级。玩家有可选的进阶职业时，执行 `/classes` 会打开略有不同的菜单。除此之外，进阶职业的显示、基础属性和技能等配置方式都相同。需要为进阶职业单独创建配置文件，再将其引用填入 `subclasses` 配置节。

source: Since you most likely want your players to access these subclasses only by leveling previous (sub)classes, you will most likely use the `display: false` class option (see above) so that your subclass does not display in the class list when using `/classes`.
zh: 如果希望玩家必须先提升前置职业或进阶职业的等级，才可选择后续进阶职业，可以使用上面的 `display: false` 选项，避免它直接出现在 `/classes` 的职业列表中。

source: Skills
zh: 技能

source: Each class has its own set of skills. Learn more about class skills on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/config).
zh: 每个职业有各自的技能，详见[此页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/config)。

source: Skill Slots
zh: 技能槽位

source: Each class has its own set of skill slots. Learn more about skill slots on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots).
zh: 每个职业有各自的技能槽位，详见[此页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots)。

source: Linking a skill tree to a class
zh: 为职业关联技能树

source: Skill trees are class-based, which means that the [skill trees](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/skill-trees) that you have access to depend on your class. You can link skill trees to a class using the following syntax:
zh: 玩家可使用哪些[技能树](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/skill-trees)，取决于当前职业。按以下语法即可为职业关联技能树：

source: Casting Mode Particles
zh: 施放模式粒子

source: This option determines the particles displayed when the player is in [casting mode](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting). At the moment, the particle effect pattern cannot be edited (elegant particle helix rotating around the player): you can only change the particle used to draw that helix.
zh: 此选项设置玩家处于[施法模式](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting)时显示的粒子。目前无法修改粒子轨迹，即围绕玩家旋转的螺旋形状；只能更换用于绘制轨迹的粒子。

source: Some particles require a color to be displayed, like the Redstone particle which is named `DUST` in Minecraft 1.21. The following format will let you modify the particle color.
zh: 部分粒子需要指定颜色，例如 Minecraft 1.21 中名为 `DUST` 的红石粒子。可以按以下格式设置颜色。

source: Some particles require you to provide a block, which you can do using the following format. Some examples include `BLOCK`, `FALLING_DUST` and `DUST_PILLAR` in 1.21.
zh: 部分粒子需要指定方块，例如 1.21 中的 `BLOCK`、`FALLING_DUST` 和 `DUST_PILLAR`。格式如下：

source: > You can disable casting mode particles by deleting or commenting out the `cast-particle` section.
zh: > 删除或注释 `cast-particle` 配置节，可以关闭施法模式粒子。

source: Class Scripts
zh: 职业脚本

source: You can define scripts which will apply to players with the corresponding class. These scripts can be used to code complex custom skill behaviours, class passive skills, or literally anything.
zh: 可以为使用特定职业的玩家定义脚本，用于实现复杂的自定义技能行为、职业被动技能或其他功能。

source: Just like skills, class scripts have a trigger associated with them, determining when this script will activate. You can find the list of all available trigger types on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers). You can also learn how to write MMOLib custom scripts on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/intro).
zh: 与技能相同，职业脚本也有关联的触发器，决定脚本何时运行。可用触发器类型见[此页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers)；MMOLib 自定义脚本的编写方法见[此页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/intro)。

source: Here is an example of a script for the *Warrior* class, that converts 10% of physical damage dealt into Rage points, up to a maximum of 10 Rage pts simultaneously.
zh: 下面是 *Warrior* 职业的脚本示例：将造成的物理伤害的 10% 转为怒气点，每次最多转化 10 点怒气。

source: The following format also works, as long as the script named `some_script_id` has already been defined somewhere else.
zh: 如果名为 `some_script_id` 的脚本已在其他位置定义，也可以使用以下格式。

source: Disabling MMOCore classes
zh: 关闭 MMOCore 职业系统

source: In some cases you might want to fully disable classes and/or leveling within MMOCore. This is rather simple to do:
zh: 如果想在 MMOCore 中完全关闭职业、升级，或同时关闭两者，可以按以下方式设置：

source: Delete the content of the `/class` folder (do not delete the whole folder, as it will regenerate). This has the effect of disabling classes and leveling all together.
zh: 清空 `/class` 文件夹中的内容，但保留文件夹本身，否则它会自动重新生成。这样会同时关闭职业和升级功能。

source: Inside the `commands.yml` config file, remove the `/class` and `/skills` command.
zh: 在`commands.yml`配置文件中，删除`/class`和`/skills`命令。

source: Edit the `/gui/player-stats.yml` UI so that it does not display class information anymore.
zh: 编辑`/gui/player-stats.yml`UI，使其不再显示职业信息。

source: If you would like to keep classes but disable leveling, remove all references to exp tables from within the `/class` and/or `/profession` folders. Classes and/or professions will be stuck to level 1. Don't forget to also edit the `/gui/player-stats.yml` UI so that it does not display information about leveling anymore.
zh: 如果你想保留职业但禁用升级，请从`/class`和/或`/profession`文件夹中删除对经验表的所有引用。职业和/或副职业将被粘到等级1。不要忘记还编辑`/gui/player-stats.yml`UI，以便它不再显示有关升级的信息。

source: ⚔️ Combat
zh: ⚔️战斗

source: Combat Logging
zh: 战斗记录

source: Combat logging is a useful feature that lets players know when they enter or quit combat. Combat log is handled via chat messages. It is a very simple feature in itself, but **it ties in so nicely with other mechanics like skills**.
zh: 战斗记录是一项有用的功能，可以让玩家知道他们何时进入或退出战斗。战斗日志通过聊天消息处理。它本身是一个非常简单的功能，但**它与技能** 等其他机制紧密结合。

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/combat_enter.DrFTWXNH.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/combat_enter.DrFTWXNH.png)

source: For instance, there is a built-in MMOCore skill that makes players deal increased melee damage when entering combat. Using the `%mmocore_since_enter_combat%` placeholder, you could also imagine a skill that increases damage dealt based on how long the player has been in combat.
zh: 例如，built-inMMOCore技能可以使玩家在进入战斗时造成更高的近战伤害。使用`%mmocore_since_enter_combat%`占位符，你还可以想象技能根据玩家的战斗时间来增加造成的伤害。

source: Resource Regeneration
zh: 资源再生

source: Combat log also dictates when the player should be able to regen their [resources](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/resources) (health, mana and stamina).
zh: 战斗日志还规定了玩家何时应该能够重新生成其[资源](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/resources)（生命值、魔力和耐力）。

source: For instance, you can set up a *Warrior* class with a base flat health regeneration rate, and with an additional 10% missing health regeneration per second **when out of combat**. This can be applied to any class, any resource, the off combat option can be disabled, the % can scale on the player's level, and you can make it so the regenerated amount also scales on the player's **missing** health instead.
zh: 例如，可以让*战士*职业按固定数值恢复生命值，并在**脱离战斗时**，每秒额外恢复相当于已损失生命值 10% 的生命值。此功能适用于任意职业和资源；可以关闭脱战限制，让百分比随玩家等级变化，也可以让恢复量根据玩家**已损失的**生命值计算。

source: Placeholders
zh: 占位符

source: MMOCore features multiple [PlaceholderAPI placeholders](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/placeholders#combat) that you can use to check if a player is in combat, in [PvP Mode](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/combat#pvp-mode), the time since last hit, combat time so far...
zh: MMOCore具有多个 [PlaceholderAPI占位符](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/placeholders#combat)，你可以使用它们来检查玩家是否处于战斗中，在 [PvP模式](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/combat#pvp-mode)，自上次击中以来的时间，到目前为止的战斗时间...

source: Friendly Fire
zh: 友军火力

source: Everyone knows the concept of friendly fire: the ability to accidentally or intentionally harm allies with attacks. In MMOCore, this concept is extended to all player interactions, not just damaging skills.
zh: 每个人都知道友军火力的概念：通过攻击意外或故意伤害盟友的能力。在MMOCore中，这个概念扩展到所有玩家交互，而不仅仅是破坏技能。

source: These rules are referred to as "interaction rules". They define when and how a player can "interact" with another player, whether through a skill or a weapon attack. For example, you might want to prevent players from using damaging skills on members of the same guild, faction, or party, while still allowing them to cast healing or buffing skills on each other. Simply disabling all skills would not work, since support skills are also essential.
zh: 这些规则被称为“交互规则”。它们定义了玩家何时以及如何与另一个玩家“交互”，无论是通过技能还是武器攻击。例如，你可能希望阻止玩家对同一公会、派系或队伍的成员使用伤害性的技能，同时仍允许他们互相施放治疗或增强技能。简单地禁用所有技能是行不通的，因为支持技能也很重要。

source: > In short, interaction rules in MMOCore define *Friendly Fire* for any skill or attack, for offense or support.
zh: > 简而言之，MMOCore中的交互规则为任何技能或攻击、进攻或支持定义了“友军火力”。

source: Let's observe the following config syntax snippet, which you will find at the bottom of `MythicLib/config.yml`.
zh: 让我们观察以下配置语法片段，你可以在`MythicLib/config.yml`的底部找到它。

source: Set `enabled` to `true` to enable PvE/PvP interaction checks. The most important config sections are `rules.offense` and `rules.support`. Here are some examples:
zh: 将`enabled`设置为`true`以启用PvE/PvP交互检查。最重要的配置部分是`rules.offense`和`rules.support`。以下是一些示例：

source: Setting `offense.party_member` to `false` disables friendly fire for players within the same party
zh: 将`offense.party_member`设置为`false`会禁用同一队伍内玩家的友军火力

source: Setting `offense.guild_enemy` to `true` allows players from enemy guilds to fight each other. This option should be left to `true`, as it makes no sense to disable PvP in between enemy guilds.
zh: 将`offense.guild_enemy`设置为`true`可以让敌方公会的玩家互相战斗。该选项应该留给`true`，因为在敌方公会之间禁用PvP是没有意义的。

source: Setting `offense.self` to `false` prevents the player from casting damaging skills onto himself.
zh: 将`offense.self`设置为`false`可防止玩家对自身施放伤害性的技能。

source: Note that MythicLib takes into account the first/topmost rule that applies to the player. In other words, rules that appear first in the configuration are of higher priority. Let's look at an example to understand this priority feature:
zh: 请注意，MythicLib考虑了适用于玩家的第一个/最上面的规则。换句话说，配置中首先出现的规则具有更高的优先级。让我们看一个例子来理解这个优先级特性：

source: You have both a guild and party plugin installed.
zh: 你已经安装了公会和队伍插件。

source: Player A is in guild A and has no party.
zh: 玩家A 属于公会 A，没有队伍。

source: Player B is in guild B and has no party.
zh: 玩家B 属于公会 B，没有队伍。

source: Player tries to deal damage to player B. The guild plugin will flag players with relation `guild_ally` as they are in the same guild. The party plugin will flag them with relation `party_other` because the two players are not in the same party. In the config above, `guild_ally` appears first, in front of `party_other`, so `guild_ally` takes precedence: the result is `false` and player A is not allowed to damage player B.
zh: 玩家尝试对玩家B 造成伤害。公会插件将标记玩家与`guild_ally`的关系，因为它们在同一个公会中。队伍插件将用关系`party_other`标记它们，因为两个玩家不在同一个队伍中。在上面的配置中，`guild_ally`首先出现，在`party_other`前面，因此`guild_ally`优先：结果是`false`且玩家A 不允许损坏玩家B。

source: Instead of using true or false, you can also use placeholders. PAPI placeholders are supported, and will parse against the player performing the initial interaction (either the player dealing damage to their target, or the player trying to cast the support skill). `{flag_pvp}` returns `true` if WorldGuard allows PvP. `{world_pvp}` returns `true` if world PvP is enabled
zh: 除了使用true或false之外，你还可以使用占位符。 PAPI占位符受支持，并将针对执行初始交互的玩家进行解析（玩家对目标造成伤害，或者玩家尝试投射支持技能）。  如果WorldGuard允许PvP，则`{flag_pvp}`返回`true`。  如果世界PvP已启用，`{world_pvp}`返回`true`

source: > World PvP is defined by the `pvp` gamerule in 1.21.9+. In older versions of Bukkit, it is a server wide option under `settings.yml`.
zh: > 世界PvP由1.21.9+ 中的`pvp`游戏规则定义。在旧版本的Bukkit中，它是`settings.yml`下的服务器范围选项。

source: PvE
zh: PvE

source: These rules only apply to PvP. By default, MythicLib does not prevent the use of offense skills against mobs.
zh: 这些规则仅适用于PvP。默认情况下，MythicLib不会阻止对小怪使用攻击技能。

source: The `support_skills_on_mobs` option determines if players are allowed to cast support skills/heals/buffs onto monsters.
zh: `support_skills_on_mobs`选项决定是否允许玩家对怪物施放支持技能/治疗/增益。

source: Supported Plugins
zh: 支持的插件

source: To apply these friendly fire checks, MythicLib needs to communicate with your guild/party plugin. The list of supported party plugins can be found [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/parties). The list of supported guilds, factions, clans, kingdoms... plugins can be found [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/guilds).
zh: 要应用这些友方火力检查，MythicLib需要与你的公会/队伍插件进行通信。支持的队伍插件列表可以在 [此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/parties)] 找到。支持的公会、派系、氏族、王国...插件的列表可以在[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/guilds)] 找到。

source: Where do these rules apply?
zh: 这些规则适用于哪里？

source: These rules apply to:
zh: 这些规则适用于：

source: all PvP/PvE melee attacks,
zh: 所有PvP/PvE近战攻击，

source: damage dealt by vanilla projectiles,
zh: 原版射弹造成的伤害，

source: all skill damage dealt by MythicMobs custom skills,
zh: 所有由MythicMobs定制技能造成的技能伤害，

source: damage or buffs inflicted by [built-in MythicLib skills](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/builtin)...
zh: [built-inMythicLib技能](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/builtin)... 造成的伤害或增益 ...

source: Inside MythicMobs Skills
zh: 内部MythicMobs技能

source: You can check if a player can interact with a given entity, from inside a MythicMob custom skill, using the `mmoCanTarget` condition. Please refer to [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#checking-if-the-skill-caster-can-target-another-entity) for more information.
zh: 你可以使用`mmoCanTarget`条件从 MythicMob 自定义技能内部检查玩家是否可以与给定实体交互。请参阅[此维基页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#checking-if-the-skill-caster-can-target-another-entity)了解更多信息。

source: This condition has a very interesting side effect. Without this condition, offensive projectiles stop on the target entity, even if this entity cannot be damaged. The `damage` mechanic calls a Bukkit damage event, which MMOCore then cancels as it notices that the two players are in the same party/guild...
zh: 这种情况有一个非常有趣的副作用。如果没有这个条件，攻击性射弹就会停止在目标实体上，即使该实体无法被损坏。`damage`机械师调用了Bukkit伤害事件，然后MMOCore取消了该事件，因为它注意到两个玩家在同一政党/公会中......

source: Then, no damage is dealt, but MythicMobs still kills the projectile. Had the `mmoCanTarget` condition been used, the skill would have checked ahead of time that the entity was damageable, and the entity would have been ignored by the projectile.
zh: 然后，不会造成任何伤害，但MythicMobs仍然会杀死射弹。如果使用`mmoCanTarget`条件，技能将提前检查该实体是否可损坏，并且该实体将被射弹忽略。

source: PvP Mode
zh: PvP模式

source: This feature is specially designed for PvE-focused servers which still want to leave some options for players to fight. In specific WorldGuard regions where PvP is disabled by default, players can use `/pvpmode` to toggle on PvP back and fight other players! **Only players with PvP enabled can fight and attack each other.** Furthermore, this feature is fully compatible with the PvP interaction rules defined above.
zh: 此功能是专门为以PvE为主的服务器而设计的，这些服务器仍希望为玩家留下一些选择余地。在默认情况下禁用PvP的特定WorldGuard区域中，玩家可以使用`/pvpmode`来切换PvP并与其他玩家战斗！ **只有启用了PvP的玩家才能互相战斗和攻击。**此外，该功能完全兼容上面定义的PvP交互规则。

source: This works well for RPG or even profession/job-oriented survival servers.
zh: 这适用于RPG甚至副职业/job-oriented生存服务器。

source: > PvP Mode only works with WorldGuard! It won't work with other flag plugins like Residence.
zh: >PvP模式仅适用于WorldGuard！它无法与其他标志插件（例如 Residence）一起使用。

source: How to setup PvP Mode
zh: 如何设置PvP模式

source: first setup PvP interaction rules as explained above
zh: 首先设置PvP交互规则，如上所述

source: select an existing/create a new WorldGuard region
zh: 选择现有/创建新的WorldGuard区域

source: toggle **ON** server PvP, world PvP as well as the PvP flag
zh: 切换 **ON** 服务器PvP、世界PvP以及PvP标志

source: toggle on the `pvp-mode` WorldGuard flag. It is toggled off by default
zh: 打开`pvp-mode`WorldGuard标志。默认情况下它是关闭的

source: You are now good to go! When the `pvp-mode` flag is on, players have access to the `/pvpmode` command and MMOCore will take care of the rest.
zh: 现在就可以出发了！当`pvp-mode`标志打开时，玩家可以访问`/pvpmode`命令，而MMOCore将处理其余的事情。

source: In order to prevent abuse, you can configure PvP Mode so that players can't exit it while they are still in combat. Moreover, you can setup cooldowns for that command.
zh: 为了防止滥用，你可以配置PvP模式，使玩家在战斗时无法退出。此外，你可以为该命令设置冷却时间。

source: The following code snippet is located in the MMOCore config `config.yml`.
zh: 以下代码片段位于MMOCore配置`config.yml`中。

source: Disabling PvP Mode
zh: 禁用PvP模式

source: In order to disable PvP Mode:
zh: 要禁用PvP模式：

source: remove the `pvp-mode` config section from `commands.yml`
zh: 从`commands.yml`中删除`pvp-mode`配置部分

source: set `pvp_mode.enabled` to `false` inside `MMOCore/config.yml`
zh: 将`pvp_mode.enabled`设置为`MMOCore/config.yml`内的`false`

source: 💰 Drop Tables
zh: 💰 删除表

source: The `/drop-tables` folder is where you setup all of your custom drop tables for [blocks](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining) and [loot chests](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/loot-chests). Since their use is not limited to block drops, we decided to give them a separate folder so that you can setup them there and only use their reference in other configs to make them lighter/easier to read and setup.
zh: `/drop-tables`文件夹是你为 [方块](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining)和 [战利品箱](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/loot-chests)] 设置所有自定义掉落表的位置。由于它们的用途不仅限于块掉落，因此我们决定为它们提供一个单独的文件夹，以便你可以在那里设置它们，并且仅在其他配置中使用它们的引用，以使它们更轻/更易于阅读和设置。

source: Drop tables can be used to drop vanilla items, mmoitems or the content of another MMOCore drop table. You can encapsulate drop tables inside of other drop tables to create complex drop tables.
zh: 删除表可用于删除原版物品、 mmoitems 或另一个MMOCore删除表的内容。你可以将删除表封装在其他删除表内以创建复杂的删除表。

source: Default Config
zh: 默认配置

source: This default file is pretty self explanatory. The first drop table example showcases all the drop items you can use inside of any drop table. In order to create a drop table, just add a new section to any file in the `/drop-tables` folder. Then find an ID for your drop table (this identifier must be unique and will be used as a reference later).
zh: 这个默认文件是非常不言自明的。第一个删除表示例展示了你可以在任何删除表内使用的所有删除物品。要创建删除表，只需向`/drop-tables`文件夹中的任何文件添加一个新部分即可。然后为你的drop表找到一个ID（这个标识符必须是唯一的，稍后将用作参考）。

source: The `diamond-drop-table` example is the drop table used in the [Mining profession](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining) when mining diamond ore. The items it may drop are vanilla diamonds, a rare diamond from MMOItems, and all the content from the table called `other-drop-table` (a stone block).
zh: `diamond-drop-table`示例是[采矿副职业](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining)]开采钻石矿石时使用的掉落表。它可能掉落的物品是原版钻石，是MMOItems中的稀有钻石，表中的所有内容称为`other-drop-table`（一块石块）。

source: The numbers after the item mean the chance, and then the amount (can be an integer range). The format for every drop item is the following:
zh: 物品后面的数字表示机会，然后是金额（可以是整数范围）。每滴物品的格式如下：

source: You don't have to specify any of the three last parameters (drop chance/amount/weight) although you will need to specify, for instance, drop chance if you want to utilize the weight system (explained at the bottom of the page).
zh: 你不必指定最后三个参数中的任何一个（掉落机会/数量/重量），尽管你需要指定，例如，如果你想利用权重系统（在页面底部解释），则需要指定掉落机会。

source: Available Drop Types
zh: 可用的掉落类型

source: | Drop Item | Format |
zh: |掉落物品|格式|

source: | Another Drop Table | `droptable{id=drop-table-id} <chance> <amount>` |
zh: |另一个掉落表|`droptable{id=drop-table-id} <chance> <amount>`|

source: | Vanilla Item | `vanilla{type=ITEM_MATERIAL} <chance> <amount>` |
zh: |原版物品|`vanilla{type=ITEM_MATERIAL} <chance> <amount>`|

source: | Gold Coin | `gold{} <chance> <amount>` |
zh: |金币|`gold{} <chance> <amount>`|

source: | Note | `note{min=MIN_WORTH;max=MAX_WORTH} <chance> <amount>` |
zh: |注意|`note{min=MIN_WORTH;max=MAX_WORTH} <chance> <amount>`|

source: | mmoitem | `mmoitem{type=MMOITEM_TYPE;id=MMOITEM_ID} <chance> <min-max>` |
zh: |项目 |`mmoitem{type=MMOITEM_TYPE;id=MMOITEM_ID} <chance> <min-max>`|

source: | gentemplate | `gentemplate{id=TEMPLATE_ID;tier=TIER_NAME;level=<int>;match-level=<true/false>} <chance> <min-max>` |
zh: |基因模板 |`gentemplate{id=TEMPLATE_ID;tier=TIER_NAME;level=<int>;match-level=<true/false>} <chance> <min-max>`|

source: | miloot | `miloot{type=ITEM_TYPE_ID;class="Class Name";match-class=<true/false>;tier=TIER_ID;level=<int>;match-level=<true/false>} <chance> <min-max>` |
zh: | miloot | `miloot{type=ITEM_TYPE_ID;class="Class Name";match-class=<true/false>;tier=TIER_ID;level=<int>;match-level=<true/false>} <chance> <min-max>` |

source: `mmoitem`, `gentemplate` and `miloot` are only available when using MMOItems. For the `gentemplate` and `miloot` drop table items, please refer to [this MMOItems wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/obtain-item).
zh: `mmoitem`、`gentemplate`和`miloot`仅在使用MMOItems时可用。对于`gentemplate`和`miloot`掉落表物品，请参考 [此MMOItemswiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmoitems/items/obtain-item)。

source: Table Capacity, Items Weights
zh: 工作台容量，物品重量

source: Item weights and table capacity fix the problem of having a drop table with two items that are both too rare to drop at the same time. Using item weight you can define how 'heavy' each drop is compared to others, in order to limit extreme drops where one player has enough luck and drops every single rare item from a boss.
zh: 物品权重和掉落表容量用于处理同一掉落表中两件稀有物品同时掉落的情况。通过物品权重，可以设定每项掉落相对于其他项的“重量”，限制单个玩家运气极好、一次从 Boss 身上获得所有稀有物品的极端情况。

source: Example scenario: you want ONLY one of these three items to drop and every item has 1/3 chance to be selected.
zh: 示例场景：你希望仅掉落这三个物品之一，并且每个物品都有1/3机会被选择。

source: Every drop item has an item weight of 1, meaning that if this drop table is utilized by a loot chest (or any other system that supports MMOCore drop tables) with a capacity of 1, only one item will be selected.
zh: 每个掉落物物品的物品权重为1，这意味着如果该掉落表由容量为1的战利品箱（或支持MMOCore掉落表的任何其他系统）使用，则只会选择一个物品。

source: **When a drop table is called to generate random loot, the sum of all selected drop items WEIGHTS cannot exceed the given CAPACITY.** The same drop table can be used with different capacities (for practical reasons). If you use the drop table setup above with a capacity of 3, you can drop the three items at the same time. If you use it with a capacity of 2, 2 items will spawn at most.
zh: **当调用掉落表来生成随机战利品时，所有选定掉落物品权重的总和不能超过给定的容量。** 相同的掉落表可以用于不同的容量（出于实际原因）。如果你使用上面设置的删除表，容量为3，则可以同时删除三个物品。如果你以2的容量使用它，则最多会生成2物品。

source: Keep in mind you can use any value for the item weights. You can also have items with 0 weight along with weighted items in the same drop table (in fact, this is the setup you will be probably using to setup rare boss drops).
zh: 请记住，你可以对物品权重使用任何值。你还可以在同一个掉落表中拥有物品和0重量以及加权物品（事实上，这是你可能会用来设置稀有 Boss 掉落的设置）。

source: When a drop table is called, drop items are read in the order given by the config setup. You must keep that in mind when setting up your item drop chances, as this is why items towards the ends have a higher chance of being picked. The last item always has probability 1 because it's guaranteed to be picked, if all the previous item rolls failed.
zh: 当调用删除表时，将按照配置设置给出的顺序读取删除物品。在设置物品掉落机会时必须牢记这一点，因为这就是为什么靠近末端的物品被挑选的机会更高。最后一个物品的概率始终为1，因为如果之前的所有物品掷骰都失败，则保证会选中它。

source: Where to configure the loot table capacity
zh: 在哪里配置战利品表容量

source: If you are using drop tables inside of loot chests, please refer to [this page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/loot-chests#loot-chest-tiers) to configure the chest loot table capacity.
zh: 如果你在战利品箱内使用掉落表，请参阅[本页](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/loot-chests#loot-chest-tiers)来配置战利品箱的战利品表容量。

source: Otherwise, you can specify the default capacity for any loot table using the `capacity` option:
zh: 否则，你可以使用`capacity`选项指定任何战利品表的默认容量：

source: If absolutely no capacity is specified, MMOCore will use a default capacity of 100.
zh: 如果绝对没有指定容量，MMOCore将使用默认容量100。

source: Drop Table Conditions
zh: 删除表条件

source: Conditions are added to the drop table using the following syntax. Learn more about the conditions system [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/conditions).
zh: 使用以下语法将条件添加到删除表中。了解有关条件系统的更多信息 [此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/conditions)。

source: Extra Options
zh: 额外选项

source: Toggling on the `shuffle` option will shuffle the order in which items are looted inside the drop table. This can be used to easily increase the randomness of drop tables.
zh: 切换`shuffle`选项将打乱物品在掉落表中被掠夺的顺序。这可以用来轻松增加删除表的随机性。

source: 👯‍♀️ Friends
zh: 👯‍♀️朋友们

source: The friends system built into MMOCore is a simple yet effective system. When using the `/friends` command, it will pull up a GUI that shows all your current friends and options to add more.
zh: MMOCore内置的好友系统是一个简单而有效的系统。当使用`/friends`命令时，它会弹出一个GUI，显示你当前的所有好友以及添加更多好友的选项。

source: The stats shown when hovering over an online player include class, level, and online time. For an offline player, you will see how long they have been off!
zh: 将鼠标移到在线玩家上时，会显示其职业、等级和在线时长等属性。对于离线玩家，则会显示其已离线多久。

source: ![PEVbnk9](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/friend_ui.Dr6xWEWe.gif)
zh: ![PEVbnk9](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/friend_ui.Dr6xWEWe.gif)

source: ![6bKKTKJ](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/friend_online.BLJ02EFr.png)
zh: ![6bKKTKJ](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/friend_online.BLJ02EFr.png)

source: You can disable the friend module by simply removing the `/friends` command in the `commands.yml` config file
zh: 你可以通过简单地删除`commands.yml`配置文件中的`/friends`命令来禁用好友模块

source: 🛡️ Guilds
zh: 🛡️ 公会

source: Guilds (also called factions, kingdoms...) are a common feature for RPG servers. They allow players to team up, share resources, and work together toward common goals.
zh: 公会（也称为派系、王国...）是RPG服务器的常见功能。它们允许玩家团队合作、共享资源并共同努力实现共同目标。

source: MMOCore does not provide a guild system, but is compatible with the following guild plugins:
zh: MMOCore不提供公会系统，但兼容以下公会插件：

source: Any plugin supported by [FactionsBridge](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/factionsbridge.89716/) (>15 plugins)
zh: [FactionsBridge](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/factionsbridge.89716/)支持的任何插件（>15插件）

source: [UltimateClans V6](https://polymart.org/resource/ultimate-clans-v6.1162)
zh: [终极部落 V6](https://polymart.org/resource/ultimate-clans-v6.1162)

source: [Guilds](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/guilds-30-sale.66176/)
zh: [公会](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/guilds-30-sale.66176/)

source: Note that you need FactionsBridge installed when running MMOCore with any guild plugin supported by FactionsBridge.
zh: 请注意，当使用 FactionsBridge 支持的任何公会插件运行MMOCore时，你需要安装 FactionsBridge。

source: Choosing your guild plugin
zh: 选择你的公会插件

source: Go to `MMOCore/config.yml` and set `guild-plugin` to whatever plugin you want to use. Make sure you restart your server when editing this option.
zh: 转到`MMOCore/config.yml`并将`guild-plugin`设置为你要使用的任何插件。编辑此选项时请确保重新启动服务器。

source: Using any guild plugin that is not MMOCore will disable all guild features from MMOCore, including the guild registry and the `/guild` command.
zh: 使用任何不是MMOCore的公会插件都会禁用MMOCore的所有公会功能，包括公会注册表和`/guild`命令。

source: MMOCore Guilds
zh: MMOCore公会

source: Note that MMOCore does technically have a dummy guild system implemented, though it has little to no features, and we do not have any plans of pursuing its development.
zh: MMOCore 内部实现了一个占位用的公会系统，但几乎没有实际功能，目前也没有继续开发它的计划。

source: 🎁 Loot Chests
zh: 🎁 战利品箱

source: Lootable chests are a great way to reward RPG players for exploring your world. They spawn around players in specific regions with randomly generated loot. Loot chests can have tiers; the higher the tier, the better the loot.
zh: 可掠夺的箱子是奖励RPG玩家探索世界的好方法。它们在特定区域的玩家周围生成，并随机生成战利品。战利品箱可以有等级；等级越高，战利品就越好。

source: The following code snippets can be found under the `/loot-chests` folder.
zh: 以下代码片段可以在`/loot-chests`文件夹下找到。

source: General options
zh: 一般选项

source: These options can be found inside the MMOCore `config.yml`.
zh: 这些选项可以在MMOCore`config.yml`内找到。

source: Loot Chest Regions
zh: 战利品箱区域

source: MMOCore lets you setup regions where chests can spawn. The first thing you will need to define is the region boundaries just like with WorldGuard regions:
zh: MMOCore允许你设置宝箱可以生成的区域。你需要定义的第一件事是区域边界，就像WorldGuard区域一样：

source: The `loot-chest-region-id` only serves as an internal identifier. It can be anything, just make sure two regions do not share the same ID when editing the configs.
zh: `loot-chest-region-id`仅用作内部标识符。它可以是任何东西，只需确保编辑配置时两个区域不共享相同的ID即可。

source: You will then need to define how frequent chests spawn in that region (period is given in seconds, it's set to 120 by default which corresponds to 2 minutes).
zh: 然后，你需要定义该区域中宝箱生成的频率（周期以秒为单位，默认设置为120，对应于2分钟）。

source: Every X minutes, the region will look for a random player in that region and spawn a chest nearby. Keep in mind that MMOCore will first filter the players which are still on cooldown: that means no chest will spawn in a specific region, if and only if there are either no player in that region/all the players are on cooldown.
zh: 每隔 X 分钟，该区域就会在该区域中随机寻找一个玩家并在附近生成一个箱子。请记住，MMOCore将首先过滤仍在冷却时间上的玩家：这意味着当且仅当该区域中没有玩家/所有玩家都在冷却时间上时，特定区域中不会生成任何箱子。

source: Loot Chest Tiers
zh: 战利品宝箱等级

source: Chest tiers directly determine the loot chest drops. Every tier has a set chance to be chosen when a loot chest is spawned in a region.
zh: 宝箱等级直接决定战利品宝箱的掉落量。当某个地区产生战利品箱时，每个等级都有一定的选择机会。

source: Every tier has its own particle effect that will be displayed around the loot chest block every X ticks (it corresponds to the `period` option), until it is opened/it expires. A particle effect is defined by its type (the shape or figure the particle will draw) and the particle used (flame, firework, water, etc. particles). Available particle types are HELIX, OFFSET and GALAXY. Available particle names can be found over the [Spigot Javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Particle.html).
zh: 每个层都有自己的粒子效果，每 X 个刻就会显示在战利品箱周围（它对应于`period`选项），直到它被打开/过期。粒子效果由其类型（粒子将绘制的形状或图形）和使用的粒子（火焰、烟花、水等粒子）定义。可用的粒子类型有 HELIX、OFFSET 和 GALAXY。可用的粒子名称可以在 [SpigotJavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/Particle.html)] 中找到。

source: `chance` is the probability for the tier to be chosen when a loot chest is spawned. All of the tier chances should add up to 1 (10% chance is 0.1).
zh: `chance`是生成战利品箱时选择等级的概率。所有等级机会加起来应为1（10%机会为0.1）。

source: `drops` is the drop table used to fill the loot chest inventory, along with `capacity` which is the chest capacity. For more information about how loot table *capacity* works, please refer to this [wiki section](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/drop-tables#table-capacity-items-weights). You can either directly specify a number using `capacity: 10` or use a scaling formula instead like this:
zh: `drops`是用于填充战利品箱物品栏的掉落表，以及`capacity`是箱子容量。有关战利品表 *容量* 工作原理的更多信息，请参阅此 [wiki 部分](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/drop-tables#table-capacity-items-weights)。你可以使用`capacity: 10`直接指定数字，也可以使用缩放公式，如下所示：

source: The `spread` and `max-spread` options are optional if you're using a scaling formula for the loot capacity.
zh: 如果你使用战利品容量缩放公式，则`spread`和`max-spread`选项是可选的。

source: For the `drops` option, do note that you can either specify a drop table ID if your drop table is already setup in your drop tables config folder, or an entire config section if you want to define a new drop table specifically for the chest tier.
zh: 对于`drops`选项，请注意，如果你的掉落表已在掉落表配置文件夹中设置，则可以指定掉落表ID；如果你想专门为宝箱层定义新的掉落表，则可以指定整个配置部分。

source: `chests.yml` handles all of your RPG random loot chests! This wiki page is unfinished as there are more loot options and plugin compatibilities that get added to the possible drop tables.
zh: `chests.yml`处理你所有的RPG随机战利品箱！这个维基页面尚未完成，因为有更多的战利品选项和插件兼容性被添加到可能的掉落表中。

source: The name of your chest, in this case "world 59 71 131", defines where the chest is placed. It uses WORLD,X,Y,Z format. You do not actually name your chests, and instead just put different coordinates down where you want a chest.
zh: 宝箱的名称决定它放置的位置，例如“world 59 71 131”。格式为 WORLD,X,Y,Z。这里并不是给箱子起显示名称，而是填写希望放置箱子的世界和坐标。

source: drop-table
zh: drop-table

source: This option defines what could possibly be in your chest. It currently supports MMOItems, Vanilla items, MMOCore currency (gold and notes). The format is shown in the default chest.
zh: 此选项定义了你的胸部可能有什么。目前支持MMOItems、原版、物品、MMOCore货币（黄金和纸币）。格式显示在默认箱子中。

source: The 2 sets of numbers after the entry are drop chance and drop amount. In this example .9 (90%) is the chance for the chest to include it, and 1-3 is the randomized amount.
zh: 输入后的2组数字分别是掉落几率和掉落数量。在这个例子中。9(90%) 是宝箱包含它的机会，而1-3是随机数量。

source: regen-time
zh: regen-time

source: This is the time it takes for the chest to respawn with randomized loot, in ticks. When a chest is opened and cleared, it will be deleted. Or a chest can be punched to drop all the loot on the ground.
zh: 这是箱子以随机战利品重生所需的时间（以刻为单位）。当宝箱被打开并清除时，它将被删除。或者，可以敲击箱子，将所有战利品掉落在地上。

source: Effect
zh: 效果

source: In order to make loot chests stand out, you can put particle effects on them so players know they are special chests. You can also use these particle effects to determine chest tiers. Just give different chests and drop tables, different effects!
zh: 为了使战利品箱脱颖而出，你可以在它们上添加粒子效果，以便玩家知道它们是特殊的箱子。你还可以使用这些粒子效果来确定宝箱等级。只要给予不同的宝箱和掉落台，就有不同的效果！

source: ⛏️ Custom Mining
zh: ⛏️ 定制挖矿

source: MMOCore features a custom mining system finetuned for RPG servers. Using this system, you can:
zh: MMOCore具有针对RPG服务器进行微调的自定义挖矿系统。使用该系统，你可以：

source: prevent players from destroying blocks and terrain
zh: 防止玩家破坏方块和地形

source: configure loots obtained when mining blocks
zh: 配置挖掘块时获得的战利品

source: have blocks naturally regenerate only after a set amount of time
zh: 仅在设定的时间后才自然地重新生成块

source: keep or delete vanilla block drop tables
zh: 保留或删除原版块删除表

source: have blocks give profession/main class experience when mined
zh: 让方块在被挖掘时提供副职业或主职业经验

source: require players to have a specific tool in order to break a block
zh: 需要玩家拥有特定工具才能打破方块

source: ![xiL4NX0](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/custom_mining.B3iqu2mm.gif)
zh: ![xiL4NX0](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/custom_mining.B3iqu2mm.gif)

source: Enabling custom mining
zh: 启用自定义挖掘

source: Head to your `MMOCore/config.yml` config file and look for the config section named `custom-mining`.
zh: 前往`MMOCore/config.yml`配置文件并查找名为`custom-mining`的配置部分。

source: Toggle off the `enable` option to disable custom mining serverwide. You can also selectively enable it in specific worlds/regions, where custom mining is enabled. In the following example, custom mining is enabled in worlds `world` and `world_nether`, only inside the region with name `mmocore_custom_mining`.
zh: 关闭`enable`选项以在服务器范围内禁用自定义挖掘。你还可以有选择地在启用自定义挖掘的特定世界/区域中启用它。在以下示例中，仅在名为`mmocore_custom_mining`的区域内启用世界`world`和`world_nether`中的自定义挖掘。

source: Last but not least toggling on the `protect-custom-mine` option will prevent players from destroying blocks that have no setup in the `on-mine` profession configuration section (see below). In other words, any block that has no drop/regen configuration would be protected by default.
zh: 最后但并非最不重要的一点是，切换`protect-custom-mine`选项将防止玩家破坏`on-mine`副职业配置部分中没有设置的块（见下文）。换句话说，默认情况下，任何没有丢弃/再生配置的块都会受到保护。

source: Note that custom mining does not apply to creative mode.
zh: 请注意，自定义挖掘不适用于创意模式。

source: Mining Experience Source
zh: 挖矿经验来源

source: Players earn experience by mining a specific type of block. These can be crops or ores; there are some specific options to help you prevent players from abusing this exp source. The list of all crops can be found in the default Farming profession config file.
zh: 玩家通过挖掘特定类型的区块赚取经验。这些可以是农作物或矿石；有一些特定选项可以帮助你防止玩家滥用此经验源。所有农作物的列表可以在默认的农业副职业配置文件中找到。

source: | Option | Default Value | Description |
zh: |选项 |默认值 |描述 |

source: | `material` | - | The block you need to mine |
zh: |`material`| - |你需要开采的区块 |

source: | `silk-touch` | true | When enabled, no EXP is earned when using silk touch |
zh: |`silk-touch`|true|启用后，使用丝触时不会获得 EXP |

source: | `crop` | false | When enabled, players don't get exp unless crops are fully grown |
zh: |`crop`|false|启用后，除非农作物完全生长，否则玩家不会获得经验 |

source: | `player-placed` | false | When disabled, players don't get exp from blocks placed by players |
zh: |`player-placed`|false|禁用时，玩家不会从玩家放置的方块中获取 exp |

source: Tool Restrictions
zh: 工具限制

source: Tool restrictions (or *tool permission sets*) define what blocks a specific item can mine. This option is toggled off by default, but you can enable it by toggling on the following option in your MMOCore `config.yml`:
zh: 工具限制（或*工具权限集*）定义特定物品可以挖掘哪些块。默认情况下此选项处于关闭状态，但你可以通过在MMOCore`config.yml`中切换以下选项来启用它：

source: Please read this [wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/tool-restrictions) for more information about tool restrictions.
zh: 请阅读此 [wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/tool-restrictions)，了解有关工具限制的更多信息。

source: Diamond Ore Example
zh: 钻石矿石示例

source: The following example is part of the default `/professions/mining.yml` setup.
zh: 以下示例是默认`/professions/mining.yml`设置的一部分。

source: Note that in this example, custom mining is setup for ores (relative to the *Mining* profession), but you can also use custom mining to setup drop tables and exp for woodcutting (wood, logs...).
zh: 请注意，在此示例中，为矿石设置了自定义采矿（相对于 *采矿*副职业），但你也可以使用自定义采矿来设置掉落表和经验进行木材切割（木材，原木...）。

source: This config does the following when a vanilla diamond ore is broken:
zh: 当原版钻石矿石被破坏时，此配置将执行以下操作：

source: drop 1 to 3 diamonds in addition to the vanilla block drops
zh: 除了原版方块掉落外，还会掉落1至3钻石

source: temporarily replace the block with a stone block (for 100 seconds)
zh: 暂时用石块替换该块（100秒）

source: give 20 *Mining* experience to the miner
zh: 为矿工提供20*挖矿* 经验

source: Target Block
zh: 目标块

source: This parameter determines what block is affected. `vanilla` corresponds to the block type. There are three built-in [block types](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/block-types) in MMOCore: vanilla blocks, MMOItems custom blocks (only available when MMOItems is installed), and textured player heads/skulls.
zh: 该参数确定受影响的块。`vanilla`对应的是块类型。共有三种built-in[MMOCore中的块类型](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/block-types)：原版块、MMOItems自定义块（仅在安装MMOItems时可用）和纹理玩家头/头骨。

source: Drop Table
zh: 掉落表

source: This determines what drop table to call when the defined block is broken. It can either be a totally new drop table or a reference to an existing drop table from the `/drop-tables` folder. Please refer to [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/drop-tables) to learn about the syntax of drop tables.
zh: 这决定了当定义的块被破坏时要调用哪个删除表。它可以是全新的删除表，也可以是对`/drop-tables`文件夹中现有删除表的引用。请参考[这个wiki页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/drop-tables)来了解删除表的语法。

source: Vanilla Drops
zh: 原版掉落

source: Toggle on/off vanilla drops of the block being mined.
zh: 打开/关闭正在开采的区块的原版掉落。

source: Block Regen
zh: 阻止再生

source: `time` is the amount of time (in ticks) before the block reverts back to its initial state after being mined. `temp-block` is the block that will physically replace the broken block, indicating to players that it has recently been mined and that it is still regenerating (and therefore that it cannot be mined again just yet).
zh: `time` 表示方块被挖掘后，恢复原状所需的时间，单位为刻（tick）。`temp-block` 是用于暂时替换已挖掘方块的方块，让玩家知道该方块刚被挖过，仍在恢复中，因此暂时无法再次挖掘。

source: Note that the `temp-block` option (what temporary block to place) follows the exact same one-line JSON syntax as the `material` option (target block) described above.
zh: 请注意，`temp-block`选项（放置什么临时块）遵循与上述`material`选项（目标块）完全相同的one-lineJSON语法。

source: Known Issue with Player Heads
zh: 玩家头的已知问题

source: In recent Minecraft versions (1.20+), there is a known issue when using player heads as temporary blocks. If ALL of the following conditions are met,
zh: 在最近的Minecraft版本 (1.20+) 中，使用玩家磁头作为临时块时存在一个已知问题。如果满足以下所有条件，

source: vanilla drops are enabled
zh: 原版子站已启用

source: temporary block is set to a player head with texture
zh: 临时块设置为带有纹理的玩家头

source: the target block is NOT a player head with texture.
zh: 目标块不是带有纹理的玩家头部。

source: Then the skull texture of the temporary skull block will not show.
zh: 那么临时头骨块的头骨纹理将不会显示。

source: Additional Example
zh: 附加示例

source: 👯 Parties
zh: 👯队伍

source: Parties are an essential part of any RPG server. They usually provide teleportation perks or buffs to members within the same party.
zh: 队伍是任何RPG服务器的重要组成部分。他们通常向同一队伍内的成员提供传送福利或增益效果。

source: While MMOCore does provide a decent built-in party system, it is fully compatible with the following plugins:
zh: 虽然MMOCore确实提供了一个不错的内置队伍系统，但它与以下插件完全兼容：

source: [MythicDungeons](https://mythiccraft.io/index.php?resources/mythic-dungeons.869/) recommended
zh: 【神话地下城](https://mythiccraft.io/index.php?resources/mythic-dungeons.869/)推荐】

source: [mcMMO](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/official-mcmmo-original-author-returns.64348/)
zh: [mcMMO](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/official-mcmmo-original-author-returns.64348/)

source: [Parties](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/parties-an-advanced-parties-manager.3709/) recommended
zh: 【各方推荐](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/parties-an-advanced-parties-manager.3709/)

source: PartyAndFriends ([Spigot](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/party-and-friends-extended-for-spigot-supports-1-7-1-19.11633/) & [Proxy](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/party-and-friends-for-bungeecord-supports-1-7-x-to-1-19-x.9531/))
zh: PartyAndFriends ([Spigot](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/party-and-friends-extended-for-spigot-supports-1-7-1-19.11633/)& [代理](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/party-and-friends-for-bungeecord-supports-1-7-x-to-1-19-x.9531/))

source: [DungeonsXL](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/dungeonsxl.9488/)
zh: [地下城XL](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/dungeonsxl.9488/)

source: [Heroes](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%9A%94-heroes-premium-%E2%9A%94-best-minecraft-spigot-rpg-plugin-ever.24734/)
zh: [Heroes](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%9A%94-heroes-premium-%E2%9A%94-best-minecraft-spigot-rpg-plugin-ever.24734/)

source: [OBTeam](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/obteam.108269/) ([DungeonMMO](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%AD%90-dungeonmmo-%E2%AD%90-dungeon-world-generator-%E2%9C%85-create-your-dungeons-%E2%AD%95-endless-possibilities.106150/))
zh: [OBTeam](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/obteam.108269/)([DungeonMMO](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%AD%90-dungeonmmo-%E2%AD%90-dungeon-world-generator-%E2%9C%85-create-your-dungeons-%E2%AD%95-endless-possibilities.106150/))

source: Choosing your party plugin
zh: 选择你的队伍插件

source: Go to `MMOCore/config.yml` and set `party-plugin` to whatever plugin you want to use. Make sure you restart your server when editing this option.
zh: 转到`MMOCore/config.yml`并将`party-plugin`设置为你要使用的任何插件。编辑此选项时请确保重新启动服务器。

source: Using any party plugin that is not MMOCore will disable all party features from MMOCore (mostly the `/party` command).
zh: 使用任何不是MMOCore的队伍插件都会禁用MMOCore中的所有队伍功能（主要是`/party`命令）。

source: MythicDungeons
zh: 神话地下城

source: You can either inject the MythicDungeons party system into MMOCore using `MYTHICDUNGEONS`, or inject the MMOCore party system into MythicDungeons using `MYTHICDUNGEONS_INJECT`.
zh: 你可以使用`MYTHICDUNGEONS`将 MythicDungeons 队伍系统注入到MMOCore中，或者使用`MYTHICDUNGEONS_INJECT`将MMOCore队伍系统注入到 MythicDungeons 中。

source: MMOCore Quests
zh: MMOCore任务

source: MMOCore features a basic built-in party system where you and up to 7 friends can party up for extra boosts and perks!
zh: MMOCore具有基本的内置队伍系统，你和最多7的朋友可以通过队伍获得额外的提升和福利！

source: > The following wiki sections describe the built-in MMOCore party module.
zh: > 以下 wiki 部分介绍了内置MMOCore队伍模块。

source: To begin, enter the `/party` command. If you are not already in a party, it will ask you if you want to create one.
zh: 首先，输入`/party`命令。如果你尚未进入队伍，它会询问你是否要创建一个。

source: After that, you will be shown the main party GUI, where you can see current party members and invite new people. By default, parties give a slight regeneration and experience boost. The more players in your party, the higher the buff (see below).
zh: 之后，你将看到主要队伍GUI，你可以在其中查看当前的队伍成员并邀请新人。默认情况下，聚会会带来轻微的恢复和经验提升。你的队伍中的玩家越多，增益就越高（见下文）。

source: ![7Vx1Ld2](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/party_ui.HXPtgxen.png)
zh: ![7Vx1Ld2](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/party_ui.HXPtgxen.png)

source: Party Chat
zh: 聚会聊天

source: Players can talk via party chat using `@` at the beginning of their message. This chat prefix can be edited in the main MMOCore config file (`party.chat-prefix`):
zh: 玩家可以在消息开头使用`@`通过群组聊天进行交谈。可以在主MMOCore配置文件 (`party.chat-prefix`) 中编辑此聊天前缀：

source: ![3zFCOei](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/party_chat.GJ2XiZcZ.png)
zh: ![3zFCOei](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/party_chat.GJ2XiZcZ.png)

source: Party Buffs
zh: 队伍增益效果

source: Party buffs are extra statistics that everyone in a party will get as long as there are more than 2 members in the party. A party with one solo player will not get any buffs. The buffs increase proportionally to the number of players in the party. For example, a party of 4 players will get 3 times the buff amount configured (as the first player does not count towards buffs).
zh: 队伍增益效果是额外的属性，只要队伍中的成员超过2，队伍中的每个人都会获得。带有一个单独的玩家的队伍将不会获得任何增益效果。增益效果与队伍中玩家的数量成比例增加。例如，4玩家的队伍将获得3乘以配置的增益效果数量（因为第一个玩家不计入增益效果）。

source: These buffs are configurable in the main MMOCore `config.yml` config file.
zh: 这些增益可以在主MMOCore`config.yml`配置文件中进行配置。

source: These buffs are displayed on a cake icon when opening the player stats menu, that you can configure under the `/gui/player-stats.yml` config file:
zh: 当打开玩家属性菜单时，这些增益会显示在蛋糕图标上，你可以在`/gui/player-stats.yml`配置文件下进行配置：

source: ![CX0lIKA](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/party_morale.BinBfJgm.png)
zh: ![CX0lIKA](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/party_morale.BinBfJgm.png)

source: Exp splitting
zh: 经验分割

source: Since MMOCore 1.9.3, the experience earned by any player is evenly split over all the party members. If your party has a total of 4 members you will only earn 25% of the exp you'd get with no party. This makes sure all the party members level up at the same time.
zh: 自MMOCore1.9.3起，任何玩家获得的经验均分给所有党员。如果你的队伍共有4成员，你将只能获得25%的经验值，而你在没有队伍的情况下获得的经验值。这可以确保所有党员同时升级。

source: This feature creates an issue where low level players can join the party of high level players and get huge amounts of exp. This can be fixed by using the `max-level-difference` in the MMOCore main config file. For instance, setting this option to 5 will prevent level-1's from joining parties of level-7's or more. The level of the party is determined by the initial party owner's level.
zh: 此功能造成了低等级玩家可以加入高等级玩家的队伍并获得大量经验的问题。这可以通过使用MMOCore主配置文件中的`max-level-difference`来修复。例如，将此选项设置为5将阻止level-1加入level-7或更多的队伍。队伍的等级由初始队伍所有者的等级决定。

source: That feature stays operational even if you are using another party plugin. It also supports profession experience.
zh: 即使你使用另一个队伍插件，该功能仍然可以运行。它还支持副职业经验。

source: Using other party plugins
zh: 使用其他方插件

source: Just go in your main MMOCore config file and change this option to whatever plugin you have installed:
zh: 只需进入你的主MMOCore配置文件并将此选项更改为你已安装的任何插件：

source: The exp splitting mechanism will work exactly in the same way as described above for all the plugins listed. The party buff system works for all of them except party-and-friends(PAF).
zh: 对于列出的所有插件，经验拆分机制的工作方式与上述完全相同。队伍增益效果系统适用于除party-and-friends(PAF) 之外的所有系统。

source: 📖 Quests
zh: 📖 任务

source: Quests are an essential part of any RPG. They give players goals, challenges, and rewards, while guiding them through the world. MMOCore includes a basic quest module, but it’s not as complete as popular Spigot quest plugins.
zh: 任务是任何RPG的重要组成部分。他们给玩家目标、挑战和奖励，同时引导他们穿越世界。MMOCore包含一个基本的任务模块，但它不像流行的Spigot任务插件那么完整。

source: For more complex RPG servers, we recommend sticking to popular, maintained quest plugins that are fully supported by MMOCore:
zh: 对于更复杂的RPG服务器，我们建议坚持使用MMOCore完全支持的流行的、维护的任务插件：

source: [TypeWriter](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/typewriter-next-generation-questing.107748/) recommended
zh: [TypeWriter](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/typewriter-next-generation-questing.107748/)推荐

source: [BetonQuest](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/betonquest-all-your-adventure-supplies-versatile-quests-in-depth-conversations.2117/) recommended
zh: 【BetonQuest](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/betonquest-all-your-adventure-supplies-versatile-quests-in-depth-conversations.2117/)推荐

source: [BeautyQuests](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/beautyquests.39255/)
zh: [BeautyQuests](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/beautyquests.39255/)

source: [Quests](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/quests.3711/)
zh: [任务](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/quests.3711/)

source: [QuestCreator](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/questcreator-new-sqlite-support-and-data-conversion.38734/)
zh: [任务创造者](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/questcreator-new-sqlite-support-and-data-conversion.38734/)

source: Choosing your quest plugin
zh: 选择你的任务插件

source: Go to `MMOCore/config.yml` and set `quest-plugin` to whatever plugin you want to use. Make sure you restart your server when editing this option.
zh: 转到`MMOCore/config.yml`并将`quest-plugin`设置为你要使用的任何插件。编辑此选项时请确保重新启动服务器。

source: Using any quest plugin that is not MMOCore will disable all quest features from MMOCore, including the quest registry and the `/quests` command. You will not get any warning for any MMOCore quest config error.
zh: 使用任何不是MMOCore的任务插件都会禁用MMOCore的所有任务功能，包括任务注册表和`/quests`命令。对于任何MMOCore任务配置错误，你不会收到任何警告。

source: MMOCore provides a simple objective-based quest solution, though it does not provide complex branching storylines with conditional events, tags and variables, like what you can achieve with BetonQuest or Typewriter.
zh: MMOCore提供了一个简单的objective-based任务解决方案，尽管它不提供带有条件事件、标签和变量的复杂分支故事情节，就像你可以使用 BetonQuest 或 Typewriter 实现的那样。

source: > The following paragraphs describe the built-in MMOCore quest module.
zh: > 以下段落描述了built-inMMOCore任务模块。

source: MMOCore quests are series of objectives the players must complete in order to earn some loot and experience.
