There are various types of objectives, like going to a specific location, talking to an NPC, killing X mobs, bringing items back to an NPC... Some of these objectives require extra plugins like [Citizens](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/citizens.13811/) for NPC objectives or [MythicMobs](https://www.mythicmobs.net/index.php) for extra mob objectives.
zh: MMOCore任务是玩家必须完成的一系列目标，才能获得一些战利品和经验。有多种类型的目标，例如前往特定位置、与 NPC 交谈、杀死 X 个小怪、将物品带回 NPC...其中一些目标需要额外的插件，例如 [Citizens](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/citizens.13811/)用于 NPC 目标或 [MythicMobs](https://www.mythicmobs.net/index.php)用于额外的小怪目标。

source: Parent Quests
zh: 家长任务

source: Quests may require that the player has completed some other quest beforehand, therefore you can set up some sort of storyline.
zh: 任务可能需要玩家事先完成一些其他任务，因此你可以设置某种故事情节。

source: Quests have a specific set of actions (these are called *triggers*), like messages or commands, performed when the player completes an objective. These may be used to explain specific things to the player, or to give them quest items or rewards.
zh: 任务具有一组特定的操作（称为*触发器*），例如消息或命令，在玩家完成目标时执行。这些可以用来向玩家解释特定的事情，或者给他们任务物品或奖励。

source: Progression
zh: 进展

source: Whenever a player starts a quest, they can keep track of that quest progression in the quest GUI and on the bossbar, which displays the current quest objective. The bossbar also displays how close the player is from finishing the quest (ratio of completed objectives).
zh: 每当玩家开始任务时，他们都可以在任务GUI和 bossbar 中跟踪任务进度，bossbar 显示当前的任务目标。 bossbar 还显示玩家距完成任务的距离（已完成目标的比率）。

source: ![SOPzchl](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/quest_start.BRpjfvKv.png)
zh: ![SOPzchl](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/quest_start.BRpjfvKv.png)

source: Quest Menu
zh: 任务菜单

source: Players can see available and unlocked quests in the quest menu, which they can access using `/quests`.
zh: 玩家可以在任务菜单中查看可用和解锁的任务，他们可以使用`/quests`访问这些任务。

source: ![If0S5w6](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/quest_ui.Bl7Almx9.gif)
zh: ![如果0S5w6](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/quest_ui.Bl7Almx9.gif)

source: Quest Example
zh: 任务示例

source: The following sections explain how to set up a new quest, using an example from the default MMOCore config files.
zh: 以下部分使用默认MMOCore配置文件中的示例解释如何设置新任务。

source: Config Breakdown
zh: 配置细目

source: The config above is one of the YAML files you can set up in the quests folder (one YAML config per quest). The first config option is `level-req` feature. This determines what level the player needs to be in order to unlock the quest. Our default config sets it to level 10 main, and level 5 mining profession.
zh: 上面的配置是你可以在任务文件夹中设置的YAML文件之一（每个任务一个YAML配置）。第一个配置选项是`level-req`功能。这决定了玩家需要是什么等级才能解锁任务。我们的默认配置将其设置为等级10main 和等级5挖矿副职业。

source: After that, you can set the **name** of the quest that is displayed in the quest menu. The initial name that you set earlier is just for ID purposes in the config.
zh: 之后，你可以设置任务菜单中显示的任务的**名称**。你之前设置的初始名称仅用于配置中的ID目的。

source: Next, you can set the **lore** of the quest that is displayed in the quest menu. Note that adding rewards here won’t actually grant them; it’s just for display.
zh: 接下来，你可以设置任务菜单中显示的任务的**描述**。请注意，在这里添加奖励并不会真正授予它们；它只是为了显示。

source: Next option is the **parent** option, this determines if there is another quest the player must finish in order to unlock the specific quest.
zh: 下一个选项是 **parent** 选项，这确定玩家是否必须完成另一个任务才能解锁特定任务。

source: Next option is the **cooldown** on the quest. If you want it to be a one-time quest, you put nothing in the option. If you want it to be instantly redoable, set it to 0. Otherwise, the cooldown is in hours.
zh: 下一个选项是任务中的 **冷却时间**。如果你希望它成为one-time任务，则无需在选项中添加任何内容。如果你希望它立即可重做，请将其设置为0。否则，冷却时间的单位是小时。

source: Objectives
zh: 目标

source: Next, the quest file lets you put in the **objectives**. A quest is a series of objectives a player must complete in order to earn some rewards. Inside of an objective you have the type, lore, and triggers.
zh: 接下来，任务文件允许你输入**目标**。任务是玩家必须完成的一系列目标才能获得一些奖励。目标内部有类型描述和触发器。

source: **Type** is what determines what the player must do, **Lore** defines what the quest tells the player to do, and **triggers** determine what happens when the player completes the actual objective.
zh: **类型**决定了玩家必须做什么，**描述**定义了任务告诉玩家要做的事情，而**触发器**决定了当玩家完成实际目标时会发生什么。

source: Since the objective lore is displayed on a bossbar, you can change the color of the bar for every objective using `bar-color: <COLOR>`. A list of all the available colors can be found over the [Spigot javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/boss/BarColor.html).
zh: 由于目标描述显示在主栏上，因此你可以使用`bar-color: <COLOR>`更改每个目标的栏颜色。所有可用颜色的列表可以在 [Spigotjavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/boss/BarColor.html)] 中找到。

source: Triggers can be either used to give information to the player about the RPG storyline or instructions for the next objective, or simply quest rewards.
zh: 触发器可用于向玩家提供有关RPG故事情节的信息或下一个目标的说明，或者只是寻求奖励。

source: | Objective | Description | Format |
zh: |目标 |描述 |格式|

source: | clickon | Player must click somewhere in the map. | `clickon{world=<world-name>;x=<x>;y=<y>;z=<z>;range=<radius>}` |
zh: |点击|玩家必须单击地图中的某个位置。 |`clickon{world=<world-name>;x=<x>;y=<y>;z=<z>;range=<radius>}`|

source: | mineblock | Player has to mine X blocks of the same type. | `mineblock{type=<MATERIAL>;amount=<amount>}` |
zh: |矿区 |玩家必须开采 X 个相同类型的区块。 |`mineblock{type=<MATERIAL>;amount=<amount>}`|

source: | killmob | Player must kill X vanilla mobs. | `killmob{type=<ENTITY_TYPE>;amount=<AMOUNT>}` |
zh: |杀戮暴民 |玩家必须杀死 X原版生物。 |`killmob{type=<ENTITY_TYPE>;amount=<AMOUNT>}`|

source: | goto | Player has to go to some location. | `goto{world=<world-name>;x=<x>;y=<y>;z=<z>;range=<radius>}` |
zh: |转到|玩家必须去某个地点。 |`goto{world=<world-name>;x=<x>;y=<y>;z=<z>;range=<radius>}`|

source: | getitem | Player has to give a Citizen NPC an item. | `getitem{type=<MATERIAL>;npc=<Citizen_ID>;amount=<AMOUNT>}` |
zh: |获取项目 |玩家必须给公民 NPC物品。 |`getitem{type=<MATERIAL>;npc=<Citizen_ID>;amount=<AMOUNT>}`|

source: | getmmoitem | Player has to give a Citizen NPC an item from MMOItems. | `getmmoitem{type=<MI_TYPE>;id=<MI_ID>;npc=<Citizen-ID>;amount=<AMOUNT>}` |
zh: |获取项目 |玩家必须从MMOItems给公民 NPC 一个物品。 |`getmmoitem{type=<MI_TYPE>;id=<MI_ID>;npc=<Citizen-ID>;amount=<AMOUNT>}`|

source: | talkto | Player must talk to an NPC. | `talkto{npc=<Citizen_ID>}` |
zh: |谈话 |玩家必须与 NPC 对话。 |`talkto{npc=<Citizen_ID>}`|

source: | killmythicmob | Player has to kill X mythic mobs. | `killmythicmob{name=<mythicMobsInternalName>;amount=<AMOUNT>}` |
zh: |杀戮神话 |玩家必须杀死 X 个神话小怪。 |`killmythicmob{name=<mythicMobsInternalName>;amount=<AMOUNT>}`|

source: Trigger Types
zh: 触发类型

source: A full list of available triggers to be used in conjunction with these objectives can be found [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers).
zh: 可以找到与这些目标结合使用的可用触发器的完整列表[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers)。

source: 🌱 Skill Trees
zh: 🌱技能树

source: Skill trees are a combination of nodes which can be unlocked/levelled-up using skill tree points. Levelling up a skill tree node can give stats or can run some triggers for the player. You can also reset the progress for a skill tree and gain the skill tree points spent for it by using a skill tree reallocation point.
zh: 技能树是可以使用技能树积分解锁/levelled-up的节点组合。升级技能树节点可以获得属性或可以为玩家运行一些触发器。你还可以重置技能树的进度，并通过使用技能树重新分配点来获得为其花费的技能树点。

source: <summary>Skill Tree Basic Config Example</summary>
zh: <summary>技能树基本配置示例</summary>

source: Skill trees are class-based, which means that the skill trees you can see and your progress for them depends on your current [class](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes). Each player can spend points in trees linked to its current class. You can link skill trees using the following syntax, inside any class configuration file:
zh: 技能树按职业划分：玩家能看到哪些技能树，以及各技能树的进度，都取决于当前[职业](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes)。玩家可以在当前职业关联的技能树中投入点数。在任意职业配置文件中使用以下语法，即可关联技能树：

source: Skill Tree Points
zh: 技能树积分

source: You can use the following command to give skill tree points to players. The `id` represents the identifier of the skill tree you want to give points to. These points will only be usable for the corresponding skill tree. If you want to give skill tree points usable for any skill tree, use the id `global`.
zh: 你可以使用以下命令将技能树指向玩家。`id`代表你想要为其分配积分的技能树的标识符。这些积分仅适用于相应的技能树。如果你想为任何技能树提供可使用的技能树积分，请使用 id`global`。

source: One of the main ways you will be giving players skill tree points is through command triggers in experience tables. In the following example, a player will receive 1 skill tree point useable for the skill tree with ID `archerSkillTree` every time they level up.
zh: 给予玩家技能树积分的主要方式之一是通过经验表中的命令触发器。在以下示例中，玩家将在每次升级时收到可用于技能树和ID`archerSkillTree`的1技能树积分。

source: You can also use the following command to give skill tree reallocation points to players.
zh: 你还可以使用以下命令将技能树重新分配点赋予玩家。

source: Max Points Spent
zh: 最多花费积分

source: This field corresponds to the maximum amount of points that a player can spend in a skill tree. If unspecified, there will be no limit to the amount of points a player can spend in the skill tree.
zh: 该字段对应于玩家可以在技能树中花费的最大积分数量。如果未指定，则玩家在技能树中可以花费的积分数量没有限制。

source: Nodes
zh: 节点

source: A skill tree is comprised of multiple nodes. Nodes are what the player interacts with in order to unlock new skills and perks. These nodes can either be linked together through paths, requirements and incompatibilities, or be independently leveled up. Players spend skill tree points on specific nodes in order to unlock/level them up.
zh: 技能树由多个节点组成。节点是玩家与之交互的对象，以解锁新的技能和特权。这些节点可以通过路径、要求和不兼容性链接在一起，也可以独立升级。玩家在特定节点上花费技能树积分来解锁/升级它们。

source: The skill tree nodes go under the `nodes` subsection in the skill tree YML config.
zh: 技能树节点位于技能树YML 配置中的`nodes`小节下。

source: Node States
zh: 节点状态

source: A skill tree node can be in one of the five following states.
zh: 技能树节点可以处于以下五种状态之一。

source: | State | Description |
zh: |状态|描述 |

source: | Unlocked | The node is at least at level 1 and is already unlocked |
zh: |解锁 |该节点至少为1等级且已解锁 |

source: | Maxed Out | The node has reached its maximum level. |
zh: |已达到极限 |该节点已达到其最大等级。 |

source: | Locked | The node is not accessible to the player yet, but might be in the future |
zh: |锁定|玩家尚无法访问该节点，但将来可能会访问 |

source: | Fully Locked | The player made a branching choice, rendering this node inaccessible unless a respec is performed |
zh: |完全锁定|玩家做出了分支选择，除非执行重新规范，否则无法访问该节点 |

source: | Unlockable | The node can be unlocked for N skill tree points |
zh: |可解锁| N个技能树点即可解锁该节点|

source: You can modify the display name of each state in the `node-status` section in the `gui/skill-tree.yml` config file.
zh: 你可以在`gui/skill-tree.yml`配置文件的`node-status`部分修改每个状态的显示名称。

source: Coordinates
zh: 坐标

source: To be represented in the GUI, each skill tree node has unique coordinates defining where it will be displayed. The coordinates can be as large as you want (e.g x:15 y:0). You might have to move around in the GUI using the arrows to see nodes that are further way from the origin `(x=0,y=0)`.
zh: 为了在GUI中表示，每个技能树节点都有唯一的坐标定义其显示位置。坐标可以任意大（e.gx:15y:0）。你可能必须使用箭头在GUI中移动才能查看距离原点`(x=0,y=0)`更远的节点。

source: ![Coordinates](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/skill_tree_ui_grid.CJcoAizS.jpeg)
zh: ![坐标](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/skill_tree_ui_grid.CJcoAizS.jpeg)

source: Parents (Strong)
zh: 父母（强）

source: All the strong parents of any node must be unlocked before that node can be unlocked.
zh: 任何节点的所有强父节点都必须先解锁，然后才能解锁该节点。

source: In the following example, `a2`, `a3` and `a4` are strong children of `a1`. In order to unlock `a2`, `a3` or `a4`, the player must get `a1` to level 2, 1 or 3 respectively.
zh: 在以下示例中，`a2`、`a3`和`a4`是`a1`的强子级。为了解锁`a2`、`a3`或`a4`，玩家必须分别将`a1`升级到2、1或3。

source: In the following example, `a1` is a strong parent of both `a2` and `a3`. In order to unlock `a2` or `a3`, the player must get `a1` to level 2 or 1 respectively.
zh: 在以下示例中，`a1`是`a2`和`a3`的强父级。为了解锁`a2`或`a3`，玩家必须分别将`a1`升级到2或1。

source: Parents (Soft)
zh: 父母（软）

source: Soft parents are similar to strong parents, except that you only need to unlock at least one soft parent, instead of all of them.
zh: 软父母与强父母类似，只不过你只需要解锁至少一个软父母，而不是全部。

source: In the following example, reaching level 3 of `a1` is sufficient to unlock `a2`, and reaching level 2 of `a1` is sufficient to unlock `a3`.
zh: 在以下示例中，达到`a1`的等级3足以解锁`a2`，达到`a1`的等级2足以解锁`a3`。

source: In the following example, in order to unlock `a3`, the player can either reach level 3 of `a1` or level 2 of `a2` (one suffices).
zh: 在下面的示例中，为了解锁`a3`，玩家可以达到`a1`的等级3或`a2`的等级2（一个就足够了）。

source: If a node has both strong and soft parents, the requirements stack up. The player must unlock all the strong parent nodes, and at least one node among the soft parents.
zh: 如果一个节点同时具有强父节点和软父节点，则需求会叠加。玩家必须解锁所有强父节点，以及至少一个软父节点。

source: > Note that the `children` and `parents` options are pretty much symmetrical. The following syntaxes are completely equivalent:
zh: > 请注意，`children`和`parents`选项几乎是对称的。以下语法完全等效：

source: > You can either define `a2` as the child of `a1`, or `a1` as the parent of `a2`. Both of these syntaxes will lead to the exact same behaviors.
zh: > 你可以将`a2`定义为`a1`的子级，或将`a1`定义为`a2`的父级。这两种语法都会导致完全相同的行为。

source: > For each node config, you can define `parents` and/or `children`, or none.
zh: > 对于每个节点配置，你可以定义`parents`和/或`children`，或不定义。

source: Incompatible Nodes
zh: 不兼容的节点

source: Nodes can be incompatible with each other, meaning that they permanently lock if other nodes have already been unlocked.
zh: 节点之间可能不兼容，这意味着如果其他节点已解锁，它们将永久锁定。

source: > Although it is not its best use case, this feature can be used to recreate the `max-children` option (described [below](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/skill-trees#maximum-children)). It is most useful in specific cases where you have two distant nodes that introduce incompatibilities or bugs when used together.
zh: > 尽管这不是其最佳用例，但此功能可用于重新创建`max-children`选项（[在](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/skill-trees#maximum-children)下面进行描述）。它在特定情况下最有用，在这种情况下，你有两个遥远的节点，当一起使用时会引入不兼容性或错误。

source: In the following example, if `a2` reaches level 1, or if `a3` reaches level 2, `a1` permanently locks (until a respec).
zh: 在以下示例中，如果`a2`达到等级1，或者`a3`达到等级2，则`a1`永久锁定（直到重新规范）。

source: Lore
zh: 描述

source: The `lore` is displayed in the skill-tree GUI through the `{node-lore}` placeholder in `gui/skill-tree.yml`. If you want to fully customize the lore each node has, you can include in it all the placeholders that are used for the node item lore in `gui/skill-tree.yml` (`{current-level}`, `{current-state}`, `{max-level}`...).
zh: `lore`通过`gui/skill-tree.yml`中的`{node-lore}`占位符显示在skill-treeGUI中。如果要完全自定义每个节点具有的描述，你可以将用于`gui/skill-tree.yml`中的节点物品描述的所有占位符包含在其中（`{current-level}`、`{current-state}`、`{max-level}`...）。

source: Root Nodes
zh: 根节点

source: Root nodes are the first nodes to be unlocked in a skill tree. Note that skill trees should have at least one root node. To mark a node as a skill tree root, use the following syntax:
zh: 根节点是技能树中第一个解锁的节点。请注意，技能树应至少有一个根节点。要将节点标记为技能树根，请使用以下语法：

source: > It is possible for skill trees to have no root nodes, if you make sure some quest or event in your storyline unlocks the first skill tree node, through the use of a command for instance.
zh: > 如果你确保故事情节中的某些任务或事件通过使用命令等方式解锁第一个技能树节点，则技能树可能没有根节点。

source: Permission Required
zh: 权限必填

source: The option `permission-required` mandates that the corresponding permission is required to unlock the skill tree node. If this option is left unfilled, there will be no restrictions on permission to advance and unlock the skill tree node.
zh: 选项`permission-required`要求需要相应的权限才能解锁技能树节点。如果该选项不填，则权限晋级并解锁技能树节点将不受限制。

source: Maximum Children
zh: 最大子女数

source: Nodes work under a parent/children system. A node may only be available if all (or at least N) of its parents are unlocked. The `max-children` option allows you to limit the number of unlocked children a parent node can have.
zh: 节点在父/子系统下工作。一个节点只有在其所有（或至少 N 个）父节点都被解锁时才可用。`max-children`选项允许你限制父节点可以拥有的未锁定子节点的数量。

source: This has the effect of creating a fork in the skill tree, where players need to choose between two different play styles.
zh: 这具有在技能树中创建分叉的效果，其中玩家需要在两种不同的游戏风格之间进行选择。

source: In the following example, the node `a1` has two children `a2` and `a3`. Since `max-children` is set to 1, the player can only unlock one of the two. As soon as the player unlocks any of the two, the other will be permanently locked (until a respec).
zh: 在以下示例中，节点`a1`有两个子节点`a2`和`a3`。由于`max-children`设置为1，因此玩家只能解锁两者之一。一旦玩家解锁两者中的任何一个，另一个将被永久锁定（直到重新规范）。

source: Each node has an experience table associated with it. More info about [Experience Tables](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/tables).
zh: 每个节点都有一个与其关联的经验表。有关 [体验表](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/tables)] 的更多信息。

source: Node Display Options
zh: 节点显示选项

source: The optional field `display` enables you to have a specific icon for the node depending on its state.
zh: 可选字段`display`使你能够根据节点的状态获得特定的图标。

source: Max Level
zh: 最高等级

source: This is the maximum level you can reach for this skill tree node.
zh: 这是此技能树节点可以达到的最高等级。

source: Points Consumed
zh: 消耗积分

source: The optional field `point-consumed` lets you set the number of skill tree points required to upgrade this skill tree node. It defaults to 1.
zh: 可选字段`point-consumed`允许你设置升级此技能树节点所需的技能树点数。默认为1。

source: Paths
zh: 路径

source: "Paths" are the connections in between nodes. They are only for visual representation, as players cannot directly interact with paths.
zh: “路径”是节点之间的连接。它们仅用于视觉表示，因为玩家无法直接与路径交互。

source: Any pair of (node, child) can have a path. A path consists in list of grid coordinates, that it should occupy inside the chest inventory.
zh: 任何一对（节点，子节点）都可以有一条路径。路径由网格坐标列表组成，它应该占据箱子物品栏内。

source: States
zh: 州

source: A path can exist in three different states, which will modify its appearance. More information about these icons can be found [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/skill-trees#node-display-options). A path is considered "unlocked" if both of the nodes it connects are also unlocked. If one of the two nodes is fully locked, the path is considered "fully-locked." Otherwise, the path is simply "locked."
zh: 路径可以存在三种不同的状态，这将改变其外观。有关这些图标的更多信息可以在 [此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/skill-trees#node-display-options)] 找到。如果一条路径连接的两个节点也都未锁定，则该路径被视为“未锁定”。如果两个节点之一完全锁定，则该路径被视为“fully-locked”。否则，路径就被“锁定”。

source: Example
zh: 示例

source: In the following example, the node `a1` has two children `a2` and `a3`. The `a1` to `a2` path occupies all grid coordinates in between these two nodes (same for `x=1,y=0` and `x=2,y=0`). Same for the path from `a1` to `a3`.
zh: 在以下示例中，节点`a1`有两个子节点`a2`和`a3`。`a1`到`a2`路径占据这两个节点之间的所有网格坐标（对于`x=1,y=0`和`x=2,y=0`相同）。从`a1`到`a3`的路径相同。

source: Paths can take turn but cannot split. You cannot have one node linked to multiple other nodes using a single path. You must have one path per (node, parent) pair.
zh: 路径可以轮流但不能分开。你不能使用单一路径将一个节点链接到多个其他节点。每对（节点、父节点）必须有一个路径。

source: Icons
zh: 图标

source: You have the ability to fully customize the appearance of the skill tree graphical user interface (GUI) by creating different displays for each possible node or path configuration. To make these changes, you can modify the file located in `gui/skill-tree.yml`, which will automatically select the appropriate display for each node or path. This configuration can also be done in each skill-tree config in order to have different GUI display for each skill-tree. As stated above each node can have its own look by filling the display section for it.
zh: 你可以通过为每个可能的节点或路径配置创建不同的显示来完全自定义技能树图形用户界面 (GUI) 的外观。要进行这些更改，你可以修改位于`gui/skill-tree.yml`中的文件，该文件将自动为每个节点或路径选择适当的显示。此配置也可以在每个skill-tree配置中完成，以便为每个skill-tree提供不同的GUI显示。如上所述，每个节点都可以通过填充其显示部分来拥有自己的外观。

source: Here is how the display will be chosen for a node / path:
zh: 以下是如何选择节点/路径的显示：

source: If it is a node and has a specific display corresponding to its state then this will be its display.
zh: 如果它是一个节点并且具有与其状态相对应的特定显示，那么这将是其显示。

source: Else if there is a display in the skill tree config it will take it.
zh: 否则，如果技能树配置中有显示，它将采用它。

source: Else it will take the display specified in `gui/skill-tree.yml`.
zh: 否则它将采用`gui/skill-tree.yml`中指定的显示。

source: Let's now dive in how the display section works in the skill-tree config and `gui/skill-tree.yml`:
zh: 现在让我们深入了解显示部分在skill-tree配置和`gui/skill-tree.yml`中的工作原理：

source: The display of a node/ path depends on both its neighborhood and its state. You can for example define a display for each node in the unlocked state and with 2 path at its left and right by being in nodes.unlocked.right-left.
zh: 节点/路径的显示取决于其邻域及其状态。例如，你可以通过位于nodes.unlocked.right-left中为处于解锁状态的每个节点定义显示，并在其左侧和右侧使用2路径。

source: The process is exactly the same for paths with 4 possible state for each path:
zh: 对于每条路径具有4可能状态的路径，该过程完全相同：

source: Unlocked if the 2 node it links are unlocked.
zh: 如果其链接的2节点已解锁，则解锁。

source: Unlockable if one node is unlocked while the other is unlockable.
zh: 如果一个节点已解锁，而另一节点也可解锁，则可解锁。

source: Locked if one of the 2 nodes is locked.
zh: 如果2节点之一被锁定，则锁定。

source: Fully locked if one of the 2 nodes is fully locked.
zh: 如果2节点之一完全锁定，则完全锁定。

source: The neighborhood also impacts the display of a path. For instance, if a path has a branch that goes up and ones that goes right, it will take the item associated with "up," followed by "down-right," and finally "right." This is a symmetrical process, so if a path goes left and then down, it will look identical.
zh: 邻域也会影响路径的显示。例如，如果一条路径有一个向上的分支和一个向右的分支，则它将采用与“向上”关联的物品，然后是“down-right”，最后是“向右”。这是一个对称的过程，因此如果路径向左然后向下，它看起来会是相同的。

source: The same rule applies for nodes. For example, if a node is surrounded by four paths, it will display the "up-right-down-left" configuration. Alternatively, if a node has only three paths (up, left, and right), it will automatically select the "up-right-left" display.
zh: 同样的规则适用于节点。例如，如果一个节点被四个路径包围，它将显示“up-right-down-left”配置。或者，如果节点只有三个路径（上、左、右），它将自动选择“up-right-left”显示。

source: Skill Tree GUI
zh: 技能树GUI

source: There are 2 ways of opening a skill tree UI:
zh: 打开技能树UI 的2方式有：

source: The first option is to use `/skilltrees`, which will open the GUI using the `gui/skill-tree.yml` configuration file. It allows you to browse through each skill tree within the GUI. You can enable or disable this feature by modifying the `enable-global-skill-tree-gui` field in the `config.yml` file.
zh: 第一个选项是使用`/skilltrees`，它将使用`gui/skill-tree.yml`配置文件打开GUI。它允许你浏览GUI中的每个技能树。你可以通过修改`config.yml`文件中的`enable-global-skill-tree-gui`字段来启用或禁用此功能。

source: The second option is to use `/skilltrees` to open a specific skill tree without the ability to browse between skill trees. This will utilize the GUI configuration file from `gui/specific-skill-tree/specific-skill-tree-<skill-tree-id>.yml`. Make sure that your skill tree IDs follow the YAML format to avoid any issues. If no configuration is found, it will load the GUI from `gui/specific-skill-tree/specific-skill-tree-default.yml`. You can also toggle this feature on or off by modifying the `enable-specific-skill-tree-gui` field in the `config.yml` file.
zh: 第二种选择是使用`/skilltrees`打开特定的技能树，而无法在技能树之间进行浏览。这将利用`gui/specific-skill-tree/specific-skill-tree-<skill-tree-id>.yml`中的GUI配置文件。确保你的技能树ID 遵循YAML格式，以避免出现任何问题。如果没有找到配置，它将从`gui/specific-skill-tree/specific-skill-tree-default.yml`加载GUI。你还可以通过修改`config.yml`文件中的`enable-specific-skill-tree-gui`字段来打开或关闭此功能。

source: Skill Tree Types (MMOCore 1.21.1+)
zh: 技能树类型 (MMOCore1.21.1+)

source: There are currently two types of skill trees. Using some type or another does not add, nor remove any feature from your skill tree, it only makes it easier to setup skill trees in certain scenarios, since skill tree config files can quickly get big.
zh: 目前有两种型号的技能树。使用某种类型不会添加或删除技能树中的任何功能，它只会使在某些情况下设置技能树变得更容易，因为技能树配置文件很快就会变大。

source: Custom Skill Trees
zh: 定制技能树

source: If you don't specify the `type` option for a skill tree, it will be set to `CUSTOM` by default. When using a custom skill tree, you need to manually provide all relations between skill tree nodes, as well as the location of all the paths between the nodes. In order to create a custom skill tree, simply use the following syntax:
zh: 如果你没有为技能树指定`type`选项，则默认情况下它将设置为`CUSTOM`。当使用自定义技能树时，你需要手动提供技能树节点之间的所有关系，以及节点之间所有路径的位置。为了创建自定义技能树，只需使用以下语法：

source: MMOCore will automatically infer that skill tree nodes with NO parents whatsoever are root nodes.
zh: MMOCore将自动推断没有父节点的技能树节点是根节点。

source: Proximity Skill trees
zh: 接近技能树

source: Proximity skill trees are a simplified version of custom skill trees where you sometimes don't need to provide parenting relations between the nodes. In order to create a proximity skill tree, change the `type` config option to `PROXIMITY` inside your skill tree config file.
zh: Proximity技能树是自定义技能树的简化版本，有时你不需要提供节点之间的父子关系。为了创建邻近技能树，请将技能树配置文件中的`type`配置选项更改为`PROXIMITY`。

source: Any two neighboring nodes are automatically marked as soft parents. In other words, leveling up any node automatically unlocks the neighboring nodes. Every skill tree node has four direct neighbors (up, down, left and right neighbor).
zh: 任何两个相邻节点都会自动标记为软父节点。换句话说，升级任何节点都会自动解锁相邻节点。每个技能树节点有四个直接邻居（上、下、左、右邻居）。

source: When setting up a proximity skill tree, you can still make use of custom soft/hard/incompatible node parenting rules as well as paths. Using a proximity skill tree simply gives you a skeleton for your skill tree and spares you some syntax.
zh: 设置邻近技能树时，你仍然可以使用自定义软/硬/不兼容节点父子关系规则以及路径。使用邻近技能树可以简单地为你提供技能树的骨架，并为你节省一些语法。

source: <summary>Defining parents inside a proximity skill tree</summary>
zh: <summary>定义邻近区域内的父项技能树</summary>

source: It is impossible for MMOCore to infer skill tree roots from a linked skill tree, because every non-isolated skill tree node has at least one parent/child node. For this reason, you need to specify at least one root node manually in your proximity skill tree! As a reminder, this is done using the following option:

source: 💪 Player Stats
zh: 💪玩家属性

source: Player statistics are essential in MMOCore. They can be granted by classes, attributes, party buffs, temporary skills, items... For better compatibility, MMOItems shares its stat system with MMOCore, so any stat that can be found in MMOItems can be used inside of MMOCore.
zh: 玩家属性是 MMOCore 的基础，可以由职业、基础属性、队伍增益、临时技能和物品等提供。为便于兼容，MMOItems 与 MMOCore 共用属性系统，因此 MMOItems 中的任意属性都可以用于 MMOCore。

source: 📌 Waypoints
zh: 📌 航点

source: Waypoints are a way for players to save their world exploration progression. Waypoints are configurable spots in your worlds that can link together as a player unlocks them to create a form of fast travel system. They can be unlocked crouching while standing on them. Each waypoint is linked to others waypoints with a cost corresponding to it. You can travel between 2 waypoints if they are linked and if you unlocked them.
zh: 航点是玩家保存世界探索进度的一种方式。航路点是你世界中的可配置点，当玩家解锁它们时，它们可以连接在一起以创建一种快速旅行系统。他们可以蹲着站在上面解锁。每个航点都与其他航点链接，并具有相应的成本。如果2航路点已链接​​并且你已解锁，则你可以在它们之间旅行。

source: By default a player has no waypoints unlocked, but as the player explores the world and discovers waypoints A, B, and D, the player may **fast travel** between those waypoints. If the player has not discovered waypoint C, then the player will not see it or be able to fast travel to it. When standing on/near a waypoint, you simply shift to open up the fast travel menu.
zh: 默认情况下，玩家没有解锁航点，但当玩家探索世界并发现航点 A、B 和 D 时，玩家可能会在这些航点之间**快速旅行**。如果玩家尚未发现航路点 C，则玩家将看不到它或无法快速行进至该航点。当站在航点上/附近时，你只需移动即可打开快速旅行菜单。

source: Traveling using waypoints costs **Stellium**, which is a resource just like mana but which regenerates much slower. Stellium is used to balance waypoints.
zh: 使用路径点旅行需要花费 **Stellium**，这是一种类似于魔力的资源，但再生速度要慢得多。 Sttellium 用于平衡航路点。

source: Waypoint List
zh: 航点列表

source: Players may open the waypoints menu by using `/waypoints` This menu displays all registered waypoints, including locked ones. Unlocked waypoints are displayed using an ender eye. This menu can only be used to visualize waypoints, indeed waypoints may only be used when standing on a waypoint and crouching: the same menu will open, however the waypoint you are standing on will be highlighted (using the vanilla glowing effect) and you will be able to use your stellium to teleport to any waypoint.
zh: 玩家可以使用`/waypoints`打开航点菜单。该菜单显示所有注册的航点，包括锁定的航点。解锁的航路点使用末影之眼显示。此菜单只能用于可视化航路点，实际上航路点只能在站在航路点上并蹲下时使用：将打开相同的菜单，但你所站立的航路点将突出显示（使用原版发光效果），并且你将能够使用你的星群传送到任何航路点。

source: ![PH1gn4w](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/waypoint_0.C5QX9ILv.png)
zh: ![PH1gn4w](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/waypoint_0.C5QX9ILv.png)

source: There is a **cool animation** for unlocking and teleporting to an existing waypoint as well, with sound effects.
zh: 还有一个**很酷的动画**，用于解锁和传送到现有的路径点，并带有声音效果。

source: Disabling Waypoints
zh: 禁用航点

source: MMOCore waypoints are an optional feature. If you don't want to use it, follow these steps:
zh: MMOCore航路点是可选功能。如果你不想使用它，请按照下列步骤操作：

source: empty the `/waypoints` folder (do not delete it or it will regenerate),
zh: 清空`/waypoints`文件夹（不要删除它，否则它将重新生成），

source: comment out the `/waypoints` command section inside `MMOCore/commands.yml` to disable the waypoint UI command.
zh: 注释掉`MMOCore/commands.yml`内的`/waypoints`命令部分以禁用 waypoint UI 命令。

source: Waypoint Config Example
zh: 航点配置示例

source: The `/waypoints` folder is where you can place as many YML files/subfolders as you want to register new waypoints.
zh: 你可以在`/waypoints`文件夹中放置任意数量的 YML 文件/子文件夹，以注册新的航路点。

source: <summary>Full Config Example</summary>
zh: <summary>完整配置示例</summary>

source: | Option | Description |
zh: |选项 |描述 |

source: | Name | Name displayed for the waypoint in the `/waypoints` menu. This is different than the internal ID which is only used for config purposes. |
zh: |名称 |`/waypoints`菜单中显示的航路点名称。这与仅用于配置目的的内部ID不同。 |

source: | Location | This is where you define where the waypoint block is. Your options are WORLD, X, Y, Z, PITCH, YAW. Yaw and pitch define the player's camera orientation. |
zh: |地点 |你可以在此处定义航路点块的位置。你的选项有世界、X、Y、Z、俯仰、偏航。偏航和俯仰定义了玩家的相机方向。 |

source: | Radius | This defines how close a player has to be to the source waypoint block to shift and unlock it. Radius is in blocks, and 5 blocks means that if a player shifts anywhere within 5 blocks of the waypoint, they will unlock it. It should somewhere near half the diameter of the monument/shrine/.. which serves as physical waypoint. |
zh: |半径 |这定义了玩家必须距离源航路点块多近才能移动和解锁它。半径以块为单位，5块意味着如果玩家在航路点的5块内移动任何位置，它们将解锁它。它应该接近纪念碑/神殿/.. 直径的一半，作为物理路径点。 |

source: | Default | Whether or not this waypoint is unlocked by default. |
zh: |默认 |该航点是否默认解锁。 |

source: | Dynamic | See [below](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/waypoints#dynamic-waypoints). |
zh: |动态 |参见[下面的](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/waypoints#dynamic-waypoints)。 |

source: | Enable Menu | When set to `true`, sneaking on the waypoint will open up the waypoint teleportation menu. |
zh: |启用菜单|当设置为`true`时，潜行在航点上将打开航点传送菜单。 |

source: | Unlockable | When set to `true`, players will unlock that waypoint by crouching on the waypoint location. |
zh: |可解锁|当设置为`true`时，玩家将通过蹲伏在航路点位置来解锁该航路点。 |

source: | Destinations | The list of other waypoints you can jump to when standing on your waypoint. Each neighbor waypoint is associated with the cost (in stellium) of the A -> B waypoint travel. |
zh: |目的地 |当你站在航点上时可以跳转到的其他航点列表。每个相邻航路点都与 A -> B 航路点行程的成本（以星群为单位）相关联。 |

source: Dynamic Waypoints
zh: 动态航路点

source: Dynamic waypoints can be used anywhere on the map when opening the waypoints menu. Any player can teleport to a dynamic waypoint at any time, they don't need to be standing on any waypoint.
zh: 打开航点菜单时，可以在地图上的任何位置使用动态航点。任何玩家都可以随时传送到动态路径点，它们不需要站在任何路径点上。

source: Waypoint Link Reciprocity
zh: 航点链接互易

source: By default, Waypoint A being linked to waypoint B does not mean B is linked to A. In other words, waypoint connections are not reciprocal, unless you toggle on the following option inside the MMOCore `config.yml`:
zh: 默认情况下，航点 A 链接到航点 B 并不意味着 B 链接到 A。换句话说，航点连接不是相互的，除非你在MMOCore`config.yml`内切换以下选项：

source: This option applies to all waypoints.
zh: 此选项适用于所有航点。

source: Waypoint Books
zh: 航点书籍

source: Waypoint books can be given to players using the following command.
zh: 可以使用以下命令将航点书籍提供给玩家。

source: When right clicked, the book will be consumed, unlocking the specified waypoint. You can change how the item looks in the `items.yml` config file.
zh: 右键单击时，书籍将被消耗，解锁指定的路径点。你可以在`items.yml`配置文件中更改物品的外观。

source: Waypoint Path Calculation
zh: 航点路径计算

source: When enabling this option in the main MMOCore plugin config file, MMOCore will perform automatic path calculation across the waypoints that the player has collected.
zh: 当在主MMOCore插件配置文件中启用此选项时，MMOCore将在玩家收集的航路点上执行自动路径计算。

source: Let's take the following scenario:
zh: 让我们考虑以下场景：

source: Player is standing at waypoint A. They would like to teleport to waypoint C
zh: 玩家正站在航点 A。他们想要传送到航点 C

source: Waypoint A is not directly connected to waypoint C
zh: 航点 A 未直接连接至航点 C

source: Waypoint A is connected to an intermediate waypoint B, and B is connected to C
zh: 航点 A 连接到中间航点 B，B 连接到 C

source: Even if waypoint A is not directly linked to waypoint C, MMOCore will look through the entire waypoint map and find the path A -> B -> C, rendering waypoint C accessible. MMOCore always finds the shortest paths between waypoints, and takes into account dynamic waypoints.
zh: 即使航点 A 没有直接链接到航点 C，MMOCore也会遍历整个航点地图并找到路径 A -> B -> C，从而使航点 C 可访问。MMOCore始终找到航路点之间的最短路径，并考虑动态航路点。

source: 🦾 Modularity
zh: 🦾 模块化

source: MMOCore is a modular plugin: it has specific modules you can choose to keep or to throw away. For instance, you can choose to use the default MMOCore party system, or choose another plugin - as long as it's supported by MMOCore - and the integration will be flawless. MMOCore provides the core features for your RPG server (classes, skills, leveling and professions) but it is definitely best used along with other RPG plugins like quest and guild solutions.
zh: MMOCore是一个模块化插件：它具有你可以选择保留或丢弃的特定模块。例如，你可以选择使用默认的MMOCore队伍系统，或者选择其他插件 - 只要MMOCore支持 - 并且集成将是完美的。MMOCore为你的RPG服务器提供核心功能（职业、技能、升级和副职业），但它绝对最好与其他RPG插件（如任务和公会解决方案）一起使用。

source: Currently MMOCore has modules for quests, parties, guilds, skill creation. Modularity is great because you can still use the default MMOCore module if you want, while more advanced users can switch to their favourite and more advanced plugins, allowing for much more configurability

source: > Note that MMOCore comes with a basic set of existing classes, attributes, quests... There are many examples provided to help you get started, but you will need to configure the plugin mostly yourself.
zh: > MMOCore 自带基础的职业、基础属性和任务等配置，也提供了许多入门示例。不过，插件的大部分内容仍需要自行配置。

source: Navigate to the next page when you are ready to install MMOCore!
zh: 当你准备好安装MMOCore时，导航到下一页！

source: 🔌 Installation Guide
zh: 🔌 安装指南

source: Many plugin issues are due to an invalid installations, so make sure you read the following tutorial to spare some time debugging!
zh: 许多插件问题都是由于无效安装造成的，因此请务必阅读以下教程，以腾出一些时间进行调试！

source: Make sure you install [MythicLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/mythiclib.90306/) first
zh: 确保先安装[MythicLib](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/mythiclib.90306/)

source: Drag & drop the downloaded MMOCore file in your plugin folder.
zh: 将下载的MMOCore文件拖放到插件文件夹中。

source: Restart your server to generate default config files.
zh: 重新启动服务器以生成默认配置文件。

source: **UNINSTALL the MMOMana addon for MMOItems if you have it installed**, it is not meant to be used alongside any plugin that already has mana (like MMOCore).
zh: **如果安装了MMOItems的 MMOMana 插件，请卸载它**，它不适合与任何已安装魔力的插件（例如MMOCore）一起使用。

source: MMOCore comes with default configs showcasing various compatibility features related to other plugins, including WorldGuard, Citizens, MythicMobs, MMOItems... If these plugins are not installed, you will get some startup warnings in your console, which is completely normal. Take your time to explore these features and install the required plugins if you want to use them.
zh: MMOCore附带的默认配置展示了与其他插件相关的各种兼容性功能，包括WorldGuard、Citizens、MythicMobs、MMOItems...如果未安装这些插件，你将在控制台中收到一些启动警告，这是完全正常的。如果你想使用它们，请花些时间探索这些功能并安装所需的插件。

source: ⭐ Experience Boosters
zh: ⭐ 经验助推器

source: Admins can use a [command](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/commands) to create EXP boosters that apply to all players on the server! Using the `/mmocore booster create` command, you can specify how much extra % EXP players will earn, and even **which profession** the booster applies for.
zh: 管理员可以使用[命令](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/commands)来创建适用于服务器上所有玩家的经验增强器！使用`/mmocore booster create`命令，你可以指定经验玩家将获得多少额外百分比，甚至可以指定助推器适用于哪个副职业**。

source: Compatibility Options
zh: 兼容性选项

source: This type of EXP Boosters is 100% EULA compliant. The best way to utilize these boosters is to create items with this command bound to right clicks, in order to have consumables that apply EXP boosts for all players currently connected!
zh: 这种类型的 EXP 助推器符合100%EULA 标准。利用这些助推器的最佳方法是创建物品并将此命令绑定到右键单击，以便消耗品为当前连接的所有玩家应用 EXP 助推器！

source: The `/mmocore booster create` command has an optional `player` parameter that you can use to specify the booster creator. This way, other players can see who activated the EXP booster.
zh: `/mmocore booster create`命令有一个可选的`player`参数，你可以使用该参数指定助推器创建者。这样，其他玩家就可以看到谁激活了 EXP 增强器。

source: When a booster is created, a message is broadcast in the entire server. It can be edited in the `messages.yml` config file.
zh: 创建助推器后，会在整个服务器中广播一条消息。可以在`messages.yml`配置文件中进行编辑。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/boost_new.D_QFWXoS.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/boost_new.D_QFWXoS.png)

source: Currently Active Boosters
zh: 目前活跃的助推器

source: Active boosters are displayed in the player stats menu which you can access using `/player` as seen on the following screenshot. Players can see the time left before the booster expires, who created the booster, and potentially the profession which the booster applies for.
zh: 活动助推器显示在玩家属性菜单中，你可以使用`/player`访问该菜单，如以下屏幕截图所示。玩家可以看到助推器到期前剩余的时间、谁创建了该助推器，以及可能是该助推器申请的副职业。

source: ![1DqLp7S](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/boost_ui.Bm71TL2L.png)
zh: ![1DqLp7S](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/boost_ui.Bm71TL2L.png)

source: 📈 Experience Curves
zh: 📈 经验曲线

source: Experience curves allow you to define how much experience a player needs in order to level up. Both [professions](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/intro) and [classes](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes) have experience curves.
zh: 经验曲线允许你定义玩家需要多少经验才能增加等级。 [副职业](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/intro)和 [职业](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes)都有经验曲线。

source: Basic Config
zh: 基本配置

source: All exp curves can be found under the `/MMOCore/exp-curves` folder. You can setup an exp curve by creating a `.txt` file with the following format:
zh: 所有exp曲线都可以在`/MMOCore/exp-curves`文件夹下找到。你可以通过创建具有以下格式的`.txt`文件来设置 exp 曲线：

source: The first line says how much exp a player needs in order to reach level 2, second line for level 3 and so on. Exp curves are **NOT cumulative**, they indicate the amount of experience needed to level up, regardless of how many levels the player has already reached.
zh: 第一行表示玩家需要多少经验才能达到2等级，第二行表示3等级，依此类推。经验曲线**不是累积的**，它们表示升级所需的经验量，无论玩家已经达到多少等级。

source: If your exp curve file is called `exp-curves/levels.txt`, you can assign it to a class or profession by using the following syntax. This works for both professions and classes:
zh: 如果你的经验曲线文件名为`exp-curves/levels.txt`，你可以使用以下语法将其分配给职业或副职业。这适用于副职业和职业：

source: Generating an EXP curve using Excel
zh: 使用 Excel 生成 EXP 曲线

source: Using Excel (you can use it for free online on the Microsoft website) you can easily generate a MMOCore exp curve **if you have a formula of needed exp as a function of the player level**.
zh: 使用 Excel（你可以在 Microsoft 网站上免费在线使用它），你可以轻松生成MMOCoreexp 曲线**如果你有所需 exp 的公式作为玩家等级的函数**。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/curve_excel_0.R7O7bzFU.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/curve_excel_0.R7O7bzFU.png)

source: On Excel, you can use the `ROW(CELL_NAME)` function to retrieve the cell line number. You can therefore, for instance, use this formula: `= 100 + ROW(A1) * 30` and duplicate the cell all the way down to generate a list of numbers which correspond to the amount of experience needed to reach the n-th level.
zh: 在 Excel 上，你可以使用`ROW(CELL_NAME)`函数检索单元格行号。因此，例如，你可以使用以下公式：`= 100 + ROW(A1) * 30`并一直向下复制单元格以生成与达到n-th等级所需的经验量相对应的数字列表。

source: Once you have this setup, save/export your file as a `.txt` file using the `Text (tab separator)` file type. Make sure there is only one column so that no separator appears in the resulting text file.
zh: 完成此设置后，使用`Text (tab separator)`文件类型将文件保存/导出为`.txt`文件。确保只有一列，以便生成的文本文件中不会出现分隔符。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/curve_excel_1.B-2NSFSC.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/curve_excel_1.B-2NSFSC.png)

source: Curves as Formulas
zh: 曲线作为公式

source: Instead of using a text file located in the `/MMOCore/exp-curves` folder, you can also define exp curves using mathematical formulas to reduce the number of files required.
zh: 你还可以使用数学公式定义 exp 曲线，以减少所需的文件数量，而不是使用位于`/MMOCore/exp-curves`文件夹中的文本文件。

source: Inside of your class/profession config, use the following syntax:
zh: 在职业/副职业配置内部，使用以下语法：

source: The `{level}` placeholder will be replaced by the target level number when calculating the required exp. This formula also supports PAPI placeholders. Basic math functions like `min`, `max`, `sqrt`... are supported. If the formula happens to return a decimal number, it will be rounded down to the nearest integer.
zh: 计算所需经验值时，`{level}`占位符将被替换为目标等级数。此公式还支持 PAPI占位符。支持基本数学函数，如`min`、`max`、`sqrt`...。如果公式恰好返回小数，则会向下舍入到最接近的整数。

source: Exp Level Overflow
zh: 经验值溢出

source: If the player has more than the required amount of exp when reaching a new level, the remaining exp is kept and applied towards the next level. For this reason, a player can level up multiple times in one go, if provided with enough exp points.
zh: 如果玩家在达到新等级时拥有超过所需的经验值，则剩余的经验值将被保留并应用于下一个等级。因此，如果有足够的经验值，玩家可以一次性升级多次。

source: Experience & Levels
zh: 经验和等级

source: 🪴 Experience Sources
zh: 🪴经验来源

source: An experience source gives you experience for certain professions when certain events occur. Each experience source has its own specific parameters that you can specify in the config with `exp_source_name{param1=P1;param2=p2..}`. You must specify the parameter `amount=min-max` corresponding to the bounds between which the amount of experience will be randomly chosen each time.
zh: 当某些事件发生时，经验源为你提供针对某些副职业的经验。每个经验源都有其自己的特定参数，你可以在配置中使用`exp_source_name{param1=P1;param2=p2..}`指定这些参数。你必须指定与边界相对应的参数`amount=min-max`，每次都会在该边界之间随机选择经验的数量。

source: You can also use experience sources for your main classes.
zh: 你还可以将经验源用于主职业。

source: Examples
zh: 示例

source: Let's have a look at an example. These are the default experience sources for the *Woodcutting* profession. It basically gives the player anywhere from 1 to 3 experience points whenever he cuts a log.
zh: 以下是*伐木（Woodcutting）*副职业的默认经验来源。玩家每砍掉一个原木，就会获得 1 到 3 点经验。

source: These are the default experience sources for the farming profession, which grants some experience points whenever the player harvests any type of crops.
zh: 这些是农业副职业的默认经验来源，每当玩家收获任何类型的农作物时，都会授予一些经验积分。

source: `crop=true` means that it'll only grant EXP once it's at its full growth stage. `player-placed=true` means that it'll grant EXP even if the player placed the block
zh: `crop=true`表示只有在完全成长阶段才会给予经验值。`player-placed=true`意味着即使玩家放置了方块，它也会授予 EXP

source: Experience Sources Tables
zh: 经验来源表

source: You can create experiences-sources tables in `exp-sources.yml`. This file allows you to create list of exp sources that you can use anywhere else in the plugin. Here is an example:
zh: 你可以在`exp-sources.yml`中创建experiences-sources表。该文件允许你创建可以在插件中的其他任何位置使用的 exp 源列表。这是一个例子：

source: Every experience source
zh: 每一个经验来源

source: From
zh: 从

source: Loads all the experience source in `exp-sources.yml` matching to `exp-source-id`.
zh: 加载`exp-sources.yml`中与`exp-source-id`匹配的所有经验源。

source: Mine Block
zh: 矿区

source: Get exp from mining specific blocks. More information in the [Mining](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining) wiki page.
zh: 从挖掘特定块中获取经验。更多信息请参见[挖矿](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining)wiki 页面。

source: Kill Mob
zh: 杀死暴民

source: Killing a mob grants exp. This will work on any vanilla mob.
zh: 杀死一个小怪可以获得经验值。这适用于任何原版生物。

source: Kill Mythic Mob
zh: 杀死神话暴民

source: Killing a MythicMob grants exp. You need to provide the ID of the mob using the `type` parameter.
zh: 杀死 MythicMob 可获得经验值。你需要使用`type`参数提供生物的ID。

source: Fish Item
zh: 鱼物品

source: Fishing an item of the specified type grants exp.
zh: 钓鱼指定类型的物品可获得经验值。

source: Smelt Item
zh: 冶炼物品

source: When an item is smelted (furnaces).
zh: 当物品被熔炼（熔炉）时。

source: Craft Item
zh: 工艺物品

source: When an item is crafted.
zh: 当制作物品时。

source: Brew potion
zh: 酿造药水

source: [More info on Alchemy](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/alchemy). You can specify multiple potion effects here, separated by a comma.
zh: [有关炼金术](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/alchemy)的更多信息。你可以在此处指定多个药水效果，以逗号分隔。

source: Place Block
zh: 放置块

source: Placing a block of the specified type grants xp.
zh: 放置指定类型的方块可获得 xp。

source: Repair Item
zh: 修复物品

source: You can define in `smithing.yml` the amount of xp for each material. More information in the [Smithing](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/smithing) wiki page.
zh: 你可以在`smithing.yml`中定义每种材料的 xp 数量。更多信息请参见 [Smithing](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/smithing)wiki 页面。

source: Enchant Item
zh: 附魔物品

source: Get exp when enchanting items. [More info on Enchanting](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/enchanting).
zh: 附魔物品时获得经验。 [有关迷人](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/profession/enchanting)的更多信息。

source: Climb
zh: 攀登

source: When you climb one block. The type can be `ladder`, `vines`, `weeping-vines`, `twisting-vines`. If you don't specify any type it will trigger for all types.
zh: 当你爬上一个街区时。型号可以是`ladder`、`vines`、`weeping-vines`、`twisting-vines`。如果你不指定任何类型，它将触发所有类型。

source: Eat
zh: 吃

source: Give experience when some specific food is eaten. If you don't specify a material for the type it will give exp disregarding what you eat.
zh: 提供食用某些特定食物时的经验。如果你没有指定该类型的材料，无论你吃什么，它都会给出exp。

source: Move
zh: 移动

source: Give experience for each block travelled, the type can be `sneak`, `fly`, `swim`, `sprint` or `walk`. If it is not specified will trigger all the time.
zh: 为每个行驶过的街区提供经验，类型可以是`sneak`、`fly`、`swim`、`sprint`或`walk`。如果不指定就会一直触发。

source: Resource
zh: 资源

source: Gives exp for each resource of type "RESOURCE_TYPE" consumed. Resource type can be `health`, `mana`, `stamina` or `stellium`.
zh: 给出消耗的每个“RESOURCE_TYPE”类型资源的exp。资源类型可以是`health`、`mana`、`stamina`或`stellium`。

source: Ride
zh: 骑行

source: When you move riding a certain entity. Check the [EntityType](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/entity/EntityType.html) enum to specify the type.
zh: 当你骑着某个实体移动时。检查 [EntityType](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/entity/EntityType.html)枚举以指定类型。

source: Tame
zh: 驯服

source: Exp given when taming mobs (like a wolf). Triggers once per click. `type` is optional, if not provided it applies to all mob types.
zh: 驯服小怪（如狼）时给出的经验值。每次点击触发一次。`type`是可选的，如果没有提供，它适用于所有生物类型。

source: Tamed Entity Damage
zh: 驯服实体伤害

source: Exp given when a tamed mob of yours deals damage. Amount of exp provided is multiplied by the final damage output. `type` is optional, if not provided it applies to all mob types.
zh: 当你的驯服小怪造成伤害时会给出经验值。提供的经验值乘以最终的伤害输出。`type`是可选的，如果没有提供，它适用于所有生物类型。

source: Damage Taken
zh: 受到的伤害

source: Exp given for each damage a player takes damage from a certain cause. Type can be `DROWNING`, `FALL`, `FIRE`, etc.... You can find the list of possible damage causes [here](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/event/entity/EntityDamageEvent.DamageCause.html).
zh: 玩家因某种原因受到伤害时给出的每次伤害的经验值。类型可以是`DROWNING`、`FALL`、`FIRE`等...你可以在 [此处](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/spigot/org/bukkit/event/entity/EntityDamageEvent.DamageCause.html)] 找到可能的损坏原因列表。

source: Damage Dealt
zh: 造成的伤害

source: Exp given per damage dealt of a certain MMO damage type. The damage type can be `magic`, `physical`, `weapon`, `skill`, `projectile`, `unarmed`, `on-hit`, `minion` or `dot`.
zh: 特定 MMO 伤害类型所造成的伤害所给出的经验值。损坏类型可以是`magic`、`physical`、`weapon`、`skill`、`projectile`、`unarmed`、`on-hit`、`minion`或`dot`。

source: 📋 Experience Tables
zh: 📋 经验表

source: This feature was introduced in MMOCore 1.8.3 and was designed to let players claim more complex rewards when leveling up their professions. Its primary function is to give players leveling rewards every N profession levels. You can also configure a claim chance for every "experience drop" to have extra randomness. Here is the default `exp-tables.yml` config file
zh: 此功能在MMOCore1.8.3中引入，旨在让玩家在升级提升其副职业时获得更复杂的奖励。其主要功能是给每 N 个副职业等级奖励玩家升级。你还可以为每个“经验drop”配置领取机会，以获得额外的随机性。这是默认的`exp-tables.yml`配置文件

source: An experience table is broken down into multiple *items* (there is one config section for every item inside an exp. table). An *item* is a set of rewards that has a X% chance of being claimed every Y profession levels. The `period` option (in levelups) indicates how frequently the item should be given to the player. The `chance` option determines the chance for the player to be given that item.
zh: 一张经验表被分解为多个 *物品* （经验表中的每个物品有一个配置部分）。 *物品* 是一组奖励，每 Y副职业等级有 X% 的机会被领取。`period`选项（在升级中）指示应将物品提供给玩家的频率。`chance`选项确定玩家被赋予物品的机会。

source: You can edit the rewards of an item by adding or removing triggers to the list identified by `triggers`. You can find [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers) the list of all of the available triggers that you can use inside of exp tables.
zh: 你可以通过向`triggers`标识的列表添加或删除触发器来编辑物品的奖励。你可以在[此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers)找到可在 exp 表内使用的所有可用触发器的列表。

source: First & Last Trigger
zh: 第一个和最后一个触发器

source: Using the `first-trigger` option, you can select a level that the player has to reach before claiming an item. If the first trigger level is set to 5 and the period is set to 10, the item will be claimed by level 5, 10, 15 etc. If you don't specify anything for that setting, it's set to the item period by default.
zh: 使用`first-trigger`选项，你可以选择玩家在领取物品之前必须达到的等级。如果第一个触发电平设置为5且周期设置为10，则物品将按等级5、10、15等声明。如果你没有为该设置指定任何内容，则将其设置为物品周期默认。

source: The `last-trigger` option allows you to limit the level at which the item can be dropped. If the last-trigger is set to 8 with a period of 2, the item will be claimed at level 2,4,6 and 8. If nothing is specified the last-trigger will be set to infinity (no-limitation).
zh: `last-trigger`选项允许你限制物品可以下降的等级。如果last-trigger设置为8，周期为2，则物品将在等级2、4、6和8被声明。如果未指定任何内容，则last-trigger将设置为无穷大 (no-limitation)。

source: If you want an item to be only claimable ONCE, set the period to 0.
zh: 如果你希望物品只能领取一次，请将期间设置为0。

source: Fixed Level
zh: 固定水平

source: By using the option `level: <some_integer>`, you can create an item that triggers at one specific level only. This can be used for more meticulous exp tables, or simply for unique rewards like unlocking a skill, a waypoint, etc.
zh: 通过使用选项`level: <some_integer>`，你可以创建仅在一个特定等级触发的物品。这可以用于更细致的经验表，或者仅仅用于独特的奖励，例如解锁技能、航路点等。

source: Fail Reduction
zh: 减少失败

source: If the player is unlucky and doesn't claim one of the items, the last option (`fail-reduction`) comes handy as it reduces the risk of further bad luck. Let's see how it works with an example: let's say an item claim chance is set to 60% and the fail reduction percentage is set to 50%. Setting it to 50% means that every levelup that fails at claiming the item will halve the remaining chance of not claiming it again. The successive claiming chances are then 60%, 80%, 90%, 95%, 97.5% (every time the distance to 100% gets halved).
zh: 如果玩家不走运并且没有认领物品之一，那么最后一个选项（`fail-reduction`）会派上用场，因为它降低了进一步坏运气的风险。让我们通过一个示例来看看它是如何工作的：假设物品索赔机会设置为60%，失败减少百分比设置为50%。将其设置为50%意味着每次未能领取物品的升级都会将剩余的未再次领取的机会减半。连续的领取机会是60%、80%、90%、95%、97.5%（每次到100%的距离减半）。

source: *For those of you familiar with mathematics the successive chances of failing describe a geometrical sequence*
zh: *对于那些熟悉数学的人来说，连续失败的机会描述了一个几何序列*

source: The `triggers` option is where you define what happens when that item is claimed. For maximum configurability, this is a list of [triggers](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers)... The triggers you will most often use are the `experience` and `command` triggers, exp to give experience to your main class, and commands to give rewards from other plugins (if required).
zh: `triggers`选项是你定义声明物品时发生的情况的位置。为了获得最大的可配置性，这是一个[触发器](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers)...你最常使用的触发器是`experience`和`command`触发器，经验将经验给你的主职业，以及从其他插件提供奖励的命令（如果需要）。

source: 📦 Block Types
zh: 📦 块类型

source: Block types are helpful to determine what happens (item drops, block regen..) when you [break a block](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining).
zh: 方块类型有助于确定当你[破坏方块](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining)时会发生什么（物品掉落、方块再生..）。

source: By distinguishing these block types MMOCore can apply different behaviours to them. Using player skulls with custom texture, you can setup small ore blocks which are a great addition for building. Using MI custom blocks you can have blocks with new textures, breaking speed and fully configurable drop tables.
zh: 通过区分这些块类型，MMOCore可以对它们应用不同的行为。使用具有自定义纹理的玩家头骨，你可以设置小矿石块，这对建筑来说是一个很好的补充。使用 MI 自定义块，你可以拥有具有新纹理、破坏速度和完全可配置的掉落表的块。

source: Available Block Types
zh: 可用的块类型

source: The following table provides all block types that are supported by the MMOCore custom mining system.
zh: 下表提供了MMOCore自定义挖矿系统支持的所有区块类型。

source: | Block Type | Description | Example |
zh: |块型 |描述 |示例|

source: | MMOItems Custom Block | When mining a MMOItems custom block. | `mmoitems{id=6}` |
zh: |MMOItems定制块 |当挖掘MMOItems自定义块时。 |`mmoitems{id=6}`|

source: | Player Head | When mining a player head with a custom texture. | `skull{value="aZd9fE8...48dfQX="}` |
zh: |玩家头 |当挖掘具有自定义纹理的玩家头时。 |`skull{value="aZd9fE8...48dfQX="}`|

source: | Noteblock | When mining a noteblock. | `note{note=1;instrument=PIANO}` |
zh: |笔记块 |挖掘音符块时。 |`note{note=1;instrument=PIANO}`|

source: | Mushroom Block | When mining a mushroom block. | `mushroom{type=MUSHROOM_STEM,faces="NORTH,EAST"}` |
zh: |蘑菇块|开采蘑菇块时。 |`mushroom{type=MUSHROOM_STEM,faces="NORTH,EAST"}`|

source: | Vanilla Block | When mining any other block. Fallback. | `vanilla{type=DIAMOND_ORE}` |
zh: |原版块 |开采任何其他区块时。倒退。 |`vanilla{type=DIAMOND_ORE}`|

source: Notes:
zh: 注意事项：

source: For player heads/skulls with textures, you need to provide the Base64 texture value of the skull, not the texture URL.
zh: 对于带有纹理的玩家头/头骨，你需要提供头骨的 Base64 纹理值，而不是纹理 URL。

source: For noteblocks, the note is from 1 to 24. The list of instruments can be found in the [Spigot javadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Instrument.html).
zh: 对于音符块，音符是从1到24。仪器列表可以在 [Spigotjavadocs](https://hub.spigotmc.org/javadocs/bukkit/org/bukkit/Instrument.html)中找到。

source: For mushroom blocks, possible types are `MUSHROOM_STEM`, `RED_MUSHROOM_BLOCK` and `BROWN_MUSHROOM_BLOCK`. Available faces are `UP`, `DOWN`, `NORTH`, `SOUTH`, `EAST`, `WEST`.
zh: 对于蘑菇块，可能的类型为`MUSHROOM_STEM`、`RED_MUSHROOM_BLOCK`和`BROWN_MUSHROOM_BLOCK`。可用面为`UP`、`DOWN`、`NORTH`、`SOUTH`、`EAST`、`WEST`。

source: Example config
zh: 配置示例

source: This is a small part of the default config for the Mining profession.
zh: 这是挖矿副职业默认配置的一小部分。

source: This config makes the vanilla emerald ore block drop 1 to 9 emeralds (and cancels vanilla drops), and replace it temporarily (100 seconds = 2.000 ticks) by a custom textured skull. This means you can also use these block types to choose what temporary block should be placed after breaking a specific block.
zh: 此配置使原版祖母绿矿石块掉落1为9祖母绿（并取消原版掉落），并用自定义纹理头骨暂时替换它（100秒 =2.000刻）。这意味着你还可以使用这些块类型来选择在破坏特定块后应放置哪些临时块。

source: You may use the `age` vanilla block type option to spawn back fully/partially grown crops using block regen. The following example would spawn back fully grown wheat crops after a wheat block is broken. `vanilla{type=WHEAT,age=7}`
zh: 你可以使用`age`原版块类型选项来使用块再生生成完全/部分生长的农作物。以下示例将在小麦块被破坏后重新生成完全生长的小麦作物。`vanilla{type=WHEAT,age=7}`

source: ✅ Conditions
zh: ✅ 条件

source: > This feature will be merged in a near future with MythicLib [script conditions](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/intro) (this update will be backwards compatible). This page will be deleted and moved over to the MythicLib wiki.
zh: > 此功能将在不久的将来与MythicLib[脚本条件](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/conditions/intro)合并（此更新将向后兼容）。该页面将被删除并移至MythicLibwiki。

source: Every drop table has the ability to be restricted with various conditions. This means that only players that meet all the requirements on a drop table will actually access it when performing an action. Here is a list of available conditions.
zh: 每个掉落表都可以受到各种条件的限制。这意味着只有满足删除表所有要求的玩家在执行操作时才会实际访问它。以下是可用条件的列表。

source: Conditions tables (Since 1.9.5)
zh: 条件表（自1.9.5起）

source: You can create condition tables in `conditions.yml`. You will then be able to reference an entire set of conditions at once using the `from` condition.
zh: 你可以在`conditions.yml`中创建条件表。然后，你将能够使用`from`条件立即引用一整套条件。

source: Available Conditions
zh: 可用条件

source: | Condition | Format |
zh: |状况 |格式|

source: | From | `from{source=condition-id}` |
zh: |来自 |`from{source=condition-id}`|

source: | Main Level | `level{amount=LEVEL_HERE}` |
zh: |主等级 |`level{amount=LEVEL_HERE}`|

source: | Profession Level | `level{profession=PROFESSION_NAME;amount=LEVEL_HERE}` |
zh: |副职业等级|`level{profession=PROFESSION_NAME;amount=LEVEL_HERE}`|

source: | Current Biome | `biome{name=BIOMES}` |
zh: |当前生物群系|`biome{name=BIOMES}`|

source: | Current World | `world{name=WORLD_NAME}` |
zh: |当前世界|`world{name=WORLD_NAME}`|

source: | Permission | `permission{node=PERMISSION_NODE}` |
zh: |权限|`permission{node=PERMISSION_NODE}`|

source: 💸 Economy
zh: 💸经济

source: MMOCore comes along with a RPG styled physical currency system which consists in two types of items: **bank notes** and **gold coins**. Gold coins are always worth 1 gold however bank notes can be worth anything. This currency system not only adds some RPG atmosphere to your server because they can be used to trade, but they can also be added to mob drop tables e.g using MythicMobs to make dropping gold easier.
zh: MMOCore附带RPG风格的物理货币系统，其中包含两种类型的物品：**纸币**和**金币**。金币总是价值1黄金，但纸币可以值任何东西。这个货币系统不仅可以为你的服务器添加一些RPG气氛，因为它们可以用于交易，而且还可以使用MythicMobs将它们添加到生物掉落表e.g中，以使掉落金币变得更容易。

source: Deposit
zh: 押金

source: Players can deposit their physical bank notes and gold coins directly into their Vault account. This can be used for instance like a bank safe where you can free some inventory space and yet still be able to use your digital Vault cash with NPCs.
zh: 玩家可以将他们的实物纸币和金币直接存入他们的Vault账户。例如，这可以像银行保险箱一样使用，你可以在其中释放一些物品栏空间，但仍然可以通过 NPC 使用你的数字Vault现金。

source: You can force open the deposit GUI using `/deposit <player>` or simply ask players to use `/deposit` if they have the `mmocore.currency` permission. Using extra plugins, you can also bind this command to specific blocks on right-click, for e.g enderchests, or even bind this command to NPCs using Citizens addons to make a Vault keeper NPC.
zh: 你可以使用`/deposit <player>`强制打开存款GUI，或者简单地要求玩家使用`/deposit`（如果他们有`mmocore.currency`权限）。使用额外的插件，你还可以将此命令绑定到right-click上的特定块（对于e.g渲染箱），甚至可以使用Citizens插件将此命令绑定到 NPC 以制作Vault守护者 NPC。

source: ![IDpIfft](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/deposit.CxVkBWvo.gif)
zh: ![IDpIft](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/deposit.CxVkBWvo.gif)

source: Withdraw
zh: 撤回

source: Withdrawing enables players to withdraw some Vault cash and get physical currencies for trading or in order to pay other players. You can start a withdraw request for a player using the `/withdraw <player>` command, or ask them to use `/withdraw` if they have the `mmocore.currency` permission.
zh: 提现使玩家可以提取部分Vault现金并获得实物货币用于交易或支付其他玩家。你可以使用`/withdraw <player>`命令启动玩家的提款请求，或者要求他们使用`/withdraw`（如果他们有`mmocore.currency`权限）。

source: When a withdraw request is started, players are asked to type in the chat the amount they would like to withdraw. When withdrawing $54, players will receive 4 gold coins worth $1 each, and a $50 bank note: `withdraw = <gold-coins> * 1 + <bank-notes> * 10`.
zh: 当提款请求开始时，玩家被要求在聊天中输入他们想要提款的金额。当提取$54时，玩家将获得每枚价值$1的4金币，以及一张$50钞票：`withdraw = <gold-coins> * 1 + <bank-notes> * 10`。

source: ![VNe2NPr](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/withdraw.DBBKbVhJ.gif)
zh: ![VNe2NPr](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/withdraw.DBBKbVhJ.gif)

source: Miscellaneous
zh: 杂项

source: 💖 Player Resources
zh: 💖玩家资源

source: There are four player resources in MMOCore, with different objectives. These resources regenerate over time.
zh: MMOCore中有四个玩家资源，具有不同的目标。这些资源会随着时间的推移而再生。

source: **health**
zh: **生命值**

source: **mana** and **stamina**, used to cast [skills](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro) and use items
zh: **魔力** 和 **耐力**，用于施放 [技能](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro)并使用物品

source: **stellium**, used for [waypoints](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/waypoints)
zh: **stellium**，用于[航点](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/waypoints)

source: Base Resource Regen
zh: 基础资源再生

source: MMOCore has **two** types of resource regen. First of all, every class has a base **flat** resource regeneration stat, for any of the four resource. For instance, *10 Stamina Regen* means that players regenerate 10 stamina points every second. If you toggle on the `off-combat-stamina-regen` class option, players will only regenerate that flat amount when they are out of combat.
zh: MMOCore有**两种**类型的资源再生。首先，每个职业都有一个基础 **扁平** 资源再生属性，适用于四种资源中的任何一个。例如，*10耐力Regen* 表示玩家每秒重新生成10耐力点。如果你打开`off-combat-stamina-regen`职业选项，玩家将仅在脱离战斗时重新生成固定金额。

source: Every class also has another regeneration stat, like `Max Health Regeneration` which is expressed in % max health per second. It is the percentage of your maximum health that you will regenerate every second. This second stat stacks up with the first regen.
zh: 每个职业还具有另一个再生属性，如`Max Health Regeneration`，以每秒 %最大生命值表示。它是你每秒重新生成的最大生命值的百分比。第二个属性与第一个再生叠加。

source: In the default MMOCore config, mages only regenerate their health when they are out of combat, *as they are rather weak and must concentrate to get their forces back*. Mages have a base regen of 0.13 health + 1% of their max health/sec.
zh: 在默认的MMOCore配置中，法师只有在脱离战斗时才会恢复生命值，*因为他们相当虚弱，必须集中精力才能恢复力量*。法师的基础回复值为0.13生命值 +1%的最大生命值/秒。

source: Special Resource Regen
zh: 特殊资源再生

source: This second type of resource regen in MMOCore can almost be considered a passive skill. Classes can be setup to have special type of resource regen, that scales on the player's amount of max/missing resource. This special resource regen can also be toggled off during combat.
zh: MMOCore中的第二种类型的资源再生几乎可以被认为是被动的技能。职业可以设置为具有特殊类型的资源再生，可根据玩家的最大/缺失资源量进行缩放。这种特殊的资源再生也可以在战斗中关闭。

source: This can be particularly useful if you want to develop new classes which have a special type of resource. For instance, warriors with *Rage* instead of *Mana*, can have their Rage slowly decrease when out of combat at a more flexible rate.
zh: 如果你想开发具有特殊类型资源的新职业，这可能特别有用。例如，拥有“怒气”而不是“魔力*”的战士，可以在脱离战斗时以更灵活的速度缓慢降低怒气。

source: The rate at which the resources regenerate (or is lost) can be configured as well. You can also make it so that regen does not apply when in combat, by toggling off the `off-combat` option. **Unlike the first type of resource regen, this one is completely independent of the items the player is wearing. It only depends on the player's level.**
zh: 资源再生（或丢失）的速率也可以配置。你还可以通过关闭`off-combat`选项来使再生在战斗中不适用。 **与第一种资源再生不同，这种资源再生完全独立于玩家佩戴的物品。它仅取决于玩家的等级。**

source: That would be a really OP melee fighting class where players would regen 10-20% of their maximum health (based on their current level) every second, when out of combat.
zh: 这是一个强度很高的近战职业：脱离战斗后，玩家每秒恢复最大生命值的 10–20%，具体比例取决于当前等级。

source: The `type` option is either `MAX` (scales with max resource) or `MISSING` (scales with missing resource) depending on what you want the resource regen to scale on. The `value` entry corresponds to the % of resource regenerated every second. You may use the `min` and `max` options to create bounded linear functions of the player level.
zh: `type`选项是`MAX`（根据最大资源进行缩放）或`MISSING`（根据缺失资源进行缩放），具体取决于你希望资源再生进行缩放的内容。`value`条目对应于每秒重新生成的资源的百分比。你可以使用`min`和`max`选项来创建玩家等级的有界线性函数。

source: ⚒️ Tool Restrictions
zh: ⚒️工具限制

source: This feature allows you to define what blocks every type of tool can mine. It can be very useful to further customize and balance your tools, when used alongside with the MMOCore [mining & block regen](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining) feature. The config file for this feature is `restrictions.yml`.
zh: 此功能允许你定义每种类型的工具可以挖掘哪些块。当与MMOCore[挖矿和区块再生](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining)功能一起使用时，它对于进一步自定义和平衡你的工具非常有用。此功能的配置文件是`restrictions.yml`。

source: By default, the config is setup only for mining and has all of the pickaxes included. You **CAN** add axes, shovels, and even other materials (not just tools) to this list and give them their own restrictions.
zh: 默认情况下，该配置仅设置用于采矿，并且包含所有镐。你**可以**将轴、铲子甚至其他材料（不仅仅是工具）添加到此列表中，并给予它们自己的限制。

source: <summary>Default Config</summary>
zh: <summary>默认配置</summary>

source: The options are very simple as well. You start by choosing the tool, then specify the list of all the [block types](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining#target-block) this tool can break. This feature works like a whitelist: any block that is not in the list, cannot be broken by the given tool. For extra compatibility, we have broken blocks into block types, like vanilla blocks, blocks from MMOItems, and even custom skulls!
zh: 选项也非常简单。首先选择工具，然后指定该工具可以破坏的所有块类型](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining#target-block)的列表。此功能的工作原理类似于白名单：任何不在列表中的块都不能被给定的工具破坏。为了获得额外的兼容性，我们将块分解为块类型，例如原版块、MMOItems块，甚至定制头骨！

source: Default permission set
zh: 默认设置权限

source: The `default` option can be used to setup default break permissions. If a player happens to hold an item which has NO setup in this config file, this permission set will be used by default. It makes sense to just use `AIR` as default because it's what any player can mine when not holding a special tool.
zh: `default`选项可用于设置默认中断权限。如果玩家碰巧拥有一个在此配置文件中没有设置的物品，则默认情况下将使用此权限设置。仅使用`AIR`作为默认值是有意义的，因为这是任何玩家在不持有特殊工具时都可以挖掘的内容。

source: To give block mining permissions to MMOItems tools, use the `ITEM_TYPE?ITEM_ID` syntax. Here is an example with the item with type `TOOL` and ID `STEEL_PICKAXE`.
zh: 要将区块挖掘权限提供给MMOItems工具，请使用`ITEM_TYPE?ITEM_ID`语法。以下是物品的示例，类型为`TOOL`和ID`STEEL_PICKAXE`。

source: Inheritance
zh: 继承

source: The `parent` option is used when your tools are tiering up, and you want the stronger tools to automatically inherit all of the blocks from the tools under it. This is a very handy organizational feature. If you leave it empty, it will automatically take the `default` permission set as parent.
zh: 当你的工具分层并且你希望更强大的工具自动继承其下工具的所有块时，请使用`parent`选项。这是一个非常方便的组织功能。如果将其留空，它将自动将`default`权限设置为父级。

source: 🔧 Triggers
zh: 🔧 触发器

source: > This feature will be merged in a near future with MythicLib [script mechanics](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/intro) (this update will be backwards compatible). This page will be deleted and moved over to the MythicLib wiki.
zh: > 此功能将在不久的将来与MythicLib[脚本机制](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/scripts/mechanics/intro)合并（此更新将向后兼容）。该页面将被删除并移至MythicLibwiki。

source: **This is a very technical feature, you will not learn anything by reading this page on its own (out of context). It should only be read if other wiki pages redirect you to this page.**
zh: **这是一个非常技术性的功能，通过单独阅读此页面（断章取义），你不会学到任何东西。仅当其他 wiki 页面将你重定向到此页面时才应阅读。**

source: Triggers are used by MMOCore to execute actions when certain conditions are met. They are used for both quests and professions, and each has a set of actions or objectives that can "trigger" them.
zh: MMOCore使用触发器在满足某些条件时执行操作。它们用于任务和副职业，并且每个都有一组可以“触发”它们的动作或目标。

source: Trigger Tables (Since 1.9.5)
zh: 触发表（自1.9.5起）

source: Since 1.9.5, you can define trigger tables in `triggers.yml`. You can reference each trigger list with its id which will fire all the corresponding triggers.
zh: 从1.9.5开始，你可以在`triggers.yml`中定义触发器表。你可以使用每个触发器列表的 id 来引用它，这将触发所有相应的触发器。

source: Available Trigger Types
zh: 可用的触发器类型

source: | Trigger | Description | Format/Example |
zh: |触发|描述 |格式/示例 |

source: | stat | Gives a permanent stat to the player. FLAT type just adds the amount to the stat. Relative makes it have a % increase for the stat. | `stat{stat=<STAT_NAME>;amount=<amount>;type=FLAT/RELATIVE}` |
zh: |属性|为玩家提供永久的属性。 FLAT 类型只是将金额添加到属性中。相对使得属性有%的提升。 |`stat{stat=<STAT_NAME>;amount=<amount>;type=FLAT/RELATIVE}`|

source: | skill_buff | Gives a permanent buff for all the skills matching the formula by changing the value of a certain modifier (cooldown, damage, mana...). More info on skill buffs [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#skill-buffs). | `skill_buff{formula="<FORMULA>";modifier=<MODIFIER>;amount=<amount>;type=FLAT/RELATIVE}` |
zh: |skill_buff|通过改变某个修饰符的值（冷却时间，伤害，魔力...），为所有匹配公式的技能提供永久的增益效果。有关技能增益效果的更多信息 [此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#skill-buffs)。 |`skill_buff{formula="<FORMULA>";modifier=<MODIFIER>;amount=<amount>;type=FLAT/RELATIVE}`|

source: | unlock_skill | Unlocks a skill for the player. More about skill unlocking [here](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/unlocking). | `unlock_skill{skill=FIREBALL}` |
zh: |unlock_skill|为玩家解锁技能。有关技能解锁的更多信息 [此处](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/unlocking)。 |`unlock_skill{skill=FIREBALL}`|

source: | unlock_slot | Unlocks a specific [skill slot](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots) for the player. | `unlock_slot{slot="<SLOT>"}` |
zh: |unlock_slot|为玩家解锁特定的[技能插槽](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots)。 |`unlock_slot{slot="<SLOT>"}`|

source: | bind_skill | Binds a skill to a specific slot. | `bind_skill{skill=FIREBALL;slot=10}` |
