source: Most of these types and triggers are shown in the default config with how to properly use them. The message and command triggers support placeholders from [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/).
zh: 大多数这些类型和触发器都显示在默认配置中，以及如何正确使用它们。消息和命令触发器支持 [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/)中的占位符。

source: 🌟 Vanilla Exp
zh: 🌟原版已过期

source: This simple RPG option lets you display the player's current main class level on the vanilla experience bar. Players can also see how close/far they are from reaching the next level by looking at the actual EXP bar progression. This option can be enabled in `config.yml`:
zh: 这个简单的RPG选项可让你在原版经验栏上显示玩家的当前主职业等级。玩家还可以通过查看实际的经验进度条来了解他们距离下一个等级有多近/多远。可以在`config.yml`中启用此选项：

source: ![SbErxxz](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/vanilla_exp.CW9qSvtl.png)
zh: ![SbErxxz](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/vanilla_exp.CW9qSvtl.png)

source: It matches the experience progress and level displayed in the `/p` menu.
zh: 与`/p`菜单中显示的经验进度和等级相匹配。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/exp_progress.BKg6SjB0.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/exp_progress.BKg6SjB0.png)

source: Vanilla EXP redirection
zh: 原版EXP重定向

source: When enabled, a set portion of the EXP you earn via experience orbs is redirected to your main MMOCore class exp. You can change this option in `config.yml`.
zh: 启用后，你通过经验球获得的经验的一部分将被重定向到你的主MMOCore职业经验。你可以在`config.yml`中更改此选项。

source: This feature can be useful for survival or simple RPG servers which do not want to spend time on setting up [experience sources](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/sources) and are okay with relying on vanilla exp dropped by mobs and blocks.
zh: 此功能对于生存或简单的RPG服务器非常有用，这些服务器不想花时间设置[经验源](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/sources)，并且可以依赖小怪和方块掉落的原版exp。

source: 🍹 Alchemy
zh: 🍹炼金术

source: The default alchemy profession allows players to earn experience when brewing any type of potions: splash, lingering, upgraded vanilla potions. Here is the most important part of the alchemy profession config file.
zh: 默认炼金术副职业允许玩家在酿造任何类型的药水时获得经验：飞溅药水、滞留药水、升级的原版药水。这是 alchemy副职业配置文件中最重要的部分。

source: As you can see, the only alchemy experience source is brewing (brewing stand). You may also specify what type of potions the player must brew in order to get experience in that specific profession using the `brewitem` **experience source**. If you want the player to earn EXP when only brewing speed and regen potions, use `'brewpotion{effect=SPEED,REGEN}'` (separate potion types using a comma).
zh: 正如你所看到的，唯一的炼金源经验是酿造（酿造台）。你还可以指定玩家必须酿造什么类型的药水才能使用`brewitem`**经验源** 在该特定副职业中获得经验。如果你希望玩家在仅酿造速度和再生药水时获得经验，请使用`'brewpotion{effect=SPEED,REGEN}'`（使用逗号分隔药水类型）。

source: The `alchemy-experience` config section dictates how much experience the player will get from brewing any potion. The experience a player gets from brewing **directly depends on the potion effect type**: rarer potions i.e potions which require rarer ingredients like ghast tears (over glistering melons) should grant more alchemy experience.
zh: `alchemy-experience`配置部分规定了玩家从酿造任何药水中可以获得多少经验。玩家从酿造中获得的经验**直接取决于药水效果类型**：稀有药水i.e需要更稀有成分的药水，例如恶魂之泪（在闪闪发光的瓜上）应该会提供更多的炼金术经验。

source: On the other hand, mundane, thick and awkward potions should give less experience since players must brew them before brewing any other potion.
zh: 另一方面，普通、浓稠和笨拙的药水应该会提供较少的经验，因为玩家必须在酿造任何其他药水之前酿造它们。

source: Base EXP
zh: 基础经验值

source: Every potion type has a base EXP which the player earns when brewing 1, 2 or 3 potions (at the same time) of this type in a brewing stand, for example the player will earn 15EXP from brewing a fire resistance potion and 20EXP from brewing a jump potion *(with the default setup)*.
zh: 每种药水类型都有一个基础 EXP，玩家在酿造台中酿造该类型的1、2或3药水（同时）时会获得该 EXP，例如玩家将通过酿造抗火药水获得15EXP和20EXP酿造跳跃药水*（使用默认设置）*。

source: Alchemy EXP Modifiers
zh: 炼金术 EXP 修改器

source: When using **redstone to extend the effect duration**, the player will earn X% of the potion effect base experience e.g when extending a jump potion, the player will earn `40% * 20 = 5EXP`. This percentage can be setup with the `special.extend` option. When using **glowstone to upgrade the effect**, the player will also earn X% of the potion effect base experience. This percentage can be setup with the `special.upgrade` option.
zh: 使用**红石延长药水效果的持续时间**时，玩家会获得该药水效果基础经验的 X%。例如，延长跳跃药水的效果时，会获得 `40% * 20 = 5EXP`。此百分比通过 `special.extend` 设置。使用**荧石提升药水效果等级**时，也会获得该效果基础经验的 X%，对应设置为 `special.upgrade`。

source: When using **gunpowder to brew a splash potion** or **dragon breath to brew a lingering potion**, the player will earn X% of the potion effect base experience (percentages are configurable using `special.splash` and `special.lingering`).
zh: 当使用**火药酿造飞溅药水**或**龙息酿造滞留药水**时，玩家将获得X%的药水效果基础经验（百分比可使用`special.splash`和`special.lingering`进行配置）。

source: 🧙‍♂️ Enchanting

Enchanting is a specific type of profession in MMOCore. It allows players to get experience and level up their enchant profession by enchanting items at the vanilla enchantment tables. The experience gained when enchanting an item depends directly on the new enchants your item obtains, and on the levels of the new enchants.
zh: 附魔是MMOCore中副职业的一种特定类型。它允许玩家通过在原版附魔台上附魔物品来获得经验和等级的附魔副职业。附魔物品时获得的经验直接取决于你的物品获得的新附魔，以及新附魔的等级。

source: Enchanting Experience
zh: 迷人的体验

source: Some enchants are harder to obtain than others and therefore should give more exp than others. Every enchant has a set amount of EXP **per enchant level** that will be given to the player whenever he rolls that enchant. Therefore, the experience earned is the weighted sum of all the exp earned by every single enchant, weighted by the enchant level.
zh: 有些附魔比其他附魔更难获得，因此应该比其他附魔提供更多的经验。每个附魔都有一定数量的经验值**每个附魔等级**，每当玩家滚动该附魔时，都会将其提供给他。因此，获得的经验是每个附魔获得的所有经验值的加权总和，并按附魔等级加权。

source: A player enchants a diamond sword with *Efficiency IV*, *Unbreaking III* and *Silk Touch*. Therefore the experience given to the player is:
zh: 玩家为钻石剑附魔*效率 IV*、*坚不可摧 III* 和 *丝触*。因此给予玩家的经验是：

source: 🎣 Fishing
zh: 🎣 钓鱼

source: MMOCore may be used to override/rewrite default fishing drop tables.
zh: MMOCore可用于覆盖/重写默认钓鱼掉落表。

source: Fishing Experience
zh: 钓鱼体验

source: Using the `fishitem` [experience source](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/sources), you can make players earn a certain amount of EXP when fishing specific items, like fishes, enchanted books, saddles, etc. The rarer the item, the more experience players should earn.
zh: 使用`fishitem`【经验源](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/sources)】，可以让玩家在钓鱼特定的物品时获得一定的经验值，比如鱼、魔法书、马鞍等。物品越稀有，玩家应该获得的经验越多。

source: Currently, the `fishitem` experience source only supports item materials, which means a player will not get extra EXP from looting a mending enchanted book over a Power I enchanted book. The only way to bind specific experience amounts to amounts is to hook onto MMOItems items using the fishing drop tables which can be edited in the fishing.yml profession config file.
zh: 目前，`fishitem`经验源仅支持物品材料，这意味着玩家不会通过从 Power I 附魔书上抢夺修复附魔书来获得额外的经验。将特定经验金额绑定到金额的唯一方法是使用可在fishing.yml副职业配置文件中编辑的钓鱼掉落表挂钩到MMOItems物品。

source: **If you don't want to utilize professions in general**, just ignore the fishing experience sources and use the fishing drop tables without specifying any experience. **If you don't want to utilize the MMOCore fishing drop tables**, just use the fishing experience sources, and delete any default fishing drop tables.
zh: **如果你不想一般使用副职业**，只需忽略钓鱼经验源并使用钓鱼掉落表而不指定任何经验。 **如果你不想使用MMOCore钓鱼掉落表**，只需使用钓鱼经验源，并删除任何默认的钓鱼掉落表。

source: The main config file is `professions/fishing.yml`.
zh: 主配置文件是`professions/fishing.yml`。

source: *As you can see, the default fishing config setup does not utilize fishing experience sources although you can add other exp sources to that profession if required.* Fishing drop tables are defined by two options: conditions and items.
zh: *如你所见，默认的钓鱼配置设置不使用钓鱼经验源，尽管你可以根据需要将其他经验源添加到该副职业中。*钓鱼掉落表由两个选项定义：条件和物品。

source: When a player fishes, MMOCore goes through all the fishing drop tables and picks the first one which conditions are all met by the player. The two conditions available as of right now are the `region` condition which hooks onto WorldGuard. This condition lets you configure specific drop tables for each WorldGuard region. This lets you create specific regions where you can fish rarer items. You can use the [waypoints](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/waypoints) system in parallel to create a unique fishing zone with rare drops! The other condition is the `biome` condition, which reads the biome you're standing in. Biomes must be formatted in the `name=<biome>` format to function -- see example above.
zh: 当玩家钓鱼时，MMOCore会遍历所有钓鱼掉落表，并选择第一个玩家都满足条件的钓鱼掉落表。目前可用的两个条件是`region`条件，它挂接到WorldGuard上。此条件允许你为每个WorldGuard区域配置特定的删除表。这可以让你创建可以钓鱼稀有物品的特定区域。你可以并行使用[航点](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/waypoints)系统，创建一个独特的钓鱼区，并获得稀有掉落！另一个条件是`biome`条件，它读取你所在的生物群落。生物群落必须以`name=<biome>`格式格式化才能运行 - 请参阅上面的示例。

source: If you create a drop table with no condition, make sure it's the last one otherwise it will always be chosen by MMOCore. Moreover creating a no-condition fishing drop table means that MMOCore fishing drop tables **always** override the default vanilla drop tables.
zh: 如果你创建一个没有条件的删除表，请确保它是最后一个，否则它将始终被MMOCore选择。此外，创建no-condition钓鱼掉落表意味着MMOCore钓鱼掉落表**始终**覆盖默认的原版掉落表。

source: Fishing Drop Tables
zh: 钓鱼台

source: Learn about [regular drop tables](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/drop-tables) first.
zh: 先了解一下【常规掉落表](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/drop-tables)。

source: Fishing drop tables are slightly different from regular drop tables (used by random chests or block drops). The main difference is that a fishing drop table always require ONE and only ONE item to be randomly picked and dropped.
zh: 钓鱼掉落表与常规掉落表（用于随机箱子或方块掉落）略有不同。主要区别在于钓鱼掉落表总是需要一个且仅一个物品来随机挑选和掉落。

source: This changes the way MMOCore picks that one random item. In fact the `chance` option is never used by fishing drop tables. Even if you set the drop item chance to 0%, your item might be picked.
zh: 这改变了MMOCore选择一个随机物品的方式。事实上，`chance`选项从未被钓鱼台使用过。即使你将掉落物品的机会设置为0%，你的物品也可能会被选中。

source: Fishing drop tables **use item weight to determine drop chance**. Every table item is assigned a weight, which is a number. The higher this number, the higher the drop chance. The probability of an item being picked and dropped is `<item weight> / <sum of item weights from all the items in that drop table>`.
zh: 钓鱼掉落表**使用物品重量来确定掉落几率**。每个表物品都分配有一个权重，它是一个数字。这个数字越高，掉落的几率就越高。物品被拾取和掉落的概率为`<item weight> / <sum of item weights from all the items in that drop table>`。

source: The generic format for a drop item is the following (same as a regular drop table item). As explained above, the `<drop-chance>` option is completely useless and can be set to anything.
zh: 删除物品的通用格式如下（与常规删除表物品相同）。如上所述，`<drop-chance>`选项完全无用，可以设置为任何值。

source: There are some advantages to this weight system. First of all, if you ever want to add a new item to your fishing drop tables, you don't actually have to edit all the previously configured drop chances. Just add some new table item with a specific weight, and because of the way the drop chances are calculated, this will have the effect of 'updating all the other item drop chances'. The second advantage is that it's really adapted to fishing tables requiring to have only ONE item dropped at a time.
zh: 这种重量系统有一些优点。首先，如果你想将新的物品添加到钓鱼掉落表中，你实际上不必编辑所有先前配置的掉落机会。只需添加一些具有特定权重的新表物品，并且由于掉落机会的计算方式，这将具有“更新所有其他物品掉落机会”的效果。第二个优点是它确实适合一次只掉落一个物品的钓鱼台。

source: Tugs
zh: 拖船

source: MMOCore improves the default fishing mechanism by adding **tugs**. When a player catches a fish, the fish tries to resist, therefore the player must spam-click his fishing rod until it gives up! The tugs dictate the amount of clicks needed to catch the fish. If a player stops clicking while the fish is resisting, the fish will eventually go away.
zh: MMOCore通过添加 **拖船** 改进了默认的捕鱼机制。当玩家钓到鱼时，鱼会试图反抗，因此玩家必须spam-click他的鱼竿直到它放弃！拖船决定了捕获鱼所需的点击次数。如果玩家在鱼抵抗时停止点击，鱼最终会消失。

source: To set the amount of tugs required to catch a certain item, add `;tugs=min-max` to the item line config. You may also use `;tugs=10` if you want that tugs number to always be the same.
zh: 要设置捕获特定物品所需的拖船数量，请将`;tugs=min-max`添加到物品线路配置中。如果你希望拖船编号始终相同，你也可以使用`;tugs=10`。

source: Experience
zh: 经验

source: To have an item give the player a specific amount of exp when fished, add `experience=min-max` to the item line config. A random amount of exp anywhere between the two given boundaries will be rolled every time the item is caught by a player. You may also use `experience=30` if you want the exp amount to be a constant.
zh: 要让物品在钓鱼时为玩家提供特定数量的 exp，请将`experience=min-max`添加到物品线路配置中。每次物品被玩家捕获时，两个给定边界之间任意位置的随机 exp 量都会滚动。如果你希望经验金额为常量，你也可以使用`experience=30`。

source: Vanilla Experience
zh: 原版经验

source: You can also give vanilla exp when catching a fish by adding `vanilla-exp=min-max` to the item line config. This field is optional and works exactly like `experience`.
zh: 你还可以通过将`vanilla-exp=min-max`添加到物品线路配置来在钓鱼时提供原版exp。该字段是可选的，其工作方式与`experience`完全相同。

source: Professions
zh: 副职业

source: Introduction
zh: 介绍

source: Although MMOCore features at the moment 7 default professions, you can create as many professions as you want to make your leveling system more interesting. Professions can have specific [experience sources](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/sources), i.e actions that players can perform in order to obtain exp in a specific profession.
zh: MMOCore 目前自带 7 个副职业，也可以自行创建更多副职业，丰富等级系统。副职业可以有各自的[经验来源](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/sources)，也就是玩家为了获得该副职业经验而执行的操作。

source: Once players have earned enough experience in their profession, their profession levels up, granting some rewards, such as main class exp, skill points, access to skills...
zh: 一旦玩家在其副职业中获得足够的经验，其副职业等级就会上升，授予一些奖励，例如主职业经验、技能积分、访问技能...

source: ![TBz9e5B](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/main_gui.DlPQMKdI.gif)
zh: ![TBz9e5B](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/main_gui.DlPQMKdI.gif)

source: Example: Farming Profession
zh: 示例：农业副职业

source: All profession config files are saved in the `/MMOCore/profession` plugin folder. You may configure the profession display name, as well as the **main class experience** the player will earn whenever leveling this specific profession.
zh: 所有副职业配置文件都保存在`/MMOCore/profession`插件文件夹中。你可以配置副职业显示名称，以及 **主职业经验** 每当升级这个特定的副职业时，玩家就会获得奖励。

source: This determines how much EXP the player needs to reach the next profession level. More info on experience curves on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/curves).
zh: 这决定了玩家需要多少经验才能到达下一个副职业等级。有关经验曲线的更多信息，请访问 [此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/curves)。

source: More about experiences tables on this [wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/tables).
zh: 有关体验表的更多信息，请参见此 [wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/tables)。

source: Experience sources
zh: 经验来源

source: Experience sources define what actions the player have to do in order to earn exp in your profession. More info over [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/sources).
zh: 经验来源定义了玩家必须执行哪些操作才能在你的副职业中赚取经验。更多信息请参阅 [此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/level/sources)。

source: ⛏️ Mining
zh: ⛏️ 挖矿

source: Mining is a big part of MMOCore. You will find all the information about the MMOCore custom mining system on [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining).
zh: 挖矿是MMOCore的重要组成部分。你可以在[此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/mining)上找到有关MMOCore自定义挖矿系统的所有信息。

source: 🔨 Smithing
zh: 🔨 锻造

source: Smithing is a specific type of profession where players can earn EXP when repairing items using the vanilla anvil. The experience earned by the player depends on the item the player is repairing, and on the amount of durability the player is repairing.
zh: 史密斯是副职业的一种特定类型，其中玩家在使用原版铁砧修理物品时可以获得经验。玩家获得的经验取决于玩家正在维修的物品，以及玩家正在维修的耐久度的数量。

source: The config file is pretty self explanatory: you can setup how much smithing experience you want the player to earn when repairing 100 durability points of a specific item using the vanilla anvil.
zh: 配置文件非常不言自明：你可以设置在使用原版铁砧修复特定物品的100耐久度点时希望玩家获得多少锻造经验。

source: Note
zh: 笔记

source: All items do not have the same amount of maximum durability however repairing a tool in the anvil **always repairs 25% of that maximum amount!** This is why the experience values look a bit weird. When repairing a diamond pickaxe using a diamond in the anvil, you are repairing 25% of these 1561 durability points which is about 390 durability points corresponding to `390 / 100 * 1,923 = 7.6 EXP`.
zh: 不同物品的最大耐久度不同，但在铁砧上用材料修复工具时，**每次都会恢复最大耐久度的 25%！**因此这里的经验数值看起来不太整齐。例如，在铁砧上用钻石修复钻石镐时，会恢复其 1561 点耐久度的 25%，约为 390 点，对应的经验为 `390 / 100 * 1,923 = 7.6 EXP`。

source: When repairing a golden sword, you are only repairing 25% of 32 durability points i.e 8 durability points which represents `8 / 100 * 62.5 = 5 EXP`. Repairing a diamond sword using the vanilla anvil gives more experience than repairing a golden sword.
zh: 修复金剑时，你仅修复32耐久度点中的25%点i.e8耐久度点（代表`8 / 100 * 62.5 = 5 EXP`）。使用原版铁砧修理钻石剑比修理金剑可以获得更多的经验。

source: 🔗 Binding Skills
zh: 🔗 绑定技能

source: In order to be cast, skills need to be bound to specific skill slots. There can be at most one skill bound to one skill slot. Each skill slot corresponds to a different keybind, or key combo. There are multiple ways to bind skills:
zh: 为了进行施放，技能需要绑定到特定的技能插槽。 1个技能槽位最多绑定1个技能。每个技能插槽对应不同的按键绑定或按键组合。绑定技能的方式有多种：

source: you can either let the players choose their keybinds through the `/skills` GUI,
zh: 你可以让玩家通过`/skills`GUI选择其按键绑定，

source: enable/disable the editing of keybinds and hard-code the keybinds (like on Wynncraft, for instance),
zh: 启用/禁用按键绑定和hard-code按键绑定的编辑（例如在 Wynncraft 上），

source: enable/disable the binding of specific passive skills altogether,
zh: 完全启用/禁用特定被动技能的绑定，

source: or use commands to bind skills to skill slots.
zh: 或者使用命令将技能绑定到技能槽位。

source: For example, a skill bound to skill slot n1 could be cast by pressing the [1] key (or combo *Left-Right*), while the skill bound to skill slot n2 could be cast by pressing [2] (or by performing combo *Left-Right*).
zh: 例如，绑定到技能插槽 n1 的技能可以通过按 [1] 键（或组合 *Left-Right*）来施放，而绑定到技能插槽 n2 的技能可以通过按 [2]（或执行组合 *）来施放。Left-Right*)。

source: Skill slots are class-specific, which means that classes can have a varying number of skill slots, as well as different skill slot properties. For instance, magic-oriented classes like Mages, Wizards or Paladins could have more skill slots than melee-oriented classes like Warriors or Brutes.
zh: 技能插槽是class-specific，这意味着职业可以具有不同数量的技能插槽，以及不同的技能插槽属性。例如，像法师、巫师或圣骑士这样的magic-oriented职业可能比像战士或野兽这样的melee-oriented职业有更多的技能插槽。

source: To edit the skill slots of a class, open up the class config file and look for/create the `skill-slots` section. Each entry under this config section corresponds to a single skill slot.
zh: 要编辑职业的技能插槽，请打开职业配置文件并查找/创建`skill-slots`部分。此配置部分下的每个条目对应于一个技能插槽。

source: Let's go over each parameter one by one.
zh: 让我们一一讨论每个参数。

source: Name and lore
zh: 姓名和描述

source: Options `name` and `lore` are used to define the item name and lore of your skill slot as seen in the `/skills` menu.
zh: 选项`name`和`lore`用于定义技能插槽的物品名称和描述，如`/skills`菜单中所示。

source: Other Options
zh: 其他选项

source: `can-manually-bind` determines if the player is allowed to manually bind skills to this slot. It is set to `true` by default. When set to `false`, the only way to bind skills to this slot is by using an admin command.
zh: `can-manually-bind`决定是否允许玩家手动绑定技能到该槽位。默认设置为`true`。当设置为`false`时，将技能绑定到此插槽的唯一方法是使用管理命令。

source: `unlocked-by-default` is set to `true` by default. When set to `false`, this skill slot needs to be [unlocked](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#unlocking-skill-slots), just like a skill in order to be usable. Until it is unlocked, the player cannot bind any skill to it.
zh: `unlocked-by-default`默认设置为`true`。当设置为`false`时，此技能插槽需要[解锁](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#unlocking-skill-slots)，就像技能一样才能使用。在解锁之前，玩家无法绑定任何技能。

source: Formula
zh: 公式

source: Each slot also has a formula (specified by the `formula` entry) which determines the set of skills that can be bound to it (the set of *compatible skills*).
zh: 每个插槽还有一个公式（由`formula`条目指定），该公式确定可以与其绑定的技能集合（*兼容技能* 集合）。

source: > Comment out this line or set it to `"true"` to disable this option. If no formula is specified, all skills will be compatible with this skill slot.
zh: > 注释掉此行或将其设置为`"true"`以禁用此选项。如果未指定公式，则所有技能都将与此技能插槽兼容。

source: This option can be used to create things like *Passive skill slots*, where the player can only bind passive skills. If other skill slots are *Active-only*, you can make sure the player has at most one passive skill.
zh: 此选项可用于创建诸如“被动技能插槽”之类的内容，其中玩家只能绑定被动技能。如果其他技能插槽为 *Active-only*，则可以确保玩家最多有一个被动技能。

source: The only limit is your imagination. Here are some examples of formulas you can use.
zh: 唯一的限制是你的想象力。以下是你可以使用的一些公式示例。

source: | Formula | Usage |
zh: |公式|用途 |

source: | `<passive>` | Only passive skills |
zh: |`<passive>`|仅无源技能|

source: | `<active>` | Only active skills |
zh: |`<active>`|仅活动技能|

source: | `<active> && <fire>` | Only active skills with category `fire` |
zh: |`<active> && <fire>`|仅有效技能类别`fire`|

source: | `<active> && (!<fire>)` | Any skill that does not have category `fire` |
zh: |`<active> && (!<fire>)`|任何没有类别`fire`的技能|

source: | `<passive> || <fire>` | Only passive skills with category `fire` |
zh: |`<passive> || <fire>`|仅无源技能类别为`fire`|

source: | `(<passive> && <fire>) || <active>` | Only passive skills with category `fire`, OR active skills |
zh: |`(<passive> && <fire>) || <active>`|仅具有类别`fire`的无源技能或有源技能|

source: | `<firebolt> || (!<water>)` | Only skill named `firebolt`, or any skill that does not have category `water` |
zh: |`<firebolt> || (!<water>)`|仅名为`firebolt`的技能或任何不具有类别`water`的技能|

source: These formulas support [skill categories](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#skill-categories) and support boolean algebra operators: `!<aaa>` (logical not), `<aaa> && <bbb>` (logical and), `<aaa> || <bbb>` (logical or).
zh: 这些公式支持 [技能类别](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#skill-categories)并支持布尔代数运算符：`!<aaa>`（逻辑非）、`<aaa> && <bbb>`（逻辑与）、`<aaa> || <bbb>`（逻辑或）。

source: The following code defines a skill slot where the player can only bind the skill named `FIRE_STORM`. Note that this is the skill ID, and not the skill name.
zh: 以下代码定义了一个技能插槽，其中玩家只能绑定名为`FIRE_STORM`的技能。请注意，这是技能ID，而不是技能名称。

source: The following code snippet defines a slot where the player can only bind skills that are active and have the category `fire`:
zh: 以下代码片段定义了一个插槽，其中玩家只能绑定处于活动状态且类别为`fire`的技能：

source: The following code snippet can be used to define the categories of a skill. Note that this syntax is to be used inside of a MythicLib skill config. Please read [this MythicLib wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#skill-categories) to learn how to define the categories of a skill.
zh: 以下代码片段可用于定义技能的类别。请注意，此语法将在MythicLib技能配置内部使用。请阅读[此MythicLibwiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic#skill-categories)以了解如何定义技能的类别。

source: Skill Buffs
zh: 技能增益

source: Skill buffs can also be granted to skill slots. A skill buff is a specific buff applied on one specific parameter of a set of skills, for instance *+10% Damage* or *-10% Cooldown*. These skill buffs will only apply to the skill bound to that skill slot. Find more information about skill buffs in [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#skill-buffs).
zh: 技能增益效果也可以授予技能插槽。技能增益效果是应用于一组技能的一个特定参数的特定增益效果，例如 *+10%Damage* 或 *-10%冷却时间*。这些技能增益效果将仅适用于绑定到该技能插槽的技能。在 [此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#skill-buffs)中查找有关技能增益效果的更多信息。

source: This feature can be used to create, for instance, *Fire slots* or *Water slots* which provide additional damage to lower cooldowns to a specific set of skills (which can be specified using skill formulas, see above).
zh: 例如，此功能可用于创建*火槽*或*水槽*，它们为较低的冷却时间到一组特定的技能（可以使用技能公式指定，见上文）提供额外的伤害。

source: Skill buffs provided by skill slots should be placed under the `skill-buffs` config entry of the skill slot config.
zh: 技能插槽提供的技能buff 应放置在技能插槽配置的`skill-buffs`配置条目下。

source: Hardcoded Keybinds
zh: 硬编码按键绑定

source: If you plan to have a limited number of skills per class, you might not need to give your players the option to choose their skill keybinds. On some RPG servers, the skill keybinds, or combos, are hardcoded and cannot be changed by the player.
zh: 如果你计划每个职业的技能数量有限，你可能不需要为你的玩家提供选择其技能键绑定的选项。在某些RPG服务器上，技能键绑定或组合是硬编码的，不能由玩家更改。

source: In this case, go to your class config file and edit its skill slots:
zh: 在这种情况下，请转到职业配置文件并编辑其技能插槽：

source: By setting the `hardset` parameter to a skill ID, like `FIREBALL` (or whatever skill you have [configured](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/config) for the class), you forcefully bind that skill to this skill slot for all players.
zh: 通过将`hardset`参数设置为技能ID，例如`FIREBALL`（或你拥有的任何技能[为职业配置](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/config)），你可以强制将该技能绑定到此技能插槽适用于所有玩家。

source: Unlocking Skill Slots
zh: 解锁技能插槽

source: By default, all skill slots are unlocked. If not, they can be unlocked using the following command, where `<slot_number>` starts at 1 (not 0).
zh: 默认情况下，所有技能插槽均已解锁。如果没有，可以使用以下命令解锁它们，其中`<slot_number>`从1（不是0）开始。

source: Locked skill slots are not visible in the skill GUI.
zh: 锁定的技能插槽在技能GUI中不可见。

source: <summary>Default Config for Skill Slots</summary>
zh: <summary>技能插槽的默认配置</summary>

source: Binding Active Skills
zh: 绑定活动技能

source: Since active skills are proactively [cast](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting) by players, they all require to be bound to a specific skill slot before being used.
zh: 主动技能由玩家主动[施放](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting)，因此使用前都必须绑定到指定技能槽位。

source: Players can bind skills to skill slots from inside the `/skills` GUI. In the skill GUI, available skills are displayed on the left. Click the skill you would like to bind (the GUI name should update), then on the right side, click the skill slot where you'd like to bind your skill. Once an active skill is bound, you can [cast](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting) it.
zh: 玩家可以从`/skills`GUI内部将技能绑定到技能插槽。在技能GUI中，可用的技能显示在左侧。单击你要绑定的技能（GUI名称应更新），然后在右侧单击你要绑定技能的技能插槽。一旦绑定了活跃的技能，你就可以[施放](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting)它。

source: ![skillgui](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/bind_active.DOWAcMwn.gif)
zh: ![技能gui](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/bind_active.DOWAcMwn.gif)

source: Passive Skills
zh: 无源技能

source: Binding Passive Skills
zh: 绑定被动技能

source: By definition, [passive skills](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/config#passive-skills) do not require any proactive action from the player to be cast. For this reason, you can choose to make them automatically take effect as soon as they are unlocked, without the need to be bound to a skill slot.
zh: 根据定义，[被动技能](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/config#passive-skills)不需要玩家施放任何主动动作。为此，你可以选择解锁后自动生效，无需绑定技能槽位。

source: This behavior can be defined at the plugin level for all skills using the following option in the MMOCore `config.yml` file:
zh: 可以使用MMOCore`config.yml`文件中的以下选项在所有技能的插件等级定义此行为：

source: This default behavior can be overridden for specific skills in the class config file using the `needs-bound` field. If `needs-bound` is set to `false`, this passive skill will be permanent, meaning that it will always take effect as soon as it is unlocked, without the need to be bound. Conversely, if `needs-bound` is set to `true`, this passive skill will require binding in order to take effect.
zh: 对于职业配置文件中的特定技能，可以使用`needs-bound`字段覆盖此默认行为。如果`needs-bound`设置为`false`，则这个被动的技能将是永久的，也就是说一旦解锁就会一直生效，不需要绑定。相反，如果`needs-bound`设置为`true`，则此被动技能将需要绑定才能生效。

source: In the following example taken from the `classes/mage/mage.yml` config file, the skill `POWER_MARK` is a passive skill that does not need to be bound to take effect.
zh: 以下取自`classes/mage/mage.yml`配置文件的示例中，技能`POWER_MARK`是被动技能，不需要绑定即可生效。

source: The default MMOCore config files for the *Mage* class features three *Passive skill slots* where players can only bind passive skills.
zh: *Mage*职业的默认MMOCore配置文件具有三个 *被动技能插槽*，其中玩家只能绑定被动技能。

source: ![upgrade2](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/bind_passive.BimutQw8.gif)
zh: ![升级2](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/bind_passive.BimutQw8.gif)

source: Using commands
zh: 使用命令

source: If you don't want players to bind their skills and keybinds, you can use the following command to bind skills to specific slots instead.
zh: 如果你不希望玩家绑定其技能和按键绑定，则可以使用以下命令将技能绑定到特定插槽。

source: The bind command will work, even if the designated skill OR skill slot is not unlocked by the player. If the designated skill is not unlocked by the player, the skill will be bound but the skill will remain locked, and the player will get a friendly error message when trying to cast it. If the designated skill slot is not unlocked, the skill will be castable but the skill slot will remain locked.
zh: 即使指定的技能或技能插槽未被玩家解锁，绑定命令也将起作用。如果指定的技能没有被玩家解锁，则技能将被绑定，但技能将保持锁定状态，并且玩家在尝试投射时会收到一条友好的错误消息。如果指定的技能插槽未解锁，则技能将可施放，但技能插槽将保持锁定状态。

source: 💫 Skill Casting
zh: 💫技能施放

source: Make sure you first learn about [skills](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro) and [skill slots](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots). MMOCore offers multiple ways of casting skills:
zh: 确保你首先了解 [技能](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro)和 [技能插槽](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots)。MMOCore提供多种施放技能的方式：

source: using key combos most popular!
zh: 使用最流行的组合键！

source: using the `1` to `9` hotbar keys (*skill bar*)
zh: 使用`1`至`9`热键栏（*技能栏*）

source: using the mouse scroller
zh: 使用鼠标滚轮

source: using a command
zh: 使用命令

source: Make sure you restart your server when editing your skill casting configuration.
zh: 确保在编辑技能投射配置时重新启动服务器。

source: Key Combos
zh: 组合键

source: Key combos like *Left-Right-Left* can be used to cast skills. Players can start a combo by pressing the first key of any of the configured combos, which will temporarily alter the player's action bar, and display their current key combo there. As soon as MMOCore recognizes a valid key combo that is bound to some skill slot, it will cast the corresponding skill.
zh: *Left-Right-Left* 等组合键可用于施放技能。玩家可以通过按任何已配置组合的第一个键来启动组合，这将暂时改变玩家的动作栏，并在那里显示其当前的组合键。一旦MMOCore识别出绑定到某个技能插槽的有效组合键，它就会投射相应的技能。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/combos.D-UXtaQ4.gif)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/combos.D-UXtaQ4.gif)

source: One combo can be used to cast the skill bound to one specific slot. Therefore, there are as many valid key combos as there are skill slots. This implies that a specific key combo won't make two players cast the same skill (unless they have bound the same skill to the same skill slot). A few examples (the default configuration):
zh: 可以使用一个组合来将技能绑定到一个特定插槽。因此，有多少个技能槽就有多少个有效组合键。这意味着特定的组合键不会使两个玩家投射相同的技能（除非它们将相同的技能绑定到相同的技能插槽）。一些示例（默认配置）：

source: LEFT -> RIGHT -> LEFT will cast the skill on the 1st slot
zh: LEFT -> RIGHT -> LEFT 将把技能投射到1st插槽上

source: LEFT -> RIGHT -> RIGHT will cast the skill on the 2nd slot
zh: LEFT -> RIGHT -> RIGHT 将把技能投射到2nd插槽上

source: LEFT -> RIGHT -> DROP will cast the skill on the 3rd slot

source: Keybind List
zh: 按键绑定列表

For instance, you can choose to start every combo with a right click, and then every combo is a combination or right or left clicks. Bukkit click events are canceled when performing a combo, which means you are temporarily unable to interact with any item/spell when performing a combo.
zh: 这些是你可以在组合内部使用的不同按键绑定。例如，你可以选择通过右键单击来启动每个组合，然后每个组合都是右键单击或左键单击的组合。  执行连击时，Bukkit单击事件被取消，这意味着执行连击时你暂时无法与任何物品/spell 交互。

source: How to use key combos
zh: 如何使用组合键

source: Head to `MMOCore/config.yml` and replace the `skill-casting` config section for the following code snippet:

source: <summary>Copy and paste inside `config.yml`</summary>
zh: <summary>复制并粘贴到`config.yml`</summary>内

source: The `initializer-key` option is optional. It is the key players need to press first in order to start any combo. When unset, pressing the first key of any combo will start a new combo.
zh: `initializer-key`选项是可选的。这是玩家需要先按的键才能启动任何组合。取消设置后，按任意组合的第一个键将启动新的组合。

source: Similarly, the `quit-key` is optional. This key will cancel the current combo when pressed. Additionally, if the `stay-in` option is toggled on, players can cast as many combos as they want in a row without leaving skill casting (action bar stays on).

zh: Class-Specific组合键

zh: 每个职业可以有不同的combo-to-slot映射。职业映射优先于插件主配置中定义的映射（见上文）。要设置class-specific组合映射，请将以下代码片段粘贴到`MMOCore/classes`文件夹下的职业配置文件中，然后根据你的喜好进行编辑：

source: Action Bar
zh: 动作栏

source: Key combos use the player's action bar to display the current combo. To fully disable the casting action bar, delete or uncomment the `action-bar` section altogether. In this section, you can edit the prefix and suffix of the action bar as well as other formatting options.
zh: 按键组合使用玩家的动作栏来显示当前组合。要完全禁用投射动作栏，请完全删除或取消注释`action-bar`部分。在此部分中，你可以编辑动作栏的前缀和后缀以及其他格式选项。

source: Skill Bar
zh: 技能酒吧

source: This way of casting skills utilizes the action bar. Players must press some key (`F` by default) which will have them enter *casting mode*. While in casting mode, the player's bound skills are displayed onto the action bar, along with their respective cooldown if they happen to be on cooldown. Skills that are castable appear green, skills on cooldown appear red, and skills which you cannot cast due to low mana appear blue.
zh: 这种施法方式使用动作栏。玩家按下指定按键（默认为 `F`）进入*施法模式*。此时，已绑定的技能及其剩余冷却时间会显示在动作栏中：可施放的技能为绿色，冷却中的技能为红色，魔力不足而无法施放的技能为蓝色。

source: While in casting mode, pressing any key from `1` to `6` will cast the skill bound to that slot.
zh: 在施放模式下，按`1`到`6`之间的任意键将施放绑定到该插槽的技能。

source: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/skill_bar.BpGkdVfw.png)
zh: ![](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/skill_bar.BpGkdVfw.png)

source: Players can leave casting mode by pressing the same key again. They can't enter the casting mode while in creative.
zh: 玩家再次按同一键即可退出投射模式。他们在创意时无法进入投射模式。

source: How to use
zh: 如何使用

source: `disable-sneak` prevents the skill bar from opening if the player is sneaking when pressing the input keybind.
zh: 如果玩家在按下输入键绑定时潜行，`disable-sneak`会阻止技能栏打开。

source: `use-lowest-keybinds` makes MMOCore choose the lowest available keybinds for castable skills. Since you can leave some skill slots empty or even bind a passive skill (uncastable) to a skill slot, the player might have empty slots before their first active (castable) skill. By toggling on this option, all active skills are "shifted to the left" to use the lowest available keybinds (`1` first, then `2`, etc...)
zh: `use-lowest-keybinds` 会让 MMOCore 为可施放技能分配最靠前的可用按键。技能槽位可以留空，也可以绑定无法主动施放的被动技能，因此第一个主动技能之前可能有空位。启用此项后，所有主动技能会“向左补位”，优先使用靠前的按键，先是 `1`，再是 `2`，以此类推。

source: Skill Slot Offset
zh: 技能插槽偏移

source: You may notice that the keys shown in the screenshot don't exactly match `1` to `6`. This happens because if your selected hotbar slot is `2`, then skill slots `2`, `3`, `4` and all subsequent slots are shifted by 1.
zh: 你可能会注意到屏幕截图中显示的键与`1`到`6`并不完全匹配。发生这种情况的原因是，如果你选择的热栏插槽是`2`，则技能插槽`2`、`3`、`4`以及所有后续插槽都会移动1。

source: If your selected hotbar slot is `2`, the Minecraft client does not send any packet to the server when pressing `2`, rendering MMOCore unable to detect a slot swap. Generally, the Minecraft client avoids sending useless packets to the server.
zh: 如果你选择的热键栏插槽是`2`，则Minecraft客户端在按下`2`时不会向服务器发送任何数据包，从而导致MMOCore无法检测插槽交换。一般情况下，Minecraft客户端会避免向服务器发送无用的数据包。

source: > If there are only 6 skill slots, and the player is on slot `7`, `8` or `9`, there will be no offset.
zh: > 如果只有6技能插槽，且玩家位于插槽`7`、`8`或`9`上，则不会有偏移。

source: This casting mode uses the action bar too. To fully disable the casting action bar, delete or uncomment the `action-bar` section altogether. In this section, you can edit formatting options of the player's action bar while in casting mode.
zh: 这种投射模式也使用动作栏。要完全禁用投射动作栏，请完全删除或取消注释`action-bar`部分。在此部分中，你可以在投射模式下编辑玩家动作栏的格式选项。

source: Skill Scroller
zh: 技能卷轴

source: The player first presses a specific key (set to `F` by default) to enter casting mode. From there, they use the mouse scroller to navigate through their skill list. The skill currently selected appears on the player's action bar. They then press another key (set to `R` by default) to cast the selected skill.
zh: 玩家首先按下特定按键（默认设置为`F`）进入投射模式。从那里，他们使用鼠标滚轮浏览技能列表。当前选择的技能出现在玩家的动作栏上。然后，他们按另一个键（默认设置为`R`）来投射选定的技能。

source: How to setup
zh: 如何设置

source: | Parameter | Optional | Description |
zh: |参数|可选|描述 |

source: | `scroll-key` | Yes | Optional: comment the line to disable. When set, the mouse scroller no longer scrolls through the skill list, and the player has to press this keybind to scroll through their skill list. |
zh: |`scroll-key`|是的 |可选：注释要禁用的行。设置后，鼠标滚轮不再滚动技能列表，而玩家必须按此按键绑定才能滚动技能列表。 |

source: | `scroll-back-key` | Yes | Optional: comment the line to disable. When set, the mouse scroller no longer scrolls through the skill list, and the player has to press this keybind to scroll through their skill list. |
zh: |`scroll-back-key`|是的 |可选：注释要禁用的行。设置后，鼠标滚轮不再滚动技能列表，而玩家必须按此按键绑定才能滚动技能列表。 |

source: | `cast-key` |  | Keybind you need to press in order to cast the currently selected skill. |
zh: |`cast-key`|  |你需要按下按键绑定才能投射当前选择的技能。 |

source: | `quit-on-cast` | Yes | When enabled, players quit casting mode when casting the selected skill. |
zh: |`quit-on-cast`|是的 |启用后，玩家在投射选定的技能时退出投射模式。 |

source: | `quit-on-switch-empty-hand` | Yes | When enabled, players quit casting mode when scrolling to an empty hotbar slot. |
zh: |`quit-on-switch-empty-hand`|是的 |启用后，玩家在滚动到空的热键栏插槽时退出投射模式。 |

source: | `ignore-sneak` | Yes | When enabled, keys pressed while crouching are ignored. |
zh: |`ignore-sneak`|是的 |启用后，蹲下时按下的按键将被忽略。 |

source: MMOCore features commands to cast skills. These commands work anytime even if skill casting is disabled, if WorldGuard/Residence flags prevent players from casting skills...
zh: MMOCore具有用于投射技能的命令。即使技能投射被禁用，如果WorldGuard/Residence 标志阻止玩家投射技能...

source: The following command will cast the n-th castable skill of the given player.
zh: 以下命令将转换给定玩家的n-th可转换技能。

source: The following command will have the given player cast the skill on their n-th skill slot.
zh: 以下命令将使给定的玩家将技能投射到其n-th技能插槽上。

source: For example, let's say a player has four skill slots and the corresponding skill bindings:
zh: 例如，假设玩家有四个技能插槽和相应的技能绑定：

source: | Slot 1 | Slot 2 | Slot 3 | Slot 4 |
zh: |插槽1|插槽2|插槽3|插槽4|

source: | - | Passive Skill | Active Skill n1 | Active Skill n2 |
zh: | - |无源技能|活动技能n1 |活动技能n2 |

source: `/mmocore cast first <player> 1` will cast the 1st castable skill, hence on slot 3. The skill on slot 2 cannot be cast since it is passive, it is therefore ignored by this command. `/mmocore cast first <player> 2` will cast the 2nd castable skill, hence on slot 4. `/mmocore cast first <player> 3` and higher indices will return an error.
zh: `/mmocore cast first <player> 1` 会施放第 1 个可主动施放的技能，即槽位 3 中的技能。槽位 2 是被动技能，无法主动施放，因此会被忽略。`/mmocore cast first <player> 2` 会施放第 2 个可主动施放的技能，即槽位 4 中的技能。`/mmocore cast first <player> 3` 或更大的序号会报错。

source: `/mmocore cast specific <player> 1` will result in an error as there is no castable skill currently in slot 1. `/mmocore cast specific <player> 2` will also result in an error because the skill on slot 2 is not castable (as it is a passive skill). `/mmocore cast specific <player> 3` will cast the skill on slot 3.
zh: `/mmocore cast specific <player> 1` 会报错，因为槽位 1 中没有可施放技能。`/mmocore cast specific <player> 2` 也会报错，因为槽位 2 是被动技能。`/mmocore cast specific <player> 3` 则会施放槽位 3 中的技能。

source: Disable skill casting
zh: 禁用技能投射

source: If you are not using class skills or if you are not planning on adding active skills, you can just disable skill casting by using the following config syntax snippet inside `config.yml`.
zh: 如果你不使用职业技能或者你不打算添加活动的技能，则可以通过在`config.yml`中使用以下配置语法片段来禁用技能转换。

source: This will disable skill casting altogether. We generally recommend using this if you plan on either not using skill casting at all, or if you only want to cast skills through commands.
zh: 这将完全禁用技能投射。如果你打算根本不使用技能投射，或者只想通过命令投射技能，我们通常建议使用此选项。

source: Editing the skill casting particle effect
zh: 编辑技能施放粒子效果

source: By default, MMOCore displays a small helix particle effect around players that are currently in casting mode. You can edit the particle used, size and color. Add the following code snippet to your MMOCore class config file.
zh: 默认情况下，MMOCore在当前处于施放模式的玩家周围显示小螺旋粒子效果。你可以编辑所使用的粒子、大小和颜色。将以下代码片段添加到你的MMOCore职业配置文件中。

source: In order to disable the skill casting particle effect, you need to delete/comment out the `cast-particle` configuration section from your MMOCore class configuration file.
zh: 为了禁用技能投射粒子效果，你需要从MMOCore职业配置文件中删除/注释掉`cast-particle`配置部分。

source: Timeout for skill casting
zh: 技能施放超时

source: Since MMOCore 1.12.1 development builds, you can add a timeout to skill casting. If no activity is detected for more than X seconds, skill casting will end instantly. It's very simple to setup, just add the following option to your existing `skill-casting` config section. This option supports all casting modes.
zh: 由于MMOCore1.12.1开发构建，你可以为技能投射添加超时。如果超过 X 秒没有检测到任何活动，技能投射将立即结束。设置非常简单，只需将以下选项添加到现有的`skill-casting`配置部分即可。此选项支持所有投射模式。

source: If you do not plan on using skill casting timeout, simply do not use this parameter inside the `skill-casting` config section.
zh: 如果你不打算使用技能转换超时，则不要在`skill-casting`配置部分中使用此参数。

source: 🗃️ Configuration
zh: 🗃️配置

source: Class-Specific Skills
zh: Class-Specific技能

source: Skills are class-specific - a given class can only execute a set of predefined skills.
zh: 技能和class-specific- 给定的职业只能执行一组预定义的技能。

source: To define what skills each class can use, open up the class config file inside the `MMOCore/classes` folder, and look for the `skills` config section. Each entry under this section corresponds to a single class skill.
zh: 要定义每个职业可以使用的技能，请打开`MMOCore/classes`文件夹内的职业配置文件，然后查找`skills`配置部分。此部分下的每个条目对应于一个职业技能。

source: Skill Level
zh: 技能等级

source: `level` indicates the level at which the class naturally unlocks this skill. `max-level` is the maximum level for that class skill. Once reached, the player can no longer [upgrade](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#upgrading-a-skill) this skill.
zh: `level`表示等级，此时职业自然会解锁该技能。`max-level`是职业技能的最大值等级。一旦达到，玩家就无法再[升级](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#upgrading-a-skill)此技能。

source: Unlocked by Default
zh: 默认解锁

source: `unlocked-by-default` indicates if this skill should be unlocked by default. It is set to `true` by default. When toggled off, this skill has to be [unlocked](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/unlocking) through the use of a command, quest trigger, skill book, exp table...
zh: `unlocked-by-default`指示此技能是否应默认解锁。默认设置为`true`。当关闭时，这个技能必须[通过使用命令、任务触发器、技能书、经验表解锁](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/unlocking)...

source: Needs Binding
zh: 需要绑定

source: Another option is `needs-bound`. This option is only relevant for passive skills, as active skills must all be bound. When set to `false`, the passive skill takes effect even if not bound (and therefore can no longer be bound to any skill slot).
zh: 另一种选择是`needs-bound`。此选项仅与被动技能相关，因为主动技能必须全部绑定。当设置为`false`时，即使未绑定，被动技能也会生效（因此不能再绑定到任何技能插槽）。

source: Skill Parameters
zh: 技能参数

source: You might also want to change the skill numerical parameters, so that a fireball cast by the *Mage* class deals more damage than a fireball cast by the *Paladin* class. Each parameter of each skill can be edited by adding the corresponding entry to the class skill config. For instance (see above), the `damage` parameter for the *Fire Storm* skill is set to equal 5 Dmg, plus 3 Dmg per skill level. These skill parameters do not scale with the player's level but rather with the skill level. The skill level increases when a skill is [upgraded](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#upgrading-a-skill).
zh: 你可能还想更改技能数值参数，以便 *Mage*职业施放的火球比 *Paladin*职业施放的火球造成更多伤害。每个技能的每个参数都可以通过将相应条目添加到职业技能配置来编辑。例如（见上文），*Fire Storm*技能的`damage`参数设置为等于5Dmg，加上每个技能等级的3Dmg 。这些技能参数不随玩家的等级缩放，而是随技能等级缩放。当技能升级为](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/intro#upgrading-a-skill)时，技能等级会增加。

source: ![PhIpbOr](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/skill_ui_item.C1NBhUEq.png)
zh: ![PhIpb或](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/skill_ui_item.C1NBhUEq.png)

source: Skill Folder
zh: 技能文件夹

source: You might feel like the configs above might be lacking essential information, like its name, description icon, what it does, etc.
zh: 你可能会觉得上面的配置可能缺乏必要的信息，比如它的名称、描述图标、它的用途等。

source: Note that the configs above ("class skill" configs) do not create skills, they simply allow skills to be used by a certain class. Skills are created/defined inside the `MythicLib/skill` folder. Please refer to [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic.html#_2-declare-it-as-a-mythiclib-skill) for more information.
zh: 请注意，上面的配置（“职业技能”配置）不会创建技能，它们只是允许技能被某个职业使用。技能在`MythicLib/skill`文件夹内创建/定义。请参阅[此维基页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/custom/mythic.html#_2-declare-it-as-a-mythiclib-skill)了解更多信息。

source: Any skill that you use inside a class configuration must be registered somewhere inside the `MythicLib/skill` folder. If not, MMOCore will throw an error when trying to load the class.
zh: 你在职业配置中使用的任何技能必须在`MythicLib/skill`文件夹内的某个位置注册。如果没有，MMOCore在尝试加载职业时将抛出错误。

source: To create a passive skill, all you have to do is specify a [trigger](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers) for that skill. Any skill with no trigger is considered an active skill, while any skill with a trigger is considered a passive skill. The trigger defines when the skill takes effect.
zh: 要创建被动技能，你所要做的就是为该技能指定一个 [触发器](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/triggers)。任何不带触发器的技能均被视为主动技能，而任何带有触发器的技能均被视为被动技能。触发器定义技能何时生效。

source: The following class skill is a passive skill that is triggered every time the player attacks an entity. It uses the `ATTACK` trigger.
zh: 下面的职业技能是被动的技能，每次玩家攻击实体时都会触发。它使用`ATTACK`触发器。

source: The following skill is a passive skill that runs once every 5 seconds. It uses the `TIMER` trigger with the `timer` modifier set to `5`.
zh: 下面的技能是被动的技能，每5秒运行一次。它使用`TIMER`触发器，并将`timer`修改器设置为`5`。

source: Note that the `trigger` config option overrides the `trigger` option specified in the MythicLib skill config. If a trigger is specified in MythicLib but not in the MMOCore class config, the skill will still be considered a passive skill, and it will use the trigger specified in MythicLib. If both are specified, MMOCore takes precedence.
zh: 请注意，`trigger`配置选项会覆盖MythicLib技能配置中指定的`trigger`选项。如果在MythicLib中指定了触发器，但未在MMOCore职业配置中指定，则技能仍将被视为被动技能，并且它将使用MythicLib中指定的触发器。如果两者都指定，则MMOCore优先。

source: 🔥 Skills
zh: 🔥技能

source: Skills are amazing and unique abilities that players can use to defeat their enemies or buff their party mates fighting and surviving.
zh: 技能是令人惊叹且独特的能力，玩家可以用来击败敌人或增强队友的战斗和生存能力。

source: Skills are either **active or passive**. Active skills refer to skills proactively [cast by the player](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting). Passive skills cannot be cast - instead, they automatically trigger on specific events (attacks, clicks, movements, other skills...).
zh: 技能要么是**主动要么是被动**。主动技能是指主动技能[由玩家](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting)施放。被动技能无法施放 - 相反，它们会在特定事件（攻击、点击、移动、其他技能...）上自动触发。

source: Skills are class-specific. When changing class, the player will "lose" the progress they made on their skills and unlock new ones. Previous progress is recovered when switching classes again.
zh: 技能是class-specific。当更改职业时，玩家将“丢失”他们在技能上取得的进度并解锁新的进度。再次切换职业时，可恢复之前的进度。

source: Custom Skills
zh: 定制技能

source: While MMOCore comes with more than 90 built-in skills, you can create as many custom skills as you want using the most popular skill/scripting languages available, including MythicMobs, MythicLib or Fabled.
zh: MMOCore 自带 90 多种技能，也可以使用 MythicMobs、MythicLib、Fabled 等常见技能或脚本系统，创建任意数量的自定义技能。

source: Note that custom skills are registered in MythicLib. Any skill you register in MythicLib will be automatically forwarded to both MMOCore and MMOItems. Please read [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/intro) to learn how to create and register custom skills.
zh: 请注意，自定义技能已在MythicLib中注册。你在MythicLib中注册的任何技能将自动转发到MMOCore和MMOItems。请阅读[此 wiki 页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/skills/intro)以了解如何创建和注册自定义技能。

source: Overview
zh: 概述

source: In order to use a skill, players need to:
zh: 为了使用技能，玩家需要：

source: Choose a [class](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes) optional
zh: 选择 [职业](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/features/classes)可选

source: [Unlock](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/unlocking) a skill optional
zh: 【解锁](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/unlocking)、技能可选

source: [Bind](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding) the skill to a compatible skill slot optional
zh: [将](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding)和技能绑定到兼容的技能插槽可选

source: [Cast](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting) the skill
zh: 【铸](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/casting)技能

source: However, the MMOCore skill system is really permissive:
zh: 然而，MMOCore技能系统确实很宽松：

source: The default class can also have skills, so technically players do not need to choose a class to be able to cast skills. If you don't plan on using the class system, you can still use MMOCore skills.
zh: 默认的职业也可以有技能，所以技术上玩家不需要选择职业就能够施放技能。如果你不打算使用职业系统，你仍然可以使用MMOCore技能。

source: Skills can be unlocked when reaching a certain level, finishing a quest, unlocking a node in a skill tree or virtually anything else. Skills can also be made unlocked by default.
zh: 当达到一定水平、完成任务、解锁技能树中的节点或几乎任何其他东西时，都可以解锁技能。技能也可以默认解锁。

source: Skills can be manually bound using commands, or hard-set to automatically bound to skill slots if you don't like the MMOCore skill binding feature.
zh: 技能可以使用命令手动绑定，如果你不喜欢MMOCore技能绑定功能，也可以将hard-set自动绑定到技能插槽。

source: Obviously skill casting is a mandatory step, it is the only one that you cannot skip!
zh: 显然，技能施放是强制性步骤，这是唯一不能跳过的步骤！

source: Skill GUI
zh: 技能GUI

source: Players can open up the skills GUI by using `/skills`. This UI allows players to visualize their available skills and their effects, upgrade their available skills, and bind their skills to skill slots.
zh: 玩家可以通过使用`/skills`来打开技能GUI。此 UI 允许玩家可视化其可用的技能及其效果，升级其可用的技能并将其技能绑定到技能插槽。

source: Upgrading a skill
zh: 升级技能

source: Upgrading a skill **increases its power**. Players can choose the skill they would like to upgrade based on their play style and skill path they want to follow. Upgrading a skill takes **one skill point**.
zh: 升级技能**增强其功能**。玩家可以根据自己的游戏风格和想要遵循的技能路径来选择他们想要升级的技能。升级技能需要**一个 ​​技能积分**。

source: Skill points are a currency which players can use to upgrade their skills. One upgrade costs one skill point. Skill points can be granted using the following [admin command](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/commands):
zh: 技能积分是玩家可以用来升级其技能的货币。一次升级需要 1 个技能点。  可以使用以下[管理命令](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/commands)来授予技能积分：

source: ![upgrade1](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/upgrade1.Cr3v1DRG.gif)
zh: ![升级1](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/upgrade1.Cr3v1DRG.gif)

source: In the GUI, select the skill you'd like to upgrade by clicking it. The name of the selected skill displays in the UI name. You can then upgrade the selected skill by clicking the *Upgrade Skill* button. Items next to the *Upgrade Skill* button let the user visualize how strong the skill would be with a higher level.
zh: 在GUI中，单击选择你要升级的技能。所选技能的名称显示在 UI 名称中。然后，你可以通过单击*升级技能* 按钮来升级所选的技能。物品旁边的 *升级技能* 按钮让用户可以直观地看到更高等级的技能的强度。

source: A skill buff modifies the value of a certain skill modifier. It can target one or multiple skills using [category formulas](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/) and can only target 1 modifier. Skill Buffs can only be granted through [skill slots](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots) and [triggers](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers) (and per extension, skill trees).
zh: 技能buff 会修改某个技能修饰符的值。它可以使用[类别公式](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/)]来定位一个或多个技能，并且只能定位1修饰符。技能增益只能通过 [技能插槽](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/skills/binding#skill-slots)和 [触发器](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers)（以及每个扩展，技能树）授予。

source: Note that the syntax for targeting a skill category or a specific skill name is the same.
zh: 请注意，针对技能类别或特定技能名称的语法是相同的。

source: Editing the skill GUI
zh: 编辑技能GUI

source: The skill GUI can be edited by modifying the `gui/skill-view.yml` config file.
zh: 可以通过修改`gui/skill-view.yml`配置文件来编辑技能GUI。

source: First, please refer to [this wiki page](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/misc/ui-syntax) to learn about the general MMOCore UI syntax.
zh: 首先，请参考[这个wiki页面](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mythiclib/misc/ui-syntax)来了解一般的MMOCoreUI语法。

source: Item Functions
zh: 物品功能

source: The `next` and `previous` functions are used for pagination.
zh: `next`和`previous`函数用于分页。

source: `skill` is the item displayed for every skill available to the player. Its lore is a bit complicated:
zh: `skill`是为玩家可用的每个技能显示的物品。它的描述有点复杂：

source: The line starting with `{unlocked}` only displays if the player has unlocked the skill
zh: 仅当玩家已解锁技能时，才会显示以`{unlocked}`开头的行

source: The line starting with `{locked}` only displays if the player has NOT unlocked the skill yet
zh: 仅当玩家尚未解锁技能时，才会显示以`{locked}`开头的行

source: The line starting with `{max_level}` displays when the player has reached the max skill level
zh: 当玩家达到最大技能等级时，会显示以`{max_level}`开头的行

source: `{lore}` just copies and pastes the entire skill description
zh: `{lore}`只需复制并粘贴整个技能描述

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_skill.CJXgT6sZ.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_skill.CJXgT6sZ.png)

source: `switch` is the item that you'd click when switching from binding to upgrading mode
zh: `switch`是从绑定模式切换到升级模式时单击的物品

source: ![image](data:image/png;base64,)
zh: ![图片](data:image/png;base64,)

source: `skill-slot` is the item used in the binding mode
zh: `skill-slot`为绑定方式使用的物品

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_slot.DWnJakgS.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_slot.DWnJakgS.png)

source: `skill-level` are the items used to tell the player how the selected skill would behave if it had a higher level
zh: `skill-level`是物品，用于告诉玩家如果选定的技能具有更高等级，它会如何表现

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_level.BPUwfCvz.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_level.BPUwfCvz.png)

source: `upgrade` is the item clicked when you want to upgrade the selected skill
zh: `upgrade`是要升级选定的技能时点击的物品

source: ![image](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_upgrade.CauTLTdJ.png)
zh: ![图片](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/assets/item_upgrade.CauTLTdJ.png)

source: 🔐 Unlocking Skills
zh: 🔐解锁技能

source: Each skill can be locked, unlocked but not usable, or usable. Locking a skill means that it cannot be seen in the player's skills UI, and the player is unaware of its existence. When a skill is unlocked, it becomes visible to the player UI but can only be bound to a slot if the player meets the level requirements associated with the skill. A skill can be unlocked or locked through [triggers](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers) (recommended) or [commands](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/commands).
zh: 每个技能都可以锁定、解锁但不可用、或可用。锁定技能意味着在玩家的技能UI 中看不到它，并且玩家不知道它的存在。当技能解锁时，它对玩家UI 可见，但只有在玩家满足与技能关联的等级要求时才能绑定到插槽。技能可以通过 [触发](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/misc/triggers)（推荐）或 [命令](https://docs.phoenixdevt.fr/mmocore/general/commands)来解锁或锁定。

source: If you unlock a skill for which information is not filled in the class folder, it will be considered directly usable (at level 1) and won't be upgradable.
zh: 如果解锁了一个尚未在职业文件夹中填写信息的技能，该技能会直接视为可用，等级为 1，且无法继续升级。
